izzyondroid:com.nerdoftheherd.tasker.rsy.name: Rsync for Tasker
izzyondroid:com.nerdoftheherd.tasker.rsy.summary: Tasker plugin actions to allow running rsync over SSH
izzyondroid:com.nerdoftheherd.tasker.rsy.description:
Tasker is a very useful and widely used automation app for Android with a plugin architecture that allows other apps (such as this one) to add extra functionality.
 This app provides the following actions for use within Tasker:
 Generate Private Key - Generates a private key to use for SSH authentication
 Get Public Key - Retrieves a public key from a previously generated private key and returns it in the variable %pubkey 
 rsync - Run an rsync command to synchronise files to or from the device
 dbclient - Run an SSH command non-interactively (experimental)
 The packaged native binaries of Dropbear and rsync are my own builds which I keep updated with new releases.
 Reasons for requested permissions:
 FOREGROUND_SERVICE 
Run actions for more than a short time when triggered from older versions of Tasker.
 FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE 
(Android 14+) Run actions for more than a short time when triggered from older versions of Tasker.
 INTERNET 
Allow connecting to SSH servers (even if the SSH server is on your local network Android prevents connections without this permission).
 MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE 
(Android 11+) To read or write the files on your device with rsync.
 WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE 
(Android 10 and below) To read or write the files on your device with rsync.
 POST_NOTIFICATIONS 
Show a notification that a new version is available (if checking for updates is enabled).
 REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES 
Prompt to install an update after you have tapped on the update notification and chosen 'Download'.

fdroid:com.kinetica.keyboard.name: Kinetica
fdroid:com.kinetica.keyboard.summary: Two-thumb keyboard: both thumbs swipe and tap at once. No network access.
fdroid:com.kinetica.keyboard.description:
Kinetica is a keyboard for two thumbs at once. Each thumb swipes or taps on its
own, at the same time as the other, and the two streams merge into one word.
Typing "something": the left thumb taps S, then E, while the right thumb swipes
O -> M and then T -> H -> I -> N -> G. Kinetica merges them into S + OM + E +
THING.
It is a spiritual successor to the discontinued Nintype, written from scratch on
Android's public IME APIs: not a fork, and no third-party gesture or prediction
library. The dynamic time warping, the trie search and the two-thumb merge are
all in the app.
The app declares no INTERNET permission, so nothing you type can leave the
phone. Decoding, prediction and learning run on the device, and password or
private fields turn off suggestions, trails and learning.
Features
* Two thumbs, each read with its own cursor, so a word can pass between them in
 any order; one tap can stand for a double letter
* Long words in one stroke or two thumbs, up to 40 letters, learned as you
 write them
* English, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Czech, Dutch, German, French, Norwegian
 and Romanian, plus Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew and Arabic as experimental: 46k
 to 50k words per language with real corpus frequencies. Accented words are
 drawn on their base keys and restored on commit
* Several languages at once: mix two in the suggestions, or let the keyboard
 follow the language you are typing, each word learned into its own
* A short setup on first open: languages, height, automatic space, theme and a
 two-thumb practice
* Settings in two groups, with search, a field to try the keyboard on every
 screen, and a list of what you changed with a way back
* Next-word suggestions beside the word's corrections, recent words on the
 bar, and a correction strip right after each word
* Tap inside a word you wrote to swap it for another; swipe shift to change
 its case
* An editing page: arrows, selection, word moves, undo and redo, the clipboard,
 each key yours to change
* Tap autocorrect with three levels; backspace right after it undoes it
* Your words rank higher as you use them; slide a suggestion to raise, lower or
 block it. Names you write with a capital keep it
* Chords on ?123 or the spacebar, edge swipes on any key, and text expansions:
 type text, run an action, or press Ctrl and a key
* 1 906 emoji with search in 14 languages, people and hands in the skin tone
 you choose
* Voice input through a voice keyboard you install: Kinetica itself records
 nothing and has no microphone permission
* Long-press menus as grids, with your own list for every letter and symbol,
 and symbol pages you can rewrite as text. The letter menus follow your
 languages: German on, and s offers ß
* A letter from a long-press menu stays in the word: ß, ő, the Italian schwa
* Keys that fit the field: @ in email fields, / and .com in web addresses,
 words as typed there, and an optional number pad for numbers
* Clean links: tracking parameters out of a link, as a shortcut or on paste
* Clipboard history, off by default: the last 20 copies, encrypted on the
 phone and never in a backup
* Optional numbers row, a wider middle row, landscape split, one-handed for
 either hand, split mode, adjustable height and margins; landscape keeps its
 own sizes
* Peck-type mode for slang and code: every tap types exactly its letter
* Dark, light, Material You or your own colour; key borders, keys that light
 up along a swipe, a background image, and a night look of its own
* Backup of every setting, learned word and shortcut in one file
* Settings in English and Italian, with short tips and a two-thumb tutor
Source, build instructions and the full feature list:
https://github.com/EZ-eta/kinetica
If Kinetica is useful to you: https://ko-fi.com/ez_eta

fdroid:com.skycoin.skywire.name: Skywire
fdroid:com.skycoin.skywire.summary: Run a Skywire node on your phone: private chat, VPN, SOCKS proxy and a wallet
fdroid:com.skycoin.skywire.description:
Skywire is a decentralized network run by its users. This app runs a full Skywire node (a "visor") on your phone and gives you the apps that use it:
 SkyChat : end-to-end encrypted messages, groups, voice calls and file sharing, carried peer to peer over Skywire with no central chat server.
 SkyMail (beta): mail between Skywire nodes, sent to an address made from the node's key and kept on the phone. It does not reach ordinary e-mail.
 SkyVPN : route the whole phone's traffic through a Skywire VPN server, with an optional killswitch.
 SkySOCKS : a local SOCKS5 proxy through a public Skywire proxy server, for apps that support one.
 SkyDNS : open .dmsg and .skynet sites in any app on the phone.
 Wallet : a multi-coin wallet for Skycoin (SKY), Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH) and Tether (USDT), and for other Fiber coins and ERC-20 tokens you add. Keys never leave the phone, with QR send and receive.
 SkyDEX : trade on the Skywire decentralized exchange.
Your node has its own cryptographic identity. You can export or replace it, lock the app behind the phone's screen lock or fingerprint, and grant a desktop Skywire hypervisor remote management of the phone.
The node runs as a foreground service so connections survive in the background. Skywire uses Skycoin's public discovery servers to find other nodes; their software is open source in the same repository.
The wallet reads balances and history from public services, and each coin's Node screen can point it at another, including your own: node.skycoin.com for Skycoin, mempool.space for Bitcoin, and ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com with the eth.blockscout.com indexer for Ethereum and its tokens. Prices in US dollars are off by default and come from coinpaprika when turned on. SkyVPN looks up ordinary names with Cloudflare's 1.1.1.1 unless you set another DNS server in Settings. SkyDNS on its own uses the phone's own DNS.
Skywire rewards stay off until you set a reward xpub in Settings. The node then shares a hardware survey with Skycoin's reward service, which includes a hash of the phone's Android ID.
Skywire is free software under the GNU AGPL v3.0. A commercial license is available for uses that cannot comply with the AGPL.

fdroid:de.goraran.astroclock.name: AstroClock
fdroid:de.goraran.astroclock.summary: Astronomically correct 24-hour clock: the Sun is the hand, the star sky turns
fdroid:de.goraran.astroclock.description:
AstroClock is an astronomically correct 24-hour clock.
Instead of an ordinary dial, it shows the sky exactly as it currently stands above your location: the Sun travels around the dial once per day as the hour hand, and the entire starry sky turns along with it – just as it really does overhead.
Features:
* The Sun as the hour hand of a true 24-hour clock
* The co-rotating starry sky with constellations for your location
* Realistic Moon phase and the visible planets
* Compass / azimuth scale along the horizon
* Sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset as markers
* Location set by place name or coordinates
* Usable as a live wallpaper
* Home screen widget in a clear compact layout
Privacy:
AstroClock collects no data and contains no ads and no trackers. The app requests no location permission – you enter the location yourself. The only external connection happens when you search for a place by name; the search term is then sent to the free OpenStreetMap Nominatim service to turn it into coordinates. If you enter coordinates directly, no network access takes place at all.

fdroid:dev.kyu.karasu.name: Karasu
fdroid:dev.kyu.karasu.summary: Anime and manga tracker for AniList
fdroid:dev.kyu.karasu.description:
Karasu keeps your AniList list in step with what you watch and read, on a phone that talks to AniList directly — there is no server in between.
On Android it carries your lists with filters, presets and bulk edits, the season calendar, statistics and a year in review, notifications, the social feed, the forum and your profile. Pull a list down to sync, hold a title for everything you can do to it, and swipe up from the bottom bar for the command palette.
Four home-screen widgets show what is airing today, what you are watching and reading, and the week ahead — drawn from the cache, with no network of their own. A background check can tell you about new episodes with the app closed.
Detection on Android is Jellyfin: point Karasu at your server and the episode playing there counts down to an update, with the screen off if you allow the tracking service to run.
Installed from F-Droid, Karasu gets its updates from F-Droid; the APK from the GitHub releases fetches its own and opens the system installer. Karasu talks to AniList, to the Jellyfin server you set up, to GitHub once a week for the community's data on how episodes carry across seasons, and, when you open a profile, to the hosts of the images in its bio, through a bounded fetch of its own. It has no server of its own and no analytics.

fdroid:io.ente.auth.name: Ente Auth - 2FA Authenticator
fdroid:io.ente.auth.summary: Free, Cross Platform, Private, Open Source Two Factor Authenticator App
fdroid:io.ente.auth.description:
Ente Auth is the best and the only 2FA authenticator app you will ever need. It provides secure, end-to-end encrypted backup to your codes, works across devices whether its Android, iOS, Mac, Windows, Linux or Web. It also offers quality of life features like Tap to Copy, Next Code, and even allows you to share your codes securely with others.
Our customers absolutely love it.
- It works everywhere and can either be used in the cloud with end-to-end encryption or on a single device without the need for an account. Ente’s UI is well thought out and easy to use. Plus it even shows you the next code if the current one is about to expire so you dont have to wait for it to roll over before your start typing. You can even pin, tag, and search your codes which makes it a lot easier to manage a big list compared to Google Authenticator. They call it a labour of love on their Github page, and it really looks like one. - Linus Tech Tips
- Underrated but great authenticator app. Free, open source, and offers cloud backup. Very stable, has nice QoL features like the preview for the next code and the search bar. Overall, the best 2FA app I've used yet. - Luna Lometta
- Fantastic, fluid, has a dark theme, is open source, and also has a PC program. I switched from Authy to Ente Auth precisely for this reason, and I was surprised since the app as a whole is better and faster. - Daniel Ramos
- Better than Google Authenticator. - Piaw Piaw Kittens
- Authy's best replacement. Open source, desktop support, synchronization, convenient token export. Huge thanks to the developers, I hope your product will become popular and famous. - Sergey Tverye
Ente Auth is recommended by Linus Tech Tips, CERN, Zerodha and many others.
✨ Features
EASY IMPORT
Add TOTP 2FA Codes to Ente Auth easily. You can either scan a QR code, or import from other authenticator apps to make sure you never lose a code while migrating
CROSS PLATFORM
Ente Auth is available cross platform and supports all major devices and OS - including Android, iOS, Mac, Windows, Linux and Web.
SECURE E2EE BACKUP
Ente Auth provides end-to-end encrypted cloud backups so that you don't have to worry about losing your tokens. We use the same protocols Ente Photos uses to encrypt and preserve your data.
OFFLINE MODE - NO SIGNUP REQUIRED
Ente Auth generates 2FA tokens offline, so your network connectivity will not get in the way of your workflow. You can even use Ente Auth without signing up for backups and use it locally for as long as you want
INTUITIVE SEARCH
Ente Auth allows you to find your 2FA codes through one tap search. No more scrolling through a long list to find the right codes. Just tap on search and start typing.
CUSTOMISE YOUR EXPERIENCE
Customise your experience of Ente Auth to make it like you want. Reorder your 2FA codes so that your most frequently used services are always on top. Change the icons by choosing from our massive icon library. Add tags so that you can filter codes like you want
SEE NEXT CODE
Ever had to pause for the timer to run out on the current code, so you can type in the new 2FA code? Ente Auth makes your workflow extremely fast by displaying the next code prominently. Say goodbye to waiting
SHARE 2FA CODE
We all have sent multiple messages to that colleague who keeps asking for the 2FA code to a shared account. Such a waste of productive time. With Ente Auth, you can securely share your 2FA tokens as a link. You can even set an expiry time for the link as well.
ADD NOTES
Use notes to save any additional information including recovery codes. All notes are backed up with end to end encryption so you dont have to worry about losing them.

fdroid:net.eneiluj.moneybuster.description:
Moneybuster is a shared budget manager able to synchronize with IHateMoney and Nextcloud Cospend.
What's different from other shared budget managers?
You can keep your project local or make it synchronize with IHateMoney and Nextcloud Cospend projects.
This means you can choose where your data is going and preserve your privacy.
# Features
* Manage projects, members and bills (add/remove/edit)
* Search bills (by payer, name, amount, date)
* Generate and share project statistics and settlement plan
* Dark theme and customizable main app color
* Share/import projects with link/QRCode
* Connect to a Nextcloud account to automatically add projects

* Multi-lingual user-interface (translated on Crowdin: https://crowdin.com/project/moneybuster)
# Requirements
If you want to host a project in IHateMoney :
* IHateMoney instance running
If you want to host a project in Nextcloud Cospend :

# Alternatives
Tricount, Cospender, Splitwise etc... which are not FOSS and force you to give away your private data.

fdroid:org.disspair.disspair.name: DissPair
fdroid:org.disspair.disspair.summary: Audit Bluetooth Classic and BLE devices: RFCOMM, GATT and advertisements
fdroid:org.disspair.disspair.description:
DissPair is an open-source Bluetooth security toolkit for auditing Bluetooth Classic (RFCOMM) and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices you own or are authorized to test. Instead of trusting what a device advertises, it actively probes how the device really behaves. Two CVEs have been found with it (CVE-2026-31280, CVE-2025-67133).
 Discovery 
 Scan Classic (BR/EDR) and BLE devices, plus already-paired devices
 Device class tags, RSSI and filters for unnamed and paired devices
 Bluetooth Classic (RFCOMM) 
 Sweep RFCOMM channels 1-30 and see which accept unpaired (insecure) or paired connections
 Send AT commands and OBEX payloads, with automatic HFP handshake handling
 Flood test to stress a channel's buffer handling
 BLE advertisement inspector (GAP)

💾 Backups and restore
Create and restore message backups so you can keep your SMS history under your control.
🌍 Local-first privacy
Messages are processed on your device. SMSecure does not require registration, does not use ads, and does not collect user data.
⚠️ Important note
SMS only for now: MMS support is planned for a future release. Currently, SMSecure cannot send, receive, display, or download MMS messages.
End-to-end encryption works only when both sides use compatible software. Regular SMS messages are still regular SMS and are handled by the mobile network.
🧩 Free and Open Source
SMSecure is Free and Open Source Software licensed under GPLv3. The source code is available for review, auditing, and contribution.

apple-itunes:1472338480.description:
The NERV Disaster Prevention App is a smartphone service that delivers earthquake, tsunami, volcanic eruption and emergency warnings, as well as provides weather-related disaster prevention information for flooding and landslides, optimised based on the user's current and registered locations.
The app was developed to help people living in or visiting an area where damage is expected to occur, to accurately assess the situation and make quick decisions and actions.
With information received directly through a leased line connected to the Japan Meteorological Agency, our proprietary technology enables the fastest information distribution in Japan.
▼　All the information you need, in one app
Get a wide range of disaster prevention information, including weather and typhoon forecasts, rain radar, earthquake, tsunami and volcanic eruption alerts, emergency weather warnings and landslide information, river information, and heavy rain risk notifications.
By interacting with the map on the screen, you can zoom in on your location or pan across the country and see the cloud cover, typhoon forecast areas, tsunami warning areas, or the scale and intensity of an earthquake.
①　Providing users with the most appropriate disaster information
The home screen displays the information you need at the time and place you need it. When there’s an earthquake, the home screen will show you the latest information. If another type of warning or alert is issued while the earthquake is active, the app will sort them depending on the type, elapsed time and urgency, so you’ll always have the most important information at your fingertips.
②　Push Notifications for Important Information
We send out different types of notifications depending on the device’s location, the type of information and level of urgency. If the information is not urgent, we send a silent notification as not to disturb the user. For more urgent situations where a disaster is time-sensitive, a ‘Critical Alert’ alerts the user to an imminent danger. Notifications like Earthquake Early Warnings (Alert level) and Tsunami Warnings will be forced to sound, even if the device is in Silent or Do Not Disturb modes.
Note: Critical Alerts will only be sent to users in the target area of the most urgent types of disasters. Users who have registered their location but are not in the target area will instead receive a normal notification.
※ In order to receive Critical Alerts, you need to set your location permissions to “Always Allow” and have Background App Refresh turned on. If you don’t want Critical Alerts, you can disable them from Settings.
③　Barrier-Free Design
We paid close attention when designing the app to ensure our information is accessible to everyone. We put a focus on accessibility, with colour schemes that are easy to distinguish for people with colour blindness, and use a font with large, clear letters so long bodies of text are easy to read.
▼　Supporters’ Club (In-App Purchase)
In order to keep doing what we do, we’re looking for supporters to help us cover the development and operational costs of the app. The Supporters’ Club is a voluntary membership scheme for those who want to give back to the NERV Disaster Prevention app, by contributing to its development with a monthly fee.
You can find out more information about the Supporters’ Club on our website.
https://nerv.app/en/supporters.html
[Privacy]
Gehirn Inc. is an information security company. The security and privacy of our users is our highest priority. We take great care not to collect excessive amounts of information about our users through this application.
Your exact location is never known to us; all location information is first converted to an area code used by everyone in that area (like a zip code). The server also doesn’t store past area codes, so your movements cannot be tracked.
Learn more about your privacy on our website.
https://nerv.app/en/support.html#privacy

Your files are encrypted on your device before they leave it and can only be decrypted with your private key.
Your private key stays under your control. Neither DeNet nor Datakeepers can access or decrypt your files.
Decentralized
Your encrypted files are split into multiple parts and distributed across a decentralized network of independent storage providers called Datakeepers.
No single Datakeeper stores your complete file, creating a storage system without a single point of failure.
Automatic backup
Automatically back up photos, videos, files and folders from your devices.
Keep important data protected and free up space without deleting the files you want to keep.
One account across your devices
Use the same private key across mobile, Windows, macOS and Linux.
Access and synchronize your files across devices with one account.
Flexible storage, not a fixed subscription
You pay for the storage you actually use — not for a fixed subscription period.
Your storage balance is consumed based on the amount of data you store. If you don't store data, your balance isn't consumed.
Store more, and your balance is used faster. Store less, and it lasts longer.
Free to install. No ads.
DeNet is free to install and contains no third-party advertising.
Explore the DeNet ecosystem
The DeNet app gives you access to more than storage. You can also run a Watcher Node directly from the same app and participate in the ecosystem built on the DeNet Storage Protocol.

firefox-addons:933083.description:
Gemalto WebSigner is a digital signature−based software solution designed to protect and secure Internet transactions. The Gemalto WebSigner solution is capable of signing documents or transaction data presented by a web application, verifying the authenticity of the signatories, and encrypting and decrypting documents. Gemalto WebSigner combines the privacy, integrity, and authentication functionality provided by cryptographic algorithms with simplicity, portability, and convenience. With Gemalto WebSigner, you benefit from hardware-based security and the software-based security of PIN codes. Hardware-based security is a principal advantage that is significantly more secure than software-only solutions.
© Gemalto 2023

firefox-addons:2813063.name: Anti Anti Debug
firefox-addons:2813063.summary: Be able to use developer tools again
firefox-addons:2813063.description:
Be able to use developer tools again
Allows you to use developer tools on websites which utilize anti-debug techniques such as:
1. Repeated calls to debugger
2. getter traps
3. Console.clear() spam
What it does:
1. console.clear and console.table are set to do nothing.
2. console.log is overridden to filter DOM elements, functions, and objects with custom getters
3. Functions containing debugger calls are removed
4. setInterval checks for anti debugging scripts
Please report any issues to the Github:
 https://github.com/Andrews54757/Anti-Anti-Debug/issues 
This extension may break some websites which rely on certain specific logging tools. It is recommended to enable the extension only when needed.
Debug icons created by Alfian Dwi Hartanto - Flaticon
Troubleshooting Tips
0. For Firefox, you must allow the extension to view/edit data on the website you are on for the extension to work. Right click the extension icon to manage permissions.
1. Open devtools in new window, otherwise sites may detect using viewport width/height information
2. Disable source maps in devtools. Some sites will detect when source maps are automatically loaded through the devtools
3. Open devtools first, and then navigate to the site

firefox-addons:2608647.summary: A comprehensive privileged access management software to control, manage and audit the entire life cycle of privileged accounts.
firefox-addons:2608647.description:
ManageEngine PAM360 provides the comprehensive privileged access security solution 
for enterprise IT teams to have complete governance over privileged access 
entitlements and deep correlation of privileged access data with their overall network 
data. It offers effective orchestration of extended workflows through native browser 
extensions such as the Firefox add-on. 
Once you deploy the add-on, you will be able to perform most of the privileged access 
management activities using it, with PAM360 running in the background. The add-on 
helps you auto-fill passwords to websites and web applications and also set up Auto 
Logon gateway to launch RDP and SSH sessions. Additionally, the add-on allows you to view all passwords, resource groups, favorites, etc. 
PAM360 is available both as the free edition and as the paid subscription. At the end of 
the trial period, users can continue to use PAM360 as the free version, or subscribe to a 
paid edition. The add-on is free in all editions.
Here's the download URL for ManageEngine PAM360:
 https://www.manageengine.com/privileged-access-management/download.html

This is your mobile assistant to help you with your Spiritual Adoption of the Conceived Child. It will accompany you for the next 9 months of your prayer to help you redeem your commitment of prayer. Using illustrations we present every week of the child’s fetal development. There are also authentic ultrasound pictures and the heart echo scan of development’s subsequent stages. You can follow the child grow during the period of Spiritual Adoption and educate your community about the fetal appearance of a human. We have also prepared rosary considerations for each day and little surprise… you can read a short child’s thought corresponding to a given development stage. You will learn about the stages of human fetal development and become more sensitive about the conceived life.
The Daily Rosary Meditations were prepared by the Foundation-friendly priests, the ultrasound and heart echo scan were delivered by people from all over the country who wanted to contribute to this app. The creator of the application is Tiny Feet Foundation. 
More informations: www.adoptalife.pl

bluejetty:00017641:ios.description:
Welcome to BayPort!
Ranked Virginia’s #1 Best-in-State Credit Unions by Forbes 2021 & 2022!
The BayPort CU App allows you to enjoy seamless mobile experience designed exclusively for your device, giving you instant access to your BayPort Consumer and Business accounts.
Getting started is easy.
Simply download and launch the app. Then log in with your User ID and Password. 
If you are new online banking member, please see our Mobile Banking page for more information on how to log in the first time. 
https://www.bayportcu.org/bank/mobile-banking/
The BayPort CU Mobile App allows you to:
- Transfer funds 
- Pay bills
- View account balances and transactions
- Deposit checks on your mobile device
- Find BayPort ATM and Branch locations
Additional Features for Business Members:
- Set user access controls
- Manage Check Positive Pay
- Manage ACH Positive Pay
- Decision ACH Positive Pay
The BayPort CU Mobile App can put you in control of your finances, all in the palm of your hand!
24/7 ONLINE BANKING ACCESS
The BayPort CU Mobile App allows you to transfers funds, check your account balances, view your most recent transactions, and so much more! 
SAFE & SECURE
Our mobile app is encrypted with the Wireless Transport Layer Security (WTLS) protocol, the highest level of security available today. All data that passes between the wireless gateway, our service provider’s servers, and the BayPort CU web servers, are encrypted with 128-bit Secure Socket Layer (SSL).
FREE
The BayPort Mobile App may be used by all members free of charge. 
(Please note that many mobile phone carriers may charge a monthly fee for wireless web access and for the volume of data exchanged.)
QUESTIONS?
Check out our Frequently Asked Questions (FAQS) page for answers about the BayPort CU Mobile App. 
To use this app, become a BayPort Credit Union Member today! 
https://www.bayportcu.org/about/member-benefits
To learn how we protect your privacy, please visit: https://www.bayportcu.org/docs/bayport-privacy-policy.pdf
https://www.bayportcu.org

bluejetty:00071456:ios.description:
Bring out the singer in you on StarMaker——A popular karaoke & social singing app with 50M＋users globally! Whether you are a passionate singing enthusiast or a seasoned professional, StarMaker allows you to refine the voice and showcase your music talents. You can sing on your own, duet with friends, or sing alongside recordings of popular artists. Record your voice, create your MVs, and enhance your voice with professional audio editors. 
Sing Karaoke Songs
No matter you like pop or hip-hop, R&B or folk, jazz or blues, just pick your favorite songs from millions of songs, sing along with the high-quality backing music and rolling lyrics, and edit your recordings with voice effects and video filters. You can also duet with top artists and go Live to broadcast your music concerts and win likes and fans like a superstar! 
Professional Sound Effects
Supported by professional music team, the audio editor function offers you the chance to get varied sound effects when recording songs. Add sound effects you like, adjust the pitch based on your vocal range, and denoise or reduce latency to have a smooth and professional vocal performance.
With the popular singing app and social music community, you can: 
+ Pick your favorite songs and latest hits from millions of local and international songs with rolling lyrics and high-quality backing tracks.
+ Record with professional audio editor, using pitch correction and special effects like Karaoke, Studio, Superstar, Gig, Pop, etc.
+ Get real-time pitch feedback and Radar Chart Analysis of your voice to learn how to improve pitch precision, rhythm, singing techniques, emotion, and song choice.
+ Edit your selfie music videos with beautiful filters like Vintage, Cream, Sunset, Flower, Spring, etc.
+ Use video templates to create unique MVs with lyrics.
+ Share your covers on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat, Twitter, WhatsApp & more. Listen and record the music moments.
+ Sing and listen to songs with new friends in Live Duet to connect with the world seamlessly through music.
+ Host your online karaoke parties with friends in Party Rooms.
+ Join a "Family" social community to stay connected with other music lovers with similar tastes.
【STARMAKER PRO AUTOMATIC SUBSCRIPTION SERVICE DESCRIPTION】
1. Subscription Service Description: StarMaker offers several Pro Subscription packages. With StarMaker Pro, you can enjoy exclusive Pro privileges.
2. Subscription Service peroid and price:
 a) 1 Week - $7.99
 b) 1 Month - $14.99
 c) 1 Year - $59.99
3. Payment: The purchase is credited to the iTunes account after the user confirms the purchase and makes the payment.
4. Automatic Renewal: Apple's iTunes account will be charged within 24 hours before the expiration date, and the subscription period will be extended by one subscription period after the successful deduction.
5. Cancel Renewal: You can manage your automatic subscription service or disenable it by going to "Settings" -->"iTunes Store and App Store"-->"Apple ID"-->"Check Apple ID"-->"Subscriptions" from Apple. It can be cancelled 24 hours before the end of each billing period, and no fee will be deducted within 24 hours before the expiration.
6. Service Agreement
a) You can read our privacy policy at https://m.starmakerstudios.com/setting/privacy/sm/index
b) You can read our terms of service at https://m.starmakerstudios.com/setting/terms/sm/index

bluejetty:00132319:ios.description:
Plus40: The Ultimate Dating App for Singles over 40
Welcome to Plus40, the premier dating app designed specifically for singles over 40 who are seeking meaningful connections and companionship. Whether you're looking for love, casual dating, or simply to meet new people in your age range, Plus40 is the perfect platform to enhance your dating experience.
Why Choose Plus40?
Dating App for the Mature: Plus40 is tailored exclusively for mature singles aged 40 and above. We understand the unique needs and preferences of this demographic, and our app provides a safe and welcoming space to connect with like-minded individuals who are on a similar journey.
Online Dating Made Easy: With Plus40, online dating is a breeze. Our user-friendly interface allows you to effortlessly navigate through profiles, search for compatible matches, and initiate conversations. You can easily explore potential connections and get to know other singles from the comfort of your own home.
Find Love and Companionship: Whether you're looking for a long-term relationship or companionship, Plus40 is here to help you find your perfect match. Our sophisticated matching algorithm takes into account your interests, values, and preferences, ensuring that you are introduced to compatible individuals who share your relationship goals.
Casual Dating Opportunities: Plus40 also caters to those interested in casual dating. Our app provides a platform for singles to connect and engage in enjoyable and lighthearted interactions. Whether you're seeking new friendships or casual companions, Plus40 offers a flexible and inclusive dating experience.
Meet New People and Expand Your Network: Plus40 is not just about romantic connections; it's about expanding your social network and meeting new people. Our app enables you to forge new friendships, engage in stimulating conversations, and create lasting memories with like-minded individuals who are also seeking genuine connections.
Seamless Chat Functionality: Communication is key, and Plus40 ensures that you can easily connect and chat with other users through our intuitive chat feature. Engage in real-time conversations, share experiences, and foster meaningful connections with individuals who capture your interest.
Privacy and Security: We understand the importance of privacy and security in the world of online dating. Plus40 employs advanced security measures to safeguard your personal information, ensuring a safe and protected environment for all our users.
Discover the Possibilities with Plus40!
Embrace the possibilities of dating after 40 with Plus40. Join our vibrant community of singles over 40 who are ready to embark on new adventures and create meaningful connections. Whether you're searching for love, casual dating, or simply want to expand your social circle, Plus40 has the tools and resources to make your dating journey a success.
Sign up for Plus40 today and start exploring a world of exciting opportunities. Find love, enjoy casual dating experiences, and connect with amazing individuals who share your interests and desires. With Plus40, your dating experience will be elevated to new heights!

LEGO® DUPLO® Peppa Pig brings together the beloved world of Peppa Pig and the creativity of LEGO DUPLO, offering a fun and playful learning experience.
Little ones aged 2-6 can explore, build, and engage in oinktastic pretend play adventures with Peppa and her friends. 
• Play with Peppa Pig, her family and friends! 
• Role-play and storytelling—perfect for little ones 
• A wide and varied range of activities 
• Jump in muddy puddles or build a treehouse! 
• Fun problem-solving challenges 
• Build with colorful 3D LEGO DUPLO bricks 
• Play together to nurture social skills
When young children have fun and play, it creates the perfect conditions to learn and grow. We have designed this app to help young kids develop a balance of the IQ skills (cognitive and creative) and EQ skills (social and emotional) they need for the best start in life. 
CHARACTERS 
Peppa Pig, her little brother George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Grandpa Pig, Suzy Sheep, and Pedro Pony. 
Jump into happy and playful learning adventures, with giggles and snorts guaranteed!
AWARDS & ACCOLADES
• Kidscreen 2025 Nominee for Best Game App – Branded
FEATURES
• Safe and age-appropriate 
• Designed responsibly to let your child enjoy screen time while developing healthy digital habits at a young age 
• FTC Approved COPPA Safe Harbor Certification by Privo
• Play pre-downloaded content offline without wifi or internet 
• Regular updates with new content 
• Apple Family Sharing for easy subscription sharing with other family members 
• No third-party advertising 
• No in-app purchases for subscribers
SUPPORT

Our mission is to bring the world's most popular characters, worlds, and stories to life for children. We make apps for kids that engage them in well-rounded activities designed to help them learn, play, and grow. Parents can enjoy peace of mind knowing their kids are learning and having fun at the same time.

bluejetty:00127034:ios.description:
Play one of the best otome dating/romance love games in English!
Start your own medieval otome romance through this exclusive love story!
■This is an otome dating/romance love game recommended if:
・You love otome romance games.
・You love dating love romance games for girls.
・You want to play famous anime otome games for teens.
・You love anime dating simulator games.
・It is your first time playing an anime otome game.
・You love reading anime love novels.
・You love beautiful anime style illustrations.
Ikemen Prince: Beauty and Her Beast is the newest addition to CYBIRD’s hit Ikemen Series otome games! If you enjoyed Midnight Cinderella, Ikemen Sengoku, Ikemen Revolution, and Ikemen Vampire, get ready for another romantic phenomenon that will keep you on the edge of your seat! Take the fate of the kingdom into your own hands, and enjoy a tender, heartbreaking, and thrilling interactive romance novel!
Enjoy a vibrant, exciting romance complete with engaging music, gorgeous illustrations, and character voices! Receive 5 free Chapter Tickets each day to progress through the story! Free to download! Play now and find your very own medieval otome love!
You've been selected as "Belle" to choose the next king out of eight princes. If that wasn't hard enough, the princes turn out to be hot...and deadly. They're rumored to be beasts, and you find out that the rumors were far from wrong. 
In a world of war and intrigue, will you be able to save his heart and yours as you enter your very own fairy tale?
■Dress Up with Cute Attire for your Avatar and His
Experience more interactive otome romance gameplay with the in-game avatars.
Choose from gorgeous dresses, beautiful room backgrounds and gardens, and cute accessories to become a medieval princess! Freely rotate your avatar and decorations to make a room that matches your tastes! Limited edition attire pieces are constantly being added so that you can always stay up to date with the latest trends. Characters from the story are also available as avatars! Dress up your love interest for the perfect dating experience.
■Shape Your Otome Romance Story through the Choices You Make!
There are multiple endings available for each guy depending on the choices you make in this romance dating game. If you get enough points you might even receive a special epilogue with your one true love! Along the way, unlock special side stories told from his perspective to learn all about his true feelings. what kind of romance awaits you? Play to find out!
■Enjoy In-Game Story Events for a New Experience with Your Guy!
Ikemen Prince holds many special romantic Story Events that require no Chapter Tickets to continue reading! Play to experience exciting mini dating stories outside of the main story. Want to experience a new kind of romance with him? Get into new dating situations with your favorite guys, and clear endings to get bonus items and attire pieces!
■Collect Exclusive Cards!
Cards have gorgeous anime style illustrations featuring scenes from the main story, events, and more! Set your favorite Card as your Home background and he will speak to you! Cards include voiced lines so you can hear his enchanting voice! Depending on the card rarity, he might even get up and personal with you.

bluejetty:00135155:ios.description:
When the old world fell, new orders would rise. Welcome to the wasteland.
On this arid terrain, sanity and prosperity have been ripped away by apocalyptic nuclear attacks. Barbarian evilness is the new law, while civilization is long dead—at least that’s what the wastelanders say. However, there’re still righteous minds who put their faith in dispersing the darkness and bringing the order back, for they know it’s the only right way to survive and thrive.
Will you be the one to battle your way out of chaos and turn this war-torn land into a new oasis? It’s time to show the wasteland your true power! Ready to build an empire and take the shots? Start your journey now and stay safe out there, Boss!
· BUILD A STRONG BASE
Build the Base safe and strong to fuel your wasteland adventure. In this desert haven, you can manage everything from building construction to resource production. Give your command to lead this empire to a brighter future.
· GROW FORCE – HEROES & SOLDIERS
Recruit mighty Heroes and develop an invincible army to defend your Base and sweep the foes. Get ready to team up with Heroes with unique combat skills, train various types of soldiers to elevate your army power, and let your military strength do the talking on the wasteland.
· EXPLORE THE UNKNOWN
Dispatch scouts to clear out the haze and find out what’s waiting ahead—hidden riches, new foes, and desert buildings for you to occupy. Embark on Expedition to take down enemies and reap abundant rewards.
· UNITE ALLIES & WIN TOGETHER
Survival can be easier when united with your trusted ones. Build or join an Alliance to find fellow fighters and form an invincible force, help each other to develop faster, and carry out strategic combats against your enemies to enjoy group wins and shares.
· SPECIAL NOTES
This game includes random-item purchases.
Network connection is required.
Privacy Policy: https://www.leyinetwork.com/en/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.leyinetwork.com/en/privacy/terms_of_use

bluejetty:00184528:ios.summary:
Build army bases, raise infantry, use subterfuge - anything to win the Civil War
Welcome to the year 1861, soldier! The Civil War is at its peak and we need a commander for our troops. Use real time strategy to lead our army in this conque
bluejetty:00184528:ios.description:
Build army bases, raise infantry, use subterfuge - anything to win the Civil War
Welcome to the year 1861, soldier! The Civil War is at its peak and we need a commander for our troops. Use real time strategy to lead our army in this conquest and become a Civil War hero!
Build your empire and send your soldiers to the battlefield. Real time strategy will determine which side wins and sets the course of American history. Use base building to create your camp and customize your army with soldiers of all kinds: infantry, cavalry or heavy artillery.
The Civil War was one of the most famous battles in world history and now you can be the hero by demonstrating your power on the battlefield. Develop war strategy, check civil war battle maps, optimize the battlefield, and become the legend of the Civil War. Be the American Civil War commander that kids will study in their history books!
Play real time strategy war games and test your tactics - resources are scarce and collecting them takes time, so manage them well to win. Build and defend your base, follow your goal and use military strategy to achieve victory. As the war commander, you decide who lives or dies on the battlefield.
War and Peace Features:
Civil War Game
• Fight in the America Civil War - side with the Union and Abraham Lincoln or join the Confederacy with Jefferson Davis.
• Real time strategy in epic war battles let you decide the course of history!
• Multiplayer strategy and tactics will decide the outcome of the war.
• Civil War battle maps based on historical battles.
War Strategy Game
• Use Civil War military weapons and artillery from 1861.
• Build and defend in the most epic fights in American history with one of the most realistic MMO strategy games.
• Command and conquer an army of 1861 soldiers and become a military hero!
• Use base building to create and defend your base of operations.
Online Strategy Games
• Use your American history knowledge to fight on the battlefield.
• PvP battles have your army face off against other players!
• War and Peace leads you to a time where wars cannot be won with helicopters - remember that you’re in 1861 and there are no modern weapons!
• Base building, real time strategy, and subterfuge will help you win the Civil War!
Army Strategy Games:
• Build a military base and command your army against the enemy.
• Manage soldiers and develop tactics to win this epic war.
• Use subterfuge and military tactics to outwit your foes.
• Step into USA history and be part of the country’s defining war!
• Conquer civil war battle maps without using a tank or battleship!
Start base building, develop war tactics, take command and prepare your artillery for the MMO strategy war in War and Peace!
War and Peace is free too download and play, however some game items can be purchased for real money. Among these items, we offer a monthly subscription titled "Second Builder Subscription" priced at $14.99, which lasts for 30 days. After purchasing, players will get exclusive privileges which are increasing for each month while the subscription is active.
Please note:
1. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
2. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
3. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
4. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the your Account Settings after purchase
5. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Terms of Service:
http://www.war-and-peace.com/terms_of_use.html
Facebook Page:
https://www.facebook.com/warandpeacegame/
War, or peace, the choice is yours!

bluejetty:00062178:ios.description:
This is the brand-new Electronics Engineering ToolKit PRO! The HIGHLY RATED and RECOMMENDED productivity app.
Users say it is the BEST and MOST PRACTICAL Electronics App in the whole iTunes App Store.
From an electronics enthusiast with a master's degree in Electronics Engineering. This App is for engineers, students and hobbyists and anyone interested in Electronics Engineering. 
The App gets CONSTANT and POWERFUL improvements!
!!! This is a UNIVERSAL App - for iPhone and iPad !!! 100% PRO from the beginning without any In-App purchase!
The EE ToolKit PRO is the preferred Electronics App at schools and universities. It is available through the Volume Purchase Program with a discount for educational institutions. Many students, teachers and professors have downloaded the App and are using it during their studies and career.
WHAT OTHER USERS ARE SAYING:
“Awesome app, constant and powerful improvements”
This app was worth every penny I paid for it back when I bought it years ago. Since then, I’ve regularly used it at work and found it to be an excellent, quick tool to use. The most impressive aspect of this app are the constant and VERY impressive updates! Massive feature additions and very easy to use interface! The list of capabilities this app has makes it an amazing value for truly anyone involved in electronics.
“Latest version makes this an exceptional tool”
The EE Toolkit was always a very useful tool, but with the additions in the latest version it is truly an exceptional tool. The author is extremely diligent in managing bugs and improving the tool.
“A superb app highly recommended”
Fantastic application. Very useful. Always updated. Good developer. Lots of great bonus tools. Just love it.
"Incredible useful, worth the money"
I have had this app for a while now. Originally as an Electrical Engineering student I didnt really use it but once I was out in the field it became my bible. I definitely recommend to any engineering students/professionals alike. I also recommend buying the Pro version because it is definitely worth it. 
FEATURES OF THE EE TOOLKIT:
Ω more than 160 electronic applications
Ω amazingly great multi-functional keyboard
Ω huge selection of color code tools and SMD code tools
Ω audio scope and a frequency pitch detector
Ω favorites page only for the tools that you have marked as favorite
Ω full-featured frequency generator
Ω extra large component reference section (incl. 7400 Series, PIC family, etc.) with the option to open pdf datasheets live or by e.g. iBooks
Ω 555 Timer Tools with the most important application examples
Ω extensive collection of Single Board Computers (more than 120 different boards!!!)
Ω PCB trace impedance tools for several different structures
Ω simple and quick unit conversion within the single calculators
Ω fast on-the-fly conversions and calculations
Ω real-time circuit simulations of the example circuits
Ω support for preferred E series, sliders and min/max calculations
Ω auto-save of all entries over several sessions
Ω file manager to save and load individual calculations
Ω built-in access to your iCloud
Ω formula search tool with quick links to the tool which uses the formula
Ω and many many more

bluejetty:00019063:ios.description:
Welcome to Drive Ahead!, you win by hitting your friends on the head with cars! Drive Ahead! is the ultimate multiplayer battling retro game with cars, unpredictable chaos and driving. Battle with fun cars, like a monster truck, a tank or a 4x4 off-roader. There's tons of content to unlock and game modes to master.
FUN, FAST, ACTION PACKED BATTLES WITH CARS
Grab the wheel while driving into lightning fast party games! In Drive Ahead!, you'll reign supreme by winning matches in easy to start yet hard to master multiplayer fights. Drive ahead into crazy 2 player games, have fun driving alone or with friends!
MASTER ALL 250+ CARS
To improve driving these over the top cars, be it a monster truck or even motorbikes, you need practice, and a garage full of options. Perhaps driving tanks, a battle ship on wheels or a racing bike is more your thing, collect all the cars to impress your friends or rivals in multiplayer!
KING OF THE HILL & MISSION STADIUMS
How long can you reign in King of the Hill against an endless flow of opponents before you go kaboom? Explore exotic stylized Mission Stadiums for amazing rewards, while avoiding hazards like robots, aliens and penguins. Seriously, the penguins are the most dangerous.
PLAY IN 2 PLAYER OFFLINE PARTY GAMES
A fighter must train at all times, we support offline 2 player games to party with your friends in Drive Ahead! to help you ascend as a master of your favorite cars and retro big rigs!
Hundreds of pixel cars, helmets, levels, missions, and game modes bring endless hours of helmet-crashing two-player racing action with freak accidents! Just be careful not to wreck yourself!

bluejetty:00095384:ios.description:
No new earbuds needed — enjoy Live Translation today with any earbuds.
TransGPT is your AI translator for travel, business, study, or daily talk. Enjoy fast, accurate voice translation with smart real-time AI. Works with any earbuds—breaking language barriers has never been easier.
KEY FEATURES:
- Turn any Bluetooth earbuds into a Real-Time Translator
Transform your existing earbuds into a translation device: No proprietary hardware is needed—just sync with our app to unlock real-time translation. Enjoy instant, bidirectional voice translation for natural conversations in any language.
- Face-to-Face Bilingual Conversations Made Easy
Each person speaks in their own language, and TransGPT automatically translates in real time—creating smooth, natural bilingual conversations without awkward pauses or confusion.
- Smart Notes: Never Lose Important Conversations
Save translation sessions with bilingual transcripts and audio playback. Tap any timestamp to replay the exact moment. Generate AI-powered notes instantly—meeting summaries, study notes, interview highlights, travel journals, or medical consultations—tailored to your needs.
- Camera Translation for Signs & Menus
Point your camera at signs, menus, or documents for instant translation. Perfect for navigation, dining, and shopping abroad.
- Offline Translation for On-the-Go Use
Download language packs to use basic translation features without internet. Stay connected even in areas with poor network coverage or when traveling internationally.
REAL-WORLD SCENARIOS:
- Business & Professional
Close deals with confidence in international negotiations, client meetings, and trade shows like CIIE or Canton Fair. Smart Notes captures every detail—contract terms, technical specs, and action items—so nothing gets lost in translation.
- Travel & Exploration
Navigate foreign cities with ease—ask for subway directions, decode restaurant menus, understand cosmetic ingredients, or convert clothing sizes. Camera translation makes signs and labels instantly readable.
- Daily Life & Social
Handle everyday interactions—chatting with neighbors, shopping at local markets, or making new friends abroad. Translate social media posts, messages, and casual conversations effortlessly.

bluejetty:00015680:ios.description:
Self Help for Stress & Trauma in 38 languages
Stress and traumatic experiences can produce many symptoms. It can take time to heal completely, however, many symptoms can be resolved with the Trauma Tapping Technique (TTT) and similar self-help.
Trauma Tapping Technique (TTT) takes 10 minutes to do and has proven helpful in calming emotional responses to stress and traumatic experiences for over 100.000 people in 20 countries. It is a First Aid technique, which means everybody can do it, and it is not intended to replace professional help.
Tapping techniques belong to a field called Energy Psychology which includes Thought Field Therapy (TFT), Emotional Freedom Technique (EFT) and Tapas Acupressure Technique (TAT). TTT is specifically designed as an efficient and scalable non-verbal First Aid.

Stress and traumatic experiences can produce many symptoms. It can take time to heal completely, however, many symptoms can be resolved with the Trauma Tapping Technique (TTT) and similar self-help.

Trauma Tapping Technique (TTT) takes 10 minutes to do and has proven helpful in calming emotional responses to stress and traumatic experiences for over 100.000 people in 20 countries. It is a First Aid technique, which means everybody can do it, and it is not intended to replace professional help.

Tapping techniques belong to a field called Energy Psychology which includes Thought Field Therapy (TFT), Emotional Freedom Technique (EFT) and Tapas Acupressure Technique (TAT). TTT is specifically designed as an efficient and scalable non-verbal First Aid.

LANGUAGES: Albanian, Arabic, Chinese, Czech, Danish, Dari, Dutch, English, Farsi/Persian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Japanese, Kinyarwanda, Kurmanji, Kurdish/Sorani, Lingala, Maori, Nepali, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbo-Croatian, Slovak, Slovenian, Somali, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Tigrinya, Turkish, Ukrainian.

www.selfhelpfortrauma.org
info@peacefulheart.se

The latest model kits previewed
Up-and-coming model industry releases
The latest accessories and add-ons form around the world
Competitions to win modelling stuff
Modelling-related book and DVD reviews
High quality reference artwork
Photo-reference features relevant to model kit subjects
Model show reports

bluejetty:00074057:ios.description:
Easily manage large song catalogs with the best-in-class chord sheet editor featuring unmatched auto-scroll capabilities, smart automation features and a powerful adaptive audio engine.
Master your craft
Instantly transform plain text song sheets into transposable chord sheets with professionally formatted chord symbols and matching chord diagrams. Access a virtual fretboard to discover alternative chord voicings and customize the number of strings, their tuning and optional capo positions. Quickly transpose songs with audio backing tracks to match your vocal range and freely adjust the playback speed to get in the groove with ease.
Compose with ease
Get inspired with the Songs app's chord matrix and auto-generate chord symbols while playing the virtual instruments. Explore harmonic fields and master chord progressions with a built-in circle of fifths. Experience a more intuitive way of working with songs thanks to the Songs app's unique focus mode, customizable layout themes, smart chord repositioning features and transposable tabs.
Make your mark

Enjoy complete access to your entire song catalog on all of your macOS & iOS devices with automatic sync via iCloud.
Perform with confidence
Make live performances a joy with the Songs app 'smart scroll' chord charts and unrivaled auto-scroll and page flip capabilities. Play back multitracks in a variety of audio formats, create custom setlists and forward your songs to bandmates via AirDrop. Stay in control with bluetooth page turners and MIDI foot pedals and use a powerful timeline to add reliable audio playback & MIDI automation.

bluejetty:00034917:ios.description:
BTR AMP – Your Music, Your Way
Take full control of your music library with BTR AMP, the ultimate offline music player for iPhone and iPad. Designed for audiophiles and music lovers, BTR AMP delivers seamless playback, unparalleled library management, and powerful personalization features — no internet required.
FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS:
• Play It Your Way: Enjoy gapless playback, crossfade, shuffle, and repeat modes.
• Hi-Res Audio: Play bit-perfect, high-resolution music (96kHz/24-bit) through USB DACs for crystal-clear sound.
• CarPlay & Siri Support: The most complete CarPlay and Siri music experience to enjoy your tunes on the road.
• Extensive Format Support: Play all major audio file types — DSD (DSD64-DSD256 via DoP, up to DSD1024 via PCM conversion), MP3, FLAC, M4A, ALAC, AAC, OPUS, VORBIS, and many more.
• Powerful Playlists: Create unlimited Smart Playlists based on rules you define or import all of your existing M3U/M3U8 playlist files.
• Lyrics: Sing along with karaoke style scrolling lyrics from LRC sidecar files or embedded lyrics
• Chapters: Navigate audiobooks, DJ mixes, and live sets with automatic chapter detection from cue sheets, M4B files, or timestamped tracklists
• Tag & Organize: Edit metadata, album artwork, ratings, and favorites to keep your collection in perfect order.
• Customize Everything: Choose color themes, Dark Mode, list shortcuts, and Dynamic Type for a personalized experience.
• File Freedom: Access music from USB drives, memory cards, cloud storage (Google Drive, OneDrive, SMB, WebDAV), and manage everything with the built-in file manager.
BTR AMP lets you play both iTunes and non-iTunes music in one app, offering seamless control whether you're at home, in your car, or on the go. Enjoy your music with rich features like a 10-band equalizer, ReplayGain normalization, Last.FM scrobbling, and flexible playback options over Bluetooth, AirPlay, or connected devices.

Privacy Policy: https://www.btrlabs.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00187119:ios.name: TRANSFLO Mobile+
bluejetty:00187119:ios.summary: Transflo® Mobile+ is a complete trucking solution rolled into one convenient mobile app. It starts with the on-the-go scanning solutions you need with the fastest document delivery available. Plus, we’ve added in the features you need like
bluejetty:00187119:ios.description:
Transflo® Mobile+ is a complete trucking solution rolled into one convenient mobile app. It starts with the on-the-go scanning solutions you need with the fastest document delivery available. Plus, we’ve added in the features you need like accident and OS&D submission, load review and acceptance, integrated navigation designed specifically for trucking routes, weigh station bypass technology, two-way messaging with your fleet or broker and fuel finder perks like myPilot and Love’s Connect. 
Our integrated navigation is designed specifically for trucks. The software accounts for the dimensions of each truck and trailer, driver fuel needs and trucker-friendly rest areas — all while offering users real-time traffic view and full GPS map access even if data signal is lost.
Transflo® Mobile+ is proud to offer the easiest and most advanced weigh station bypass solution in the industry. Our bypass feature uses geo-fencing technology that notifies drivers when they are within two miles of a designated weigh station. That means no stopping, no wasting time and no unnecessary fees for safe drivers.
When you do need to weigh, save time with the new Weigh My Truck features without ever leaving the Transflo® Mobile+ app. This integration allows commercial drivers to weigh their trucks at over 1,800 locations throughout the U.S. and Canada.
Transflo® OnDemand lets carriers send documents to drivers so they can easily be printed at a network of strategically located truck stops throughout the U.S. and Canada.
With Transflo® Mobile+ you’ll get notifications when there are available loads. Just accept or decline them right on your smartphone or tablet! With a simple swipe, drivers can also let their carriers or brokers know which leg of the trip they’re on. Included is the ability to view both destinations on the map and truck stops along the way to better help drivers plan.
Transflo® Mobile+ can be used by drivers to send paperwork, and photos for accidents and OS&D, to carriers. We’ll walk you through the process with necessary data input and allow you to take photos or upload existing photos for your accident or OS&D submissions. After submitting documents for accidents or OS&D, a unique confirmation number and email notification is generated allowing images to be viewed for up to 14 days.
Note: Your fleet or broker must be authorized to use Transflo® Mobile+ for you to access these features. Registration follows the same process as Transflo® Mobile+. You will need a Fleet or Broker ID. A Fleet ID can be obtained from your driver manager or office personnel. Carriers will be provided with a Broker ID from an authorized broker or from Pegasus TransTech.
Transflo® Mobile+ supports Driver Hours of Service when using a Transflo® T-Series ELD device. With an HOS feature the app will automatically switch a driver to ON DUTY DRIVING mode when detecting a driving pattern (12mph for 5 seconds or more) and back to ON DUTY NOT DRIVING when detecting driving has stopped for at least 5 minutes.
Transflo® image optimization improves legibility even for carbon-copied documents, and documents with light gray text on a color background (blue, yellow, green, pink, etc.)
Summary of Features & Functionality:
• Optimized image quality 
• Accept or reject loads
• Two-way communication directly with your carrier or broker
• Handle accident and claim submissions from your device
• Get updated on your settlements
• Scan and doc type images
• View nearby Transflo® Express truck stops
• Automatically Compresses document image(s) for fast transmission and minimal data plan usage 
• Allow multiple documents to be scanned & sent together
• No-hassle auto updates
• Quality check – automatically evaluates, scores and validates image quality before submission. 
• If the user captures an image that has questionable focus or is not legible, the app prompts the user to review or re-take the image.
• Find nearest Transflo® Express scanning truck stop locations

Всемирно известные и эксклюзивные бренды, в числе которых Maison David, Tendance, Lumique, MM6 Maison Margiela, Casadei, Officine Creative, Diesel, Karl Lagerfeld, Bronx, Loriblu, Giovanni Fabiani, Camper, ASH, Halmanera, Ernesto Dolani, Versace Jeans Couture, Love Moschino и другие.
УДОБНЫЙ ПОИСК
Поиск по фото позволяет легко найти ту самую или максимально похожую модель обуви или одежды. Вы также можете быстро подобрать нужное благодаря фильтрам по цвету, стилю, размеру, сезону, цене и другим параметрам. Хотите примерить товар в магазине? Проверьте его наличие в нужном вам Rendez-Vous и забронируйте до конца рабочего дня магазина. 
БЫСТРАЯ ДОСТАВКА
Бесплатная доставка собственной службой мобильных продавцов Rendez-Vous (Москва и Московская область), в магазины Rendez-Vous, партнерскими службами доставки DPD и CДЭК по указанному адресу, а также в постаматы и на кассы магазинов «Пятерочка» и «Перекресток» службой 5Post по всей России. Возможность примерки и частичного выкупа заказа.
БЕЗОПАСНАЯ ОПЛАТА 
Вы можете оплатить покупку удобным способом: наличными при получении, банковской картой, через систему быстрых платежей (СБП), с помощью сервисов «Долями», «Яндекс Сплит», «Плати частями» от Сбербанка и «Плайт». 
ВЫГОДНАЯ ПРОГРАММА ЛОЯЛЬНОСТИ PRIVILÈGE
— система скидок до 25%, 
— 5% кешбэк за покупки,
— подарки на день рождения,
— бесплатный ремонт сроком до 3 лет.
УДОБНЫЙ ЛИЧНЫЙ КАБИНЕТ 
Вся информация о ваших покупках, состоянии бонусного счета, избранных товарах, возможность отслеживания изменения цен для выбранных моделей и оповещения о новых поступлениях и выгодных акциях.

Специалисты единой службы информации помогут вам: 8 (800) 700-88-66 (по России бесплатно, ежедневно 7:00-24:00).

bluejetty:00014728:ios.name: Site Report Pro+ Punchlist App
bluejetty:00014728:ios.summary: Site Report Pro is the #1 mobile app for generating a field inspection report or professional punch list report as a PDF or XLS file (Excel document). Fast and easy to use, with powerful features not found in other punch list and site inspe
bluejetty:00014728:ios.description:
Site Report Pro is the #1 mobile app for generating a field inspection report or professional punch list report as a PDF or XLS file (Excel document). Fast and easy to use, with powerful features not found in other punch list and site inspection report apps, we are confident it will revolutionize the way you manage projects, highlight deficiencies, perform risk assessments and generate your inspection or field report.
Whether you are an individual or a team, you can benefit from tools to mark up and blur photos, simple issue assignment, powerful filter & sort capability, and generation of PDF inspection reports in a choice of 40 premium themes that will amaze clients and colleagues.
Customizable for a specific trade or industry, Site Report Pro is used worldwide for site walks, reporting punch list items, producing a custom site inspection report, performing risk assessments, tracking construction projects and much more.
The Site Report Pro App makes it easy to create and share a site inspection report, field report, or punch list report, as an XLSX file (Excel document) or as a professional PDF report, all while on the job site using only your iPhone or iPad.
Benefit from the following features that are generally not found in other site inspection report, punch list, and field inspection apps:
- Add up to 8 photos per issue to ensure all observations are captured in the report. Add multiple photos at once or instantly create issues from your selected images.
- Mark up and blur each photo to highlight issues using powerful annotation tools — don't worry if you make a mistake, annotations can be moved and resized.
- Add professional sign-off signatures to your reports — generate from your name, draw your own, or import an existing signature.
- Produce and share professional punch list PDFs & site inspection reports via e-mail or third-party tools such as Dropbox.
- Choose from 40 available report themes.
- Configure each Excel document (XLS, XLSX) or PDF inspection report using powerful customization, sorting and filtering tools — e.g. generate and send each trade or contractor a report of outstanding issues.
- Powerful ordering, sorting, searching and filtering of projects, issues & punch lists.
- Use the flexible tagging capability to categorize the inspection report or punch list any way you want.
- Assign and send issues to your team members, colleagues and contractors.
- Import and export project backups to keep your data safe and transfer between devices.
- Maintain a chronological history of work with automatically time-stamped comments.
- High quality software and first class customer support — access support chat directly from the app.
Site Report Pro does not require an online service or sign-up.

Annoy your friends! Enrage your enemies! Bore yourself to tears! This application does just one utterly pointless thing: it sings the entire song "99 Bottles of Beer on the Wall" (starting with 99 bottles and ending when no bottles remain) in an artificial-sounding computer-generated voice.
On the screen, 99 bottles are displayed. As the song reaches the phrase "take one down", you tap a bottle (or, in autoplay mode, a bottle is randomly chosen) and it is taken down and removed from the screen. The count of remaining bottles is also shown. So you can be bored watching the screen as well as listening to the song.
If 99 bottles is just too many — perhaps you're in a hurry? — you can start with fewer bottles in various amounts down to 1.
Please, for your own safety, if you must sing along, sing responsibly.

bluejetty:00088851:ios.description:
It's all the poker hands you know, but no need to bluff. Split 13 cards into 3 hands, stack them strongest to weakest, and beat all 3 at once.
3-Stack Poker is built for players who want to master every Poker hand combo without the mind games, or who just want a fresh spin on the poker they already know inside out. The skill here isn't reading faces - it's reading your cards: with the same 13 you're dealt, how you arrange and balance strength across all 3 hands decides whether you win big or foul out. If you love the hands but never cared for the bluffing, this is the poker made for you.
Why players love it:
- 100% ad-free gameplay
- Focused on Poker hands arrangement skills, no negotiation and bluffing needed
- Daily rewards & quests to keep every session worth it
Join a global community of 2M+ players, never once bot-gaming
Also known as Pusoy, Chinese Poker, or Mậu Binh - the same game you love, new name, same 3-hand challenge.
Download 3-Stack Poker now and prove your hands can outsmart anyone's bluff.

bluejetty:00128366:ios.description:
Spider Solitaire is one of the most popular card games in the world! Now available to play free for iPad or iPhone from MobilityWare, the ORIGINAL maker of Spider Solitaire with Daily Challenges. This game is sometimes called Spiderette or Spiderwort, but it’s always a challenge that will puzzle your brain for hours of endless fun! 
== How to Play ==
Place all the cards in each suit in stacks of descending order. Weave your way as a beginner through 1 and 2 suit games and move up in difficulty as you attempt to tackle 3 and 4 suit games and become a true Spider Solitaire master!
Spider Solitaire has the same high standards and polished gameplay you’ve come to expect from the makers of the #1 free Solitaire game! Download now, and relive the familiar card game you know and love with the best Spider Solitaire in the app store.

• ALL NEW: Progress through new levels and earn titles along the way
• Daily Challenges with festive calendar themes for each month
• Playful animations to celebrate your wins
• Winning Deals that guarantee at least one winning solution
• Change the look of your cards and background for a customized experience
• Easy tap to move interactions for quick gameplay
== More Features ==
Are you a power player? Here are some more features you’ll love:
• Customize settings to suit your taste
• Adjust difficulty with 1-4 suit games
• Use the Unrestricted Deal setting to deal new cards, even with empty slots
• Unlimited undo option
• Adjust how you see hints
• Track your statistics, like Games Won, Average Time, and Winning Streaks

About Spider Solitaire Subscription
Spider Solitaire Subscription is an optional subscription that gives you access to seamless play without any ads, the ability to play future Daily Challenges and exclusive themes.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless automatic renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current term. bluejetty:00030153:ios.summary:

The Mobile ID Verify app is used by busines
bluejetty:00030153:ios.description:
Mobile ID Verify by IDEMIA scans and verifies digital identity credentials such as mobile driver’s licenses (mDL) and state-issued Mobile IDs (mID) as well scans US State-issued IDs (DL and ID).
The Mobile ID Verify app is used by businesses and relying parties to check digital IDs and display relevant identity information in a convenient and organized fashion to support transactions with consumers.
How it works:
1. When ready to scan an ID, open the app and click the button “I'm ready to scan”.
2. Hover the mobile device camera over a mobile ID digital barcode or the QR Code.
3. Once the ID has been scanned, identity information will be displayed for review.
4. Results can be dismissed by tapping the “DONE” button. Data is deleted and no data is stored on the verifier’s device.
Key Features:
* Scan and verify digital Mobile ID (mID/mDL) credentials
* Contactless scanning does not require touching consumer phones
* Quickly verify the age of a customer via customizable settings to meet regulatory needs (e.g. 18+ for tobacco products or 21+ for liquor) 
* Scan QR Codes on Mobile IDs to validate authenticity and inspect attributes
* Fully offline (device-to-device) scanning and validation with Bluetooth low energy (BLE) data transfer
* Adheres to ISO-18013 standard ensuring secure and trusted transactions to help eliminate fraud
FAQs
Q: What can I do with this App?
A: This app can be used to validate the authenticity of a Mobile ID (mID) or Mobile Driver’s License (mDL) so that you have the confidence that the person conducting the transaction is who they say they are. The app operates in a convenient, contactless manner without having to handle physical ID cards.
Q: How is an identity verified?
A: There are a couple ways to initiate an identity verification. Scanning a PDF417 barcode on a Mobile ID or physical identity card will immediately display the credential’s data, or scanning a QR code on the Mobile ID requests a set of attributes from the Mobile ID.
Q: How are verification transactions secured?
A: Verification transactions initiated by a QR code scan are 100% secure through the use of device authentication and data encryption giving full trust and assurance that the data received is accurate.
Q: Who developed this App?
A: Mobile ID Verify was developed by IDEMIA, the #1 issuer of physical driver’s licenses in the U.S. and pioneer of Mobile ID (mID), a government issued digital ID. IDEMIA is the global leader in Augmented Identity, provides a trusted environment enabling citizens and consumers alike to perform their daily critical activities (such as pay, connect, and travel), in the physical as well as the digital space.

listings.name: Mobile ID Verify
listings.description:
Mobile ID Verify by IDEMIA scans and verifies digital identity credentials such as mobile driver’s licenses (mDL) and state-issued Mobile IDs (mID) as well scans US State-issued IDs (DL and ID).


The Mobile ID Verify app is used by businesses and relying parties to check digital IDs and display relevant identity information in a convenient and organized fashion to support transactions with consumers.



How it works:

1. When ready to scan an ID, open the app and click the button “I'm ready to scan”.

2. Hover the mobile device camera over a mobile ID digital barcode or the QR Code.

3. Once the ID has been scanned, identity information will be displayed for review.

4. Results can be dismissed by tapping the “DONE” button. Data is deleted and no data is stored on the verifier’s device.



Key Features:
* Scan and verify digital Mobile ID (mID/mDL) credentials
* Contactless scanning does not require touching consumer phones
* Quickly verify the age of a customer via customizable settings to meet regulatory needs (e.g. 18+ for tobacco products or 21+ for liquor) 
* Scan QR Codes on Mobile IDs to validate authenticity and inspect attributes
* Fully offline (device-to-device) scanning and validation with Bluetooth low energy (BLE) data transfer
* Adheres to ISO-18013 standard ensuring secure and trusted transactions to help eliminate fraud


FAQs
Q: What can I do with this App?
A: This app can be used to validate the authenticity of a Mobile ID (mID) or Mobile Driver’s License (mDL) so that you have the confidence that the person conducting the transaction is who they say they are. The app operates in a convenient, contactless manner without having to handle physical ID cards.


Q: How is an identity verified?
A: There are a couple ways to initiate an identity verification. Scanning a PDF417 barcode on a Mobile ID or physical identity card will immediately display the credential’s data, or scanning a QR code on the Mobile ID requests a set of attributes from the Mobile ID.


Q: How are verification transactions secured?
A: Verification transactions initiated by a QR code scan are 100% secure through the use of device authentication and data encryption giving full trust and assurance that the data received is accurate.


Q: Who developed this App?
A: Mobile ID Verify was developed by IDEMIA, the #1 issuer of physical driver’s licenses in the U.S. and pioneer of Mobile ID (mID), a government issued digital ID. IDEMIA is the global leader in Augmented Identity, provides a trusted environment enabling citizens and consumers alike to perform their daily critical activities (such as pay, connect, and travel), in the physical as well as the digital space.
