bluejetty:00077504:ios.description:
HuntFish OH is an official application of the Ohio Division of Wildlife. HuntFish OH is a mobile path for Ohio’s hunters, anglers and shooters to licensing, game check, and communication with the Ohio Division of Wildlife through mobile devices.
Features include:
· Customer Account- create an account or sync with current account in Ohio’s Wildlife License System
· Purchases- convenient access to purchase hunting and fishing licenses, permits, stamps, and the Wild Ohio magazine.
· Display licenses and permits- display current and past licenses and permits on the phone
· Game check- submit game check from the phone even without a connection, and obtain confirmation code once the phone reestablishes service
· Maps- interactive maps with directions and information on Ohio’s public lands, boat ramps, lakes, shooting ranges, and license agents
· Resources- contact information, including directions and phone numbers, the latest hunting and fishing digests, and other popular resources for outdoor enthusiasts
· Weather- display current weather conditions and sunrise/sunset tables before heading out on the water or in the field.
The application requires internet access through Wi-Fi or cellular wireless connection to access some of the features.

bluejetty:00023071:ios.description:
Learning has never been so fun!
Bright and colorful app with loads of different games for comprehensive and safe development of your child. Available anytime and anywhere - with NO ads.
Let your child be the fastest racing driver, the fearless airplane pilot or the bravest captain of a ship! Or, explore faraway seas with cute boats and submarines. Also, have more fun with dinosaurs, coloring, or listen to bed-time lullabies. Develop fine motor skills, creativity and memory with us!
- Choose your own journey on a car or boat
- Learn shapes and colors
- Collect and solve jigsaw puzzles
- Train in logic and memory skills
- Practice sorting items
- Get creative and colorful pictures
- Listen to lullabies at bedtime
- Learn reading with Fairy Tales
- Explore the world of amazing Dinosaurs
- Meet different animals and much more!
The app includes games for both learning and fun! Children between 2 and 5 years old will love it:
- COLORING BY NUMBERS
Boost your child’s creativity and math skills by painting interesting pictures and shapes! Learn to count and solve math problems!
- FASHION ROOM
Choose your favorite character and dress it up! Get creative and develop a sense of taste and style!
- DINER
Cook a delicious dish for a cute character and feed it till it’s full!
- CARS
Choose any vehicle from different categories, upgrade it and go on a trip!
- BOATS
Choose a boat, decorate it and sail away to explore new places!
- SHAPES
Learn to sort shapes by size and color! Children develop logic and fine motor skills!
- SORTING
Sort items into different categories - balls, planes and cars all have their place!
- DINOSAURS
Play with each of the dinosaurs, make friends with them and learn fun facts about these astonishing creatures.
- FAIRY TALES
Experience the magic of fully narrated fairy tales with interactive scenes and animated characters! Read books and play educational games!
- MATH GAMES
Learn numbers, shapes and counting - math has never been so easy and enjoyable!
- FARM
Meet the lovable residents of the farm - a pink pig, a cuddly goat and a friendly puppy!
- LULLABIES
Baby can drift off to sleep with a soothing lullaby - for the perfect night’s rest!
- COLORING
Simply color the picture, get creative, develop your imagination and fine motor skills!
With an amazing selection of games, colorful animation and an intuitive interface, this app will appeal to boys, girls - and even their parents!
The application works by subscription. New games will be added regularly.
Subscription payment options:
Full game access - monthly
Full game access - annual
Important information about subscriptions:
• The trial period of the subscription is 3 days;
• If you change your mind at any point, cancellation is easy through your iTunes settings;
• During the trial period, you can cancel the subscription without cancellation fee at any time;
• Subscription renews automatically if the auto-renewal function has not been disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period;
• Payment will be charged to the iTunes account after confirming the purchase of the application;
• Payment for renewal of the subscription in the agreed amount will be taken within 24 hours before the end of the current period;
• After the purchase, you can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings;
• If you were given a trial period, after purchasing a subscription the remaining time of the trial period will be lost.
You can use your subscription on any device registered with your Apple ID. Like all Apple subscriptions, the app can’t use family sharing to share subscriptions across different Apple IDs.
Terms of use: https://playandlearn.games/termsofuse
We love to make kids happy with entertaining games, and also like to read your letters! If you need help, have questions, or want to say ‘hi’, get in touch at info@playandlearn.games

bluejetty:00092042:ios.summary: PROView Link® (PVL) allows you to monitor your PCS wireless-enabled device(s) from your mobile device(s). Wireless connectivity provides a convenient and functional way to access pertinent information directly to your smartphone or tablet s
bluejetty:00092042:ios.description:
PROView Link® (PVL) allows you to monitor your PCS wireless-enabled device(s) from your mobile device(s). Wireless connectivity provides a convenient and functional way to access pertinent information directly to your smartphone or tablet such as state of charge, history, and status.
The stored charging data includes date and time stamp information, battery type(s) and voltage, beginning battery voltage, amp hours replaced, percentage returned, and early charge termination(s) details. Other valued features include the ability to assign a name and/or an asset number to your charger/equipment, assistance in locating your product up to 300 ft., one-button upload of your historical charging profile to an email, one-button push to call PCS customer support, the capability to receive messages and update your charger to the latest firmware, access to app tutorial, set up videos, definitions, FAQ’s and more.
PROView Link® is the perfect companion to your PCS wireless-enabled product. Our intuitive PROVolt® profile makes PRO Charging Systems products the most technologically advanced products on the market today. With the addition of PVL wireless interface, you can rest assured that the technological and unmatched performance advantages you enjoy with our products will continue to advance in the years to come. PCS products are proudly designed, developed, and made in the USA. Please visit our website for more information at www.dualpro.com.

bluejetty:00093088:ios.description:
Pawsome – Train Your Dog with Proven Tricks & Expert Tips
Why Choose Pawsome? Pawsome isn't just another dog training app-it's your trusted companion in building a strong bond with your dog. Our expertly designed programs are created by certified dog trainers and veterinarians, offering the perfect solution for any dog, regardless of age or breed. Linda's innovative tools and training techniques turn every moment into a learning opportunity for your pup.
Key Features: 
▶ Dog Training Tricks – Explore an extensive library of tricks and commands.
▶ Personalized Training Programs – Tailor a custom training plan for your dog based on age, behavior, and needs. 
▶ Behavior Solutions – Address common issues like barking, chewing, biting, and separation anxiety. 
▶ Daily Training Recommendations – Receive training tips that fit into your dog's routine. 
▶ Track Progress – Monitor your dog’s success with a training progress tracker. 
▶ Strengthen Your Bond – Deepen the connection between you and your dog through fun and engaging training exercises.
Perfect for Every Dog Owner: 
▶ New Dog Owners – Get a step-by-step guide for everything from puppy potty training to basic obedience. 
▶ Experienced Dog Parents – Teach advanced tricks like rollover, fetch the leash, and give a paw. 
▶ Behavior Training – Solve issues like excessive barking, leash pulling, and jumping on people.
What Makes Pawsome Special? Pawsome’s programs are designed by experts with your dog’s happiness and health in mind. Choose from 5 unique programs, including New Dog Puppy Program, Dog Parenting 101, Stop Dog Jumping, Leash Walking, and many more. These programs cover everything you need to raise a well-mannered, friendly, and happy dog.
Dog Training Programs Include:
▶ Reliable Recall
▶ Potty Training
▶ Sit, Down, Stay
▶ Walking on a Leash
▶ Fetch, High-Five, Spin
▶ Separation Anxiety Control
▶ Managing Barking and Chewing
Subscription Options: 
▶ 1-Month Subscription 
▶ 6-Month Subscription 
▶ 1-Year Subscription 
▶ Lifetime Access
Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and upon renewal. You can cancel at any time in iTunes settings.

Terms of Use: https://doguniversity.co/terms-%26-conditions

bluejetty:00089053:ios.summary:
inKin’s mission is to motivate and inspire users to start a journey towards a healthier life while socializing with friends, family, and, most certainly, co-workers through various wellness activities online.
Our health tech platform, avai
bluejetty:00089053:ios.description:
inKin’s mission is to motivate and inspire users to start a journey towards a healthier life while socializing with friends, family, and, most certainly, co-workers through various wellness activities online.
Our health tech platform, available both on the web and mobile phone, helps create a healthier life for you and your network by raising awareness about your health status.
inKin gathers data from most wearables and health apps available on the market. And we strive to launch more engaging features to help you and your teams build new habits, reduce stress, improve your overall wellbeing, and, ultimately, live a happier.
In your journey with inKin, we recommend using our top-rated features: Habit-Builder, Task-Based challenges, Group Challenges, and Team-Battles. 
1. Companies, Organizations, and Teams
Creating an efficient and engaging corporate wellness program can require time and effort. That's why we have built our platform to make launching corporate wellbeing initiatives easier and more fun.
inKin Corporate Wellness is a simple and efficient solution that helps run friendly fitness competitions among colleagues, helps your staff track their wellbeing, and promotes a healthy lifestyle in your company. It can also be used as a virtual team building and employee engagement tool.
NEWS FEED - exchange ideas or recipes and share any health-related information with your peers.
LEADERBOARD contains fun and colorful widgets with your team's activity during a certain period.
STATS - your team's overall progress over the desired period or even two periods.
CHALLENGES & COMPETITIONS: create and join various public and private contests.
Challenge – a participant is required to reach either a daily or total goal during a certain period. A participant completes the challenge once he or she meets the requirements. This mode is available for one of these metrics: steps, distance, calories burned, activity time, and sleep.
Competition – the participant who reaches the highest metric (steps, calories burned, distance, activity time) wins the contest.
Team Battle – a competition between an unlimited number of teams. The mode is available for steps, distance, calories burned, activity time.
Group Challenge - allows all participants to reach one goal together. This mode is available for one of these metrics: steps, distance, calories burned, activity time
Task-Based Challenge - allows tracking up to 15 metrics and tasks simultaneously.
DATA EXPORT - export your team's overall progress and contests' results data in CSV files.
2. Individuals
SUPPORTED DEVICES & APPS: Apple (HealthKit app), Fitbit, Garmin, Polar, Samsung, Withings, iHealth, Google Fit, Misfit
YOUR HEALTH AND FITNESS STATS: collect your health and fitness data from fitness devices and apps or log it manually. You can connect as many devices as you like, and choose which activity trackers show which metrics on your metric page. View your customized charts, graphs and widgets to help you monitor your progress towards healthier you.
HABIT BUILDER
A simple and efficient tool to develop good habits and quit the bad ones.
GOALS: we support 20 fitness and health parameters. Set goals to help you stay focused on your progress.
DUELS - 24-hour head-to-head step challenges with other community members.
GET SOCIAL
Support your friends on their fitness journey with likes and comments.
Find new fitness buddies in your local community and across the world.
PRIVACY & SHARING: it is entirely up to you who you want to share your fitness and health data with – our customized settings allow you to share different metrics with certain friends and family.

bluejetty:00015219:ios.description:
Welcome to FahrAPP, your multi-award-winning "best driving school learning app" (1).
IMPORTANT: To use FahrAPP, you need a valid access code, which you can only obtain nationwide at driving schools. Nowhere else.
To update to the latest version, you may need to uninstall your current FahrAPP and then download the FahrAPP again.
---
Do you want to study for the theoretical driving license exam and have received access to the FahrAPP from your driving school? Then you are in the right place!
KICKSTART!
Download the app for free, register with the registration and driving school code, and get started.
The learning progress is always synchronized – whether you last studied on a PC, tablet, or smartphone.
GUARANTEE!
With FahrAPP, you are guaranteed to learn all the current questions from the official question catalog! In all classes and all official languages, including Arabic, of course. Wendel-Verlag is an official licensing partner of TÜV | DEKRA arge tp 21. Rely on our over 60 years of experience and go perfectly prepared for the theory exam!
CONTENT!
Let Clevertraining quickly lead you to success by learning the easy questions first and then gradually increasing your difficulty level. Many more special trainings and, of course, exam simulations like at TÜV and DEKRA await you. So, nothing will surprise you in the exam!
EVERYTHING INCLUDED:
- All classes: B + A, A2, A1, AM + L, T + C, CE, C1 + D, D1 + Moped
- All languages: German, Turkish, English, Russian, Arabic, Romanian, Polish, Croatian, Portuguese, French, Greek, Spanish, Italian
- Learning tips for each question and in all languages
- Speech output of all questions in all languages (except Croatian)
- Numerous image and film variants for all official parent questions
- Easy learning, even without an internet connection
* Some features only with a premium account:
Did you receive a learning set? Then the eBook and film aids are included! (If not, ask your driving school about the premium account.)
Attention!
Email address and internet connection required (flat rate recommended, otherwise additional costs may arise for data transmission). You can download films and images at home in Wi-Fi and save a lot of data volume on the go – moreover, the FahrAPP has an offline mode, with which you can continue learning even without the internet! The functionality may vary depending on the product, class, or foreign language. Technical changes and errors reserved. The illustrations correspond to those of the premium version in the FahrAPP set XXL.
We wish you a lot of fun training and success in the exam!
Do you have any questions? Tap on the support link!
---
(1) The FahrAPP was awarded "Best Driving School Learning App" in 2022, 2023 and 2024 by DEUTSCHLAND TEST in a large customer survey on further education and e-learning offerings. In addition, FahrAPP took first place in customer service among all driving license e-learnings in the German Education Award 2022 and 2023/2024, awarded by DISQ and n-tv, and won the German Service Award 2023.

bluejetty:00180721:ios.summary:
Com o Binamik Ally, você tem acesso a:
Acompanhamento do roteiro de sua viagem

bluejetty:00180721:ios.description:
Com o Binamik Ally, você tem acesso a:
Acompanhamento do roteiro de sua viagem
Quer ter mais controle e autonomia sobre o roteiro da sua viagem? No app, todas as reservas de atividades são listadas para que você possa acessar as informações dos passeios comprados quando quiser. Com isso, é possível visualizar informações importantes sobre o que levar para os passeios, como chegar até o destino, tempo de duração de cada atividade, infraestrutura do local e muito mais.
Ingresso digitais 
Uma alternativa mais prática e sustentável. Com o aplicativo, os ingressos digitais podem ser lidos pelo leitor de QR Code nos passeios. A ferramenta minimiza o impacto ambiental já que os ingressos não são mais impressos e traz mais segurança sanitária.
Nomear ingressos
Todos os integrantes do roteiro têm acesso. O responsável pela reserva pode nomear os seus ingressos e com isso, os viajantes nomeados também poderão acessar os seus ingressos através do aplicativo. 
Rotas para atrativos
Dentro do aplicativo, você também terá acesso às rotas para os passeios do seu roteiro, facilitando a sua locomoção em destinos desconhecidos.
Check-in online
Você pode realizar o check-in antes da sua viagem para confirmar os seus dados pessoais, aceitar os termos e se informar sobre restrições e informações importantes para a realização dos passeios. 
Proteção dos seus dados e da sua privacidade
Segurança garantida. O aplicativo Binamik Ally foi desenvolvido dentro das normas estabelecidas pela LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados).
Notificações em tempo real
As notificações em tempo real servem para informar sobre as suas atividades. Em caso de chuva, por exemplo, muitos passeios são cancelados e outros podem seguir operando normalmente. Por isso, as notificações do Binamik Ally são importantes aliadas na experiência de viagem.
Mapa interativo
O mapa interativo mostra a localização de outras atividades, passeios, restaurantes, comércio e etc. Com ele, você pode encontrar outras atividades para adicionar ao seu roteiro. Além de conseguir filtrar por categoria de serviço, você tem acesso também às avaliações de outros viajantes e informações pertinentes para a compra de ingressos.
Compra de passeios
Ao selecionar um serviço no mapa interativo, você poderá acessar a tela de informações do serviço e realizar a compra dele através do aplicativo.

bluejetty:00014190:ios.description:
Borrow audiobooks, eBooks, movies, TV episodes, comics, and music, all in one app. No subscription. No ads. Just click borrow and press play.
Hoopla works with your local public library to bring millions of titles to your phone, tablet, and TV. New titles are added every day, and many are ready to borrow the moment you find them. 
How it Works 
1. Find your library in the Hoopla app 
2. Sign in with your library card 
3. Start borrowing and enjoy 
Audiobooks and eBooks 
- Bestsellers, new releases, indie authors, and classics 
- Romance, thrillers, fantasy, mystery, nonfiction, kids, teens, and more 
- Listen on your commute, at the gym, or while you wind down 
- Stream right away or download to enjoy later 
Movies and TV 
- Stream movies, TV shows, documentaries, and anime at home or on the go
- Watch on iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV 
- SeasonPass lets you borrow a full season of a show and watch at your own pace 
- Family movies and kids' shows for your next movie night 
Comics, Graphic Novels, and Manga 
- Superheroes, manga, graphic memoirs, and kids' comics 
- ActionView guides you panel by panel so you can take in every detail of the art 
Music 
- Borrow full albums from today's chart-toppers and all-time favorites 
- Shuffle music across your borrowed albums to build your own unique playlist 
Made for how you read, listen, and watch 
- Apple CarPlay for audiobooks and music on the road 
- Offline downloads, so you can enjoy borrowed titles without using data 
- Sleep timer for bedtime listening 
- Dark mode for comfortable late-night reading 
- Kids Mode for family-friendly browsing

bluejetty:00138789:ios.description:
Mods for Block Games - Toolbox – this app will open up a world of incredible add-ons for your favorite block games! Discover endless possibilities and make your gameplay even more exciting and diverse!
Transform your game with our add-ons and mods app. Dive into a vast library of mods, easily browse and install them in just a few clicks. Create your own unique add-ons by combining different elements.
Drag the necessary elements to the top of the screen. If you want to create a new add-on, simply drag one element onto another. The result is a new add-on that can be further transformed by combining it with other elements.
Each new combination of elements is a completely new add-on. You can sort the elements by date/time or alphabetically.
The most amazing thing is that this game has no end. You can keep creating new add-ons, as well as revisit previously created ones and combine them with other elements to get entirely new results.
Key Features
• Expansive Add-ons Library: Explore an ever-growing collection of mods, including popular and exclusive add-ons. 
• Effortless Installation: Easily add mods to your game with our intuitive installation process. 
• Custom Add-on Packs: Create and share your own custom mod packs tailored to your preferences.
Enhance Your Gameplay
• New Biomes: Explore exciting new biomes with unique landscapes, vegetation, and creatures. 
• Custom Mobs: Encounter a variety of custom mobs, from friendly companions to dangerous foes. 
• Advanced Tools and Items: Craft powerful tools, weapons, and armor to enhance your gameplay. 
• Task Automation: Automate repetitive tasks and simplify your game with helpful add-ons. 
• Visual Enhancements: Transform the look of your world with stunning shaders, textures, and models.
Unlock the True Potential of Your Game 
• Personalize Your Game: Customize the gameplay to your liking, creating a world that reflects your imagination. 
• Explore New Mechanics: Expand the boundaries of the game with innovative mods that introduce new challenges, mechanics, and storylines. 
• Share Your Creations: Show off your creations to the world and inspire other players. 
• Stay Updated: Get regular updates to our add-ons library, ensuring access to the latest and greatest add-ons.
Disclaimer: This is an unofficial app for block games. It is not affiliated with Mojang AB or any other official developers. All mentioned brands and assets are the property of their respective owners. We do not claim any intellectual property rights associated with these brands.

- You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal after purchase in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00068138:ios.description:
English Simultane Books app brings you ability to read and listen simple English language books to improve your listening and reading skills. 
It will also help you to improve your skills for speaking and writing as you need to listen before you speak and read before you write in a new language. This app contains 4 simple books selected carefully to help you practice English language. Audio comes with the books are all real human voices. There is no human voice for real time listening. 
Reading while listening to the audio at the same time helps you to concentrate. This is perfect for people who are easily distracted. Another advantage is that you don’t spend time trying to understand every single word. You just continue at the speed of the narrator. Remember that you can always pause or rewind the audio, although it doesn’t take long to become accustomed to continuous speech. This method is a great opportunity to focus on fluency, as well as listening to stress and intonation in sentences.
Listening to the audio first helps you to gain understanding without seeing the written word. As listening is often more difficult than reading, this method is good to help you train your ear and test your understanding. Reading after you’ve listened to the audio allows you to see how much you understood from the listening, and to practice mimicking what you’ve heard. Remember that you should read aloud to improve your pronunciation.
We believe this app will help you improve your English language skills.

Fantasy Football - Reimagined
In Monster League, every matchup is more than a game—it’s a battle. Draft your squad, pick your opponents, and “capture” players by outscoring them in head-to-head matchups. Build your roster week after week until you’ve assembled an unstoppable team of football Monsters.

- Elite 3 Bosses – Endgame playoff challenge! Defeat boss-level rosters to prove you’re the ultimate champion.
- Dynamic Weekly Strategy – Every game matters. Optimize matchups, experiment with types, and keep your squad evolving.
Why Monster League?
Unlike traditional fantasy football, Monster League isn’t about managing trades or waiver wires. It’s about battling, capturing, and building your dream roster. Whether you’re a die-hard Football fan or love strategy games, this is fantasy football reimagined.
Download now and begin your quest for fantasy football glory!

bluejetty:00013763:ios.description:

• Uvid u račune i kartice
• Sve vrste plaćanja
• Novi proizvodi i usluge
• Lociranje najbližih bankomata i ekspozitura.

• “Skeniraj i plati” – više ne morate da unosite podatke sa uplatnice
Plaćanja IPS QR kodom na prodajnim mestima
Logovanje putem otiska prsta – ne morate da unosite PIN
mToken za prijavu na eBanking - odlična zamena za hardverski token
mBiznis i mToken možete dobiti u svim ekspoziturama UniCredit Banke širom Srbije.
-------------------------------------------------
UniCredit mBiznis saves you time and money. Application is user friendly, always available and payment fees are significantly lower than in branches.

• Accounts and cards overview
• All types of payment
• New products and services
• ATMs and branches locations
• Additional mBiznis features:
• Multiple companies overview in one app
• “Scan and pay” – you no longer have to type the data in the payment invoice
• IPS QR code for point of sale payment
• Fingerprint authentication – no need to enter the PIN to log in
• mToken for eBanking authentication – great replacement for hardware token
You can get mBiznis and mToken at all UniCredit Bank branches throughout Serbia.

bluejetty:00032626:ios.description:
Explore realistic airplanes in the most electrifying airborne flight simulator - Airplane Pro: Flight Simulator! 
Jump into the pilot seat to command your own fleet of aircrafts and experience the highs of flying in one of the most immersive flying simulators!
Take flight in real aeroplanes through an ever-expansive open-world flight simulator. Explore the skies above realistic scenery and airports in high fidelity with satellite map imagery. Witness towering skyscrapers, runways, air traffic, weather conditions, and true volumetric clouds to bring you a new level of immersion for the ultimate flight simulation.
Perform a wide variety of over 27 free missions to become a professional airplane pilot or explore free mode where you can explore the world!
Pilot are you ready for your first mission!
- Pass pilot school to get your flight license!
- Airplane emergency landings to put you to the test in real piloting simulations!
- Load up with passengers and safely transport them to their destinations
- Fly high class VIPs and the presidential private jet or lead the Airforce jet planes to escort them safely!
- Rescue victims after plane accidents, can you save the day?
- Rough situational landings, can you land on an aircraft carrier or safely crash land into water?
- Test your skills in checkpoint challenges
- Keep control of your aircraft during extreme weather situations or engine malfunctions
- Take small advertising jobs in your small planes showing banners in the sky
Airplanes aren't the only vehicles we have to offer!
Get behind the wheel of some fast cars if you prefer scenic route, drifting throughout the huge open world landscape!
If you're preparing for the skies then the realistic dynamic weather with day and night cycles, turbulence and disastrous winds might catch your off guard if you're not careful!
Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of flight simulation! Experience the thrills of piloting an aircraft through extreme thunderstorms or snowstorms.
- Explosive action packed plane crashes with realistic airplane physics
- Fully control your plane from the cockpit with radio, lights and passenger interaction controls
- Huge range of aircraft types from commercial airliners to jets to small biplanes
- Enter any vehicle you see! Airplanes, cars & boats the world is yours to explore
Your adventure awaits as the next pro pilot in Airplane Pro: Flight Simulator!
Download now to join us in the skies and elevate your piloting adventures!

Simply choose a channel, press and hold the Push-to-Talk (PTT) button, and start talking. Ask your friends to join the sam
bluejetty:00063830:ios.description:
Turn your phone into a real Walkie Talkie with crystal-clear voice communication, and authentic radio sound effects!
Simply choose a channel, press and hold the Push-to-Talk (PTT) button, and start talking. Ask your friends to join the same channel and enjoy instant communication just like using a real two-way radio.
### Key Features
• High-quality Push-to-Talk (PTT) voice communication
• Live video communication
• Public channels for talking with people around the world
• Private channels for communicating with friends
• Private network mode using a custom 20-character access code
• Channel scanner to discover active conversations
• One-to-one and group text messaging
• Meet and chat with new people worldwide
• Authentic Walkie Talkie sound effects
• No account required — no username, no password, no registration
### Ready in Seconds
One of the best things about this app is how simple it is to use.
No account.
No registration.
No username.
No password.
Just open the app, choose a channel, press the PTT button, and start talking.
### Private Communication
Create your own private network by defining a unique 20-character access code and sharing it only with the people you choose. Only users with the same code can communicate within that private network.
Subscribers can also invite selected users into private channels for more controlled conversations.
### Subscription Benefits
Upgrade to unlock premium features, including:
• Ad-free experience
• Hide your user ID for additional privacy
• Access to private channels
• Additional premium features
Available subscription plans:
**Monthly**
* Full access to all premium features for one month.
* Automatically renews each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
**6-Month Plan**
* Save compared to paying monthly.
* Automatically renews every six months unless canceled at least 24 hours before renewal.
**Yearly Plan**
* Our best value.
* Enjoy all premium features for 12 months at a discounted annual price.
* Automatically renews each year unless canceled at least 24 hours before renewal.
### Subscription Information
• Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
• Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Apple ID Account Settings.
### Important Notice
This app provides public voice and text communication. Conversations on public channels can be heard by anyone using the same channel. Do not share sensitive or confidential information while using public channels. Users are responsible for the content of their communications.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
http://appsdash.com/walkie-talkie-privacy-policy

Do you like cats? Fluffy, adorable, and cuddly kitties! 
meow meow~ Don't miss out on the "Lovely Cat: Dream Paradise", a magical world full of cute little cats everywhere!
Here, a large group of lovely kittens is waiting for you to take care of and dress up. Countless fun furniture items are waiting for you to unlock and interact with. There are also many NPC cats waiting for you to chat with! Join us and explore this fantastical world!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
【Countless adorable kittens】
In this world, cats are not just pets but also your cute furry friends! Each cat has its own mood value and requires you to feed, bathe, and cuddle with them regularly. Believe that you can take care of each adorable kitty and explore this world happily with them!
What? You want even more cats! Let me tell you a secret. Besides surprise eggs, you can also find a mysterious synthesis machine to create even cuter and more unique cats! Go take a look and fill this world with kittens!
【Super Cat Makeover】
Just like little girls, kittens also love dressing up! Find the big wardrobe, and you can dress up your furry babies however you like! 
Various styles of clothes, cute accessories, exquisite shoes, and all kinds of handheld items are available, including wings! Unleash your imagination and create the cutest and most fashionable looks for your pets!
【A vast and mysterious world】
Don't think that there's only one small room here! In the beautiful dreamland, there's also a market, a hotel, an entertainment area, and a large outdoor space! What? Still not satisfied? Then hop on the magical bus and go to other places! Visit cozy wooden cabins or magical academies filled with a sense of magic!
This huge and mysterious world is waiting for you to explore with your cats!
【Fun mini-games】
In addition to all of this, there are many fun games waiting for you in this exciting world! From thrilling parkour challenges to memory-testing card flipping and relaxing elimination games, you can play with your little cats and earn rich rewards!
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In conclusion, this is an adorable cute cat games designed specifically for girls who love pets and adore cats. It's not just a dress up games; it's a Kitty game! You will definitely fall in love with this mysterious magical world!
Download "Lovely Cat: Dream Paradise" now and create your exclusive pet story with the cats!

bluejetty:00160309:android.description:

CAREFULLY CRAFTED INVESTMENT APPROACHES
- IntelliInvest offers curated investing strategies that span a wide range of risk-investment profiles. 
- These strategies are optimized through back testing and tailored to different investment goals. 
- You can pick the one that suits your preferences - risk, time horizon, and return.
ANALYTICS
- Our team of experts conducts comprehensive research on various aspects of each stock, such as technical indicators, fundamental factors, industry trends, market dynamics, investor sentiments, and more.
- We present a unique summary called - IntelliView for every stock that helps you make informed investment decisions.
PORTFOLIO CONSOLIDATION AND RECOMMENDATION
We provide seamless broker integration and consolidate all your holdings to give you a view of our entire portfolio. Buy or sell directly from IntelliInvest - Stock Analysis App.
Access a broad range of investment products to achieve your personalized goals, all in one place:
INDUSTRY ANALYSIS
We examine the patterns of economic fluctuations and industry performance to identify which sectors offer attractive investment opportunities and which ones pose high risks.
FUNDAMENTAL ANALYSIS
Looking into various fundamental parameters and financial ratios over time as well as comparing within an industry to be able to segregate good, bad, and average stocks.
TECHNICAL INDICATORS
Our strategy uses various technical indicators to identify stocks that have strong momentum or trends or are in oversold or overbought conditions. It helps investors to enter and exit the trades at optimal times and maximize their returns.
STRATEGY CREATION : Providing a simple yet powerful interface to all Investors.
- Simplifying Investment Strategy
- Build Strategy
- Smart Capital Deployment
- Backtest Strategy
- Deploy Strategy
CORE FEATURES: One platform, multiple stock analyses to meet your investment goals!
INTELLIPREMIUM
Leveraging the insights obtained from the comprehensive analysis, we can generate daily recommendations aimed at pinpointing promising investment prospects and optimizing the timing of our exits.
INTELLIBUBBLE
A distinctive method for assessing market dynamics involves blending technical, fundamental, and industry analyses to provide a comprehensive market indicator, enhancing our investment planning capabilities.
Analyze Anywhere. Anytime.
Discover a new stock market analysis experience with the IntelliInvest app.

bluejetty:00126967:ios.name: The Wadsworth-Longfellow House
bluejetty:00126967:ios.summary: Founded in 1822, the Maine Historical Society is the third-oldest state historical society in the United States. Located in downtown Portland, much of our one-acre campus including the Maine History Society Museum and Store and the Brown Re
bluejetty:00126967:ios.description:
Founded in 1822, the Maine Historical Society is the third-oldest state historical society in the United States. Located in downtown Portland, much of our one-acre campus including the Maine History Society Museum and Store and the Brown Research Library is open year-round. Our Wadsworth-Longfellow House, the childhood home of famed poet Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, and Longfellow Garden are open May through October. The Maine Historical Society strives to serve the entire state through its programs and the digital museum, the Maine Memory Network.
Enhance your visit to the historic Wadsworth-Longfellow House by downloading our tour app on your smart device. The app tour includes descriptions and brief histories of each room in the house, as well as quotes from family members and select Longfellow poems. You can also view the house floor plan and read the transcript of the audio tour. To learn more about Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, and view a list of all of his published work, visit www.hwlongfellow.org.

bluejetty:00016331:ios.name: Earworm
bluejetty:00016331:ios.summary:
Earworm is a music prediction effect for professional performers.
Here's what happens:
- You ask a friend to take out their phone, mute the volume and open YouTube.
- You then take your friend's phone and play a song, giving the phone back
bluejetty:00016331:ios.description:
Earworm is a music prediction effect for professional performers.
Here's what happens:
- You ask a friend to take out their phone, mute the volume and open YouTube.
- You then take your friend's phone and play a song, giving the phone back with its screen facing downwards.
- Now you apparently mentally transmit the thought-of song to your friend.
- Your friend names *any* song, turns the volume up on their phone and looks at the screen to hear and see that your prediction was correct... that exact song is playing on their phone!
The entire effect happens on their phone.
Earworm is built for real-world performance. It gives you multiple advanced input methods, flexible reveal options, and powerful integrations so you can adapt the routine to your style, language, and audience.
Everything can be inspected afterwards, with nothing suspicious to find.
Features include:
- Predict songs, music videos, trailers, or almost any searchable video
- Multiple input methods, including voice and covert browser input
- Performable in multiple languages
- No accomplice required
- No memory work
- Integrations with many third-party magic apps
- Notification support for additional confirmation
And with Earworm Pro:
- Supports Bluetooth peek devices, including the PeekSmith and Lumen Duo as part of Earworm Pro
- Never touch their phone with Earworm Remote
- Enhanced input methods
Earworm Pro is an optional purchase that brings even more advanced performance tools, including:
Enhanced Voice input
- Automatically detect songs mentioned in conversation.
- Uses your own funded AI account and API key for best-in-class recognition.
- Black mode offers a covert input with vibration cues.
Earworm Remote v2
- Perform Earworm without touching the spectator's phone.
- A new, even more natural way to share your video link.
- Auto Redirect and WikiTest integration for pairing and redirecting.
Send To Earworm
- Allow supported third-party apps to submit to Earworm, letting you reveal a freely chosen song via their input methods.
Peek Device Support
- New support for compatible peek devices.
- Live Peek support for the Notes input (to make it seem that you really did predict the chosen song!)
- Native PeekSmith and Lumen Duo support is built into Earworm Pro
Earworm is designed for performers who want a practical, modern, impossible-looking prediction effect.
Video and audio broadcasting of any description (including TV, radio and Internet) of this effect is prohibited without the written consent of its creator.

Embarking on a health journey or striving to hit that next fitness milestone? Dive into Calorys - where every calorie counts, every step matters, and every goal is within reach. Ever wondered about the nutritional breakdown of that homemade lasagna or that exotic dish from your favorite restaurant? With our expansive food database, you're never left guessing. Snap a pic or scan a barcode, and voila - detailed nutritional insights at your fingertips! From carbs and proteins to those sneaky sugars, we've got you covered.
-Fitness - More Than Just Numbers
Whether it's that morning jog, an intense HIIT session, or a calming yoga routine, log it all in seconds. Sync with popular fitness apps and wearables, ensuring every drop of sweat is accounted for. After all, every step is a step closer to your goals.
- Plan, Eat, Repeat!
Dieting doesn't mean starving. With Calorys, it's about informed choices. Our customized diet plans - be it Keto, Mediterranean, or Intermittent Fasting - are tailored to your preferences. Plan your meals, know their calorie count, and relish them guilt-free.
- Hydration - The Unsung Hero
Water is vital, and with our intuitive water tracker, you'll never forget to hydrate. Set reminders, log your intake, and watch those energy levels soar.
-Deep Dive into Your Progress
Our detailed reports are more than just numbers. They're stories of perseverance, dedication, and progress. Track your weight, set milestones, and revel in the joy of watching yourself inch closer to them every day.
-Stay on Track

bluejetty:00027026:ios.name: Mirror Vision: Golf Coaching
bluejetty:00027026:ios.summary: You know what you are supposed to change. Your coach told you. But the only way to check is to film a swing, walk over, watch it back, walk back to the ball, and by then the feel is gone. Film, review, fix is a slow loop, and most of the ti
bluejetty:00027026:ios.description:
You know what you are supposed to change. Your coach told you. But the only way to check is to film a swing, walk over, watch it back, walk back to the ball, and by then the feel is gone. Film, review, fix is a slow loop, and most of the time the swing never actually changes.
Mirror Vision is a digital mirror for your golf swing. Your iPhone films you. Your iPad sits on the ground beside the ball and shows you the swing live, as you make it. You look down where a golfer looks anyway and watch your own backswing happen. What you feel and what is real, connected in the same moment.
WHY A MIRROR AT YOUR FEET BEATS A MIRROR ON THE WALL
Turn your head to check a wall mirror and you are no longer in golf posture. You open up ranges of motion you do not have in a real swing, so you train the wrong thing. With the iPad at your feet you stay in posture, eyes down, and still see the movement. The first session usually brings an aha moment: the change you thought was huge was almost nothing, or went the other way.
Keep practising like this and something else happens. You start to know how you are moving without the screen. That awareness is what lets you change your swing on the course, when there is no video.
THREE WAYS TO SET UP
Down the line. iPhone behind the ball on the target line, iPad just in front of the ball, below your feet. The classic view, live.
Face on. iPhone facing you, iPad at your feet. Watch your head, hips and arms as they move.
From behind. iPhone facing your back. A live view of your swing from behind that no mirror can give you.
THE PRACTICE LOOP
Hit the shot. Look down. The replay is already playing.
Auto-detect watches for your swing and records only that, so no dead time fills your library. The iPad replays the shot straight away, in slow motion if you want it. Show your palm to the camera to keep the clip, or do nothing and it is gone. Hit the next ball. Rep after rep, the feedback arrives while the feel is still in your hands.
THE TOOLS
A low latency live view, plus recording at up to 240 fps for slow motion, frame-by-frame stepping and a precise scrubber.
Draw lines, boxes, arrows, circles and angles over the video from either device. Draw them on the live view and they stay there while you swing into them.
Jump straight to address, top, impact or finish in any saved swing.
Hand gestures. Raise a palm to keep the clip you just watched, or let it go, without walking to either device.
Export any clip with your lines on it, or send it to your coach.
A swing library, not a camera roll: search, favourites, colour tags and player names.
Cloud library, so every swing is on every device.
No Wi-Fi or mobile data needed. The two devices connect directly, at the range, in the backyard or in a bay.
FOR COACHES
Draw the box the student needs to move into and let them find it themselves. Nobody is holding them in position, so they learn what it feels like, with the reference right there on the screen. They take the app home and keep working on the right thing until the next lesson.
WHAT YOU NEED
Two Apple devices. iPhone as the camera and iPad as the viewer is the best setup. An Apple Silicon Mac can be the viewer too. iOS 16.6 or later.
FREE AND PRO
Free to download, with one 10-minute mirroring session a day and recording, auto-detect, slow motion, drawing and export all included. Changing a swing takes more than 10 minutes a day. Mirror Vision Pro removes the limit and adds automatic replay on the paired device and the cloud library. Monthly or yearly.
Mirror Vision Pro subscription: payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.mirrorvisiongolf.com/privacy-policy
Terms: https://www.mirrorvisiongolf.com/terms-and-condition

The first session usually brings an aha moment: the change you thought was huge was almost nothing, or went the other way.

Keep practising like this and something else happens. You start to know how you are moving without the screen. That awareness is what lets you change your swing on the course, when there is no video.

THREE WAYS TO SET UP
Down the line. iPhone behind the ball on the target line, iPad just in front of the ball, below your feet. The classic view, live.
Face on. iPhone facing you, iPad at your feet. Watch your head, hips and arms as they move.
From behind. iPhone facing your back. A live view of your swing from behind that no mirror can give you.

THE PRACTICE LOOP
Hit the shot. Look down. The replay is already playing.
Auto-detect watches for your swing and records only that, so no dead time fills your library. The iPad replays the shot straight away, in slow motion if you want it. Show your palm to the camera to keep the clip, or do nothing and it is gone. Hit the next ball. Rep after rep, the feedback arrives while the feel is still in your hands.

THE TOOLS
A low latency live view, plus recording at up to 240 fps for slow motion, frame-by-frame stepping and a precise scrubber.
Draw lines, boxes, arrows, circles and angles over the video from either device. Draw them on the live view and they stay there while you swing into them.
Jump straight to address, top, impact or finish in any saved swing.
Hand gestures. Raise a palm to keep the clip you just watched, or let it go, without walking to either device.
Export any clip with your lines on it, or send it to your coach.
A swing library, not a camera roll: search, favourites, colour tags and player names.
Cloud library, so every swing is on every device.
No Wi-Fi or mobile data needed. The two devices connect directly, at the range, in the backyard or in a bay.

FOR COACHES
Draw the box the student needs to move into and let them find it themselves. Nobody is holding them in position, so they learn what it feels like, with the reference right there on the screen. They take the app home and keep working on the right thing until the next lesson.

WHAT YOU NEED
Two Apple devices. iPhone as the camera and iPad as the viewer is the best setup. An Apple Silicon Mac can be the viewer too. iOS 16.6 or later.

FREE AND PRO
Free to download, with one 10-minute mirroring session a day and recording, auto-detect, slow motion, drawing and export all included. Changing a swing takes more than 10 minutes a day. Mirror Vision Pro removes the limit and adds automatic replay on the paired device and the cloud library. Monthly or yearly.

Mirror Vision Pro subscription: payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00109846:android.description:
DIGITAL CASH, ALWAYS WITH YOU
You didn’t bring any cash with you? Don’t worry. Siirto replaces cash in everyday small payment needs, and it’s always with you in your cell phone. An easy and hassle-free way to split costs with a friend, send allowance to your child, pay at a flea market – and more.
MADE IN FINLAND – SAFE AND SECURE
Siirto is a Finnish mobile payment application where all users are strongly identified. You can use the application in English, Finnish or Swedish. Children under the age of 15 can use the application with digitally signed parental approval.
ALMOST A MILLION USERS
All you need to transfer money is the recipient’s mobile number. Enter the amount and swipe, and the money will be immediately transferred from your bank account to the other users bank account.
SHARE COSTS WITH FRIENDS
Did you buy a joint gift or pay a restaurant bill? Or maybe you bought movie tickets for your friend? Siirto makes it easy for you to request money from another Siirto user, and it’s easy to keep track of open requests.
EASY TO FOLLOW TRANSACTIONS
Payment data is saved like chat messages into conversations. It’s very easy to see your payment history between you and a friend.
HANDY QR CODE
Siirto payments are also easy to make using QR codes. Just read the merchant's QR code, confirm the payment, and you’re done! Handy in situations where you do not know the recipient, such as at a flea market or a coffee stand.
Read more: www.nordea.fi/siirto

bluejetty:00061747:ios.summary:
Teleprompter for Video makes it easy to create professional-looking videos on your iPhone or iPad. Simply read from the prompter while recording video. 
It's perfect for anyone wanting to record a vlog, practise a speech or give a business
bluejetty:00061747:ios.description:
Teleprompter for Video makes it easy to create professional-looking videos on your iPhone or iPad. Simply read from the prompter while recording video. 
It's perfect for anyone wanting to record a vlog, practise a speech or give a business communication. The app helps actors film self-tape casting auditions, religious leaders give sermons, job seekers create video resumes and much more. 
Used by over 1 million people worldwide!
Here's how it works...
You read from a script while filming yourself in high definition. The prompter script (or autocue) scrolls next to the camera lens, helping you make eye contact with your audience. 
They won't know you're reading from a script!
After recording, you can edit your video - add your logo, resize for social media, replace background using a green screen, add text and automatically caption the video using the timings from your recording (or export a .srt file for uploading captions on social media). You can even add a background music track using our royalty-free audio.
The 'floating' mode allows you to overlay the script on top of other apps, such as the native camera app. It's perfect for live streaming on social media.
Here's a summary of all the wonderful features:
RECORD PRO VIDEOS WITHOUT EXPENSIVE EQUIPMENT
* Record videos using the front and rear-facing cameras.
* Record your video in landscape or portrait.
* Choose your camera resolution (720p, 1080p, 4K) and frame rate (24, 25 PAL, 30, 60) based on what your device supports.
* Add beautiful filters to your videos in real-time including Portrait mode (newer devices only).
* Record sound using in-built and external microphones.

bluejetty:00125988:ios.summary:
OVERVIEW :
Mobile Midwife EHR is the premier electronic charting and patient health records software for the iPad, iPhone and Mac. A client portal is available on all devices. Clients can login and create their record, sign documents and
bluejetty:00125988:ios.description:
OVERVIEW :
Mobile Midwife EHR is the premier electronic charting and patient health records software for the iPad, iPhone and Mac. A client portal is available on all devices. Clients can login and create their record, sign documents and direct message their provider. Then the Midwife uses the iPad/iPhone/Mac to record prenatal visits, Labor flow, Postpartum visits and create invoices, tasks, reminders and reports. IT'S TIME TO GO PAPERLESS!!!
Best of all, Mobile Midwife EHR does not need to be connected to the internet to work like other web-based EHR solutions do. So if you need to attend a birth at a home, NO WORRIES! If there is no internet connection the app will work just the same. Later, once an internet connection is detected all of your data will backup to the Mobile Midwife servers and other users in your practice with different iPads will automatically get updated with the new data you entered!
TOP FEATURES :
• Record all patient information including health history, prior pregnancies, financial information and so much more.
• Record client prenatal visits, labs, physical exams, vitals, etc.
• Record mom's labor flow with vitals and the various stages of labor.
• Record new born details, APGAR scores, physical exam, complications
• Record immediate postpartum details for baby and mom with information such as vitals and events such as the stages of postpartum labor, episiotomy, complications, etc.
• Record mother and infant postpartum visits by inputing their vitals, feeding/sleeping habits, intake, and emotional health, etc.
• Take primary care clients, both male, female, adults and newborns.
• Reminder system & Track customer self-pay and insurance billing
• Print, Email or export any client data as a PDF
• Import PDFs and create a document template by dropping text boxes, check boxes and signature boxes wherever needed on the PDF to make it fully interactive. Once you create your document templates your new clients will be guided to sign all of the documents as part of their sign up process after they complete their health history information using only their finger or a stylus.
• Messaging feature records all emails between patient and care provider under client record. Messages can also be sent to other users in your practice or even anyone outside of your practice.
• Use new Chat feature to instant message your clients. Message will not wake you at night unless client indicates it's urgent.
• Use new sign off feature to lock records.
• New Audit features shows every single field change, who did it and from what device since the creation of any record. 
• New insurance claims feature generates CMS 1500 and UB-04 forms so you can bill insurance directly
• Now submit claims electronically! No need to double enter client information and billing codes into separate clearinghouse software.
• Generate reports on your practice statistics, including number of clients delivered, outcomes and transfer rate.
• Export your data as an Excel spreadsheet so you can utilize it for your own purposes such as reporting to the state, creating your own statistical analysis or tracking any other metric such as average visit duration.
• We are now integrated with lab companies such as Quest, Labcorp, Interpath, RML and many others. Lab results flow seamlessly into your client records saving you time and ensuring that no lab gets forgotten. With Labcorp and Quest you can also place orders in Mobile Midwife.
• Use our new Calendar feature to schedule appointments. Appointment reminders will go to your clients by email and text.
• Accept payments and setup payment plans with your clients
• Use Siri to chart for you during birth
• New Artificial Intelligence features to record visit audio and generate charting for you!

bluejetty:00130392:ios.description:
EatDot is an AI-powered calorie counter designed to make weight loss and healthy eating easier.
Track calories and macros, log meals from a photo or text, understand your eating habits, and get personalized guidance from your AI Coach—all in one app.
Whether you want to lose weight, maintain your progress, or simply understand what you eat, EatDot helps you stay on track without making nutrition complicated.
AI CALORIE COUNTER
Log your meals in seconds.
EatDot tracks calories, protein, carbs, and fat and shows how each meal fits into your daily goals.
Simply take a photo of your food or describe what you ate, and AI helps estimate the nutrition for you.
Spend less time logging and more time focusing on your progress.
PHOTO FOOD SCANNER
See what’s in your meal with a photo.
EatDot can analyze food from an image and help you quickly estimate calories and macronutrients.
Perfect for meals that are difficult or time-consuming to enter manually.
YOUR DAILY AI COACH
Go beyond simply counting calories.
EatDot AI Coach uses your progress and nutrition data to give you personalized insights, clear priorities, and practical next steps.
See how your day is going, understand what could be improved, and make better decisions without having to analyze everything yourself.
PERSONALIZED CALORIE & MACRO GOALS
Choose your goal:
• Lose weight
• Maintain weight
• Gain weight 
EatDot calculates personalized calorie and macronutrient targets based on your goals and lifestyle.
Follow your progress throughout the day and see exactly where you stand.
RECIPE GENIUS AI
Turn food ideas into personalized recipes.
• Create recipes based on your goals
• Turn meals into complete recipes
• Make recipes healthier or higher in protein
• Discover new meal ideas with AI 
EatDot helps make healthy eating easier without eating the same meals every day.
WEIGHT LOSS & NUTRITION TRACKING
Build a clearer picture of your progress.
Track your nutrition, weight, water, steps, and sleep while EatDot helps you understand how your habits change over time.
Charts and statistics make it easy to see your progress and stay consistent.
INTERMITTENT FASTING
Want to combine calorie tracking with fasting?
Use EatDot’s fasting tracker with popular schedules including:
• 13:11
• 16:8
• 18:6
• Custom fasting schedules 
Track your fasting and eating windows alongside your calorie and nutrition goals.
APPLE HEALTH
Connect EatDot with Apple Health to bring your health and activity information together.
Track steps, weight, sleep, and other useful health data alongside your nutrition progress.
EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
EatDot includes:
• AI calorie tracking from photos and text
• Photo food scanner
• Calories, protein, carbs, and fat tracking
• Personalized calorie and macro goals
• Daily AI Coach and personalized insights
• Weight loss progress tracking
• Recipe Genius AI
• Intermittent fasting tracker
• Water, weight, steps, and sleep tracking
• Charts and progress statistics
• Home Screen widgets
• Apple Health integration 
EatDot makes calorie tracking simpler.
Log your food, understand your nutrition, follow your progress, and get AI-powered guidance to help you reach your goals.
Start tracking with EatDot today.

- Vibrant Trading Community: Join a global network of investors. Share insights, discuss strategies, and stay ahead of the curve with real-time social wisdom.

- Unified Portfolio: Manage Saudi and U.S. investments within a single app. Switch between markets instantly with a simple tap.
- Instant Currency Exchange: Convert funds anytime, anywhere. Experience seamless cross-border investing with fast, transparent currency exchange.
- 3-Minute Account Opening: Your time is valuable. Our streamlined process gets you market-ready in just three minutes.
- Flexible Deposit Options: Deposit via Apple Pay or Mada, boosting your buying power instantly.
- Market Variety: Engage in various financial products, such as stocks, ETFs, REITs, Murabaha, Margin, Sukuk & Bonds, and Crypto ETFs.
- IPO Subscriptions: Gain early access to the most anticipated listings and secure your position in ground-floor opportunities.
- Shariah-Compliant Investing: Trade with peace of mind. Easily identify stocks that align with Islamic principles using our ethical screening tools.
- Arab-Themed ETFs: Invest in the future of the region with curated ETFs focused on high-growth Middle Eastern sectors.
- Ultra-Low Trading Costs: Maximize your returns with our highly competitive fee structure — designed to keep more profit in your pocket.
▶ ANALYSIS & INSIGHTS
- Advanced Conditional Orders: Trade like a pro. Automate your investment strategy with precise risk controls and flexible execution — set it and forget it.
- Deep Market Analysis: Unlock institutional-grade data. Our tools offer enhanced precision, technical indicators, and robust risk management.

bluejetty:00155636:ios.name: Link My Pet
bluejetty:00155636:ios.summary:
The Link app pairs with the Link smart pet wearable, which tracks your pet’s location, monitors his activity, and connects you with the most important information about your pet - all accessible via this easy-to-use app.
LOCATION TRACKING
bluejetty:00155636:ios.description:
The Link app pairs with the Link smart pet wearable, which tracks your pet’s location, monitors his activity, and connects you with the most important information about your pet - all accessible via this easy-to-use app.
LOCATION TRACKING
Track your pet’s location in real-time using Link’s Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Cellular, and GPS connections. Interact with the map on the app to connect with your pet while you’re away and feel confident knowing you can have eyes on your best friend’s location anytime. 
ACTIVITY MONITORING
Link’s accelerometer tracks moderate and intense daily activity. The patent-pending app algorithm provides customized activity targets by age, size, breed, and behavior to make sure your pet gets enough exercise.
AMBIENT TEMPERATURE ALERTS
Make sure your pet is safe and comfortable by using the app to monitor the ambient temperature of his location. Get alerts if the temperature becomes too hot or too cold.
ADVENTURES

Use SATA Azores Airlines mobile app to book flights, check in, create a booking history, and enjoy SATA IMAGINE advantages anytime and anywhere!
SATA Azores Airlines mobile app is fast, safe, free, and easy to use, adding a new look and new features that allow you to make the most of our services.
Start enjoying all the advantages now:
* Check flight schedules and flight status
Check flight schedules and frequencies by flight number, route, departure or arrival airport, and find out if the flight is on time, is delayed, has departed, or has already arrived at its destination.
* Book flights easily and conveniently
Search, book and issue your next flights safely and quickly through the app. Book one-way, round-trip, or multiple cities. You can also use your miles or normally pay for your flights, safely, using the several payment methods at your disposal.
* Check in through the app
Easily check in online via the app and download your boarding pass directly to your mobile device.
* Access your SATA IMAGINE account and check your miles
Access your SATA IMAGINE account, or become a member of our frequent flyer program, to start collecting miles. Check your profile, your miles balance and much more.
* Create a booking history
By logging in, you can access your bookings and add your future flights on the app.
* Check information about flights and services
Access all information about flights and services, such as information about permitted carry-on and checked baggage, excess baggage or additional and special services, as well as services at the airport and on board.
* Quickly access a contact form
Reach out to us using the form we provide on the app, so you can contact us more easily.

bluejetty:00119177:ios.description:
Greater Texas|Aggieland Credit Union Digital Banking
Bank anytime, anywhere with the Greater Texas|Aggieland Credit Union digital banking app. Designed for ease and security, our app gives you full control over your finances with intuitive features and advanced protections to keep your accounts safe.
Key Features:
• Seamless Account Management – Instantly check balances, track transactions, and view detailed account activity.
• Fast & Secure Transfers – Move money effortlessly between your credit union accounts or to external banks.
• Mobile Check Deposit – Snap a picture of your check to deposit it without visiting a branch.
• Advanced Card Controls – Activate, deactivate, and set spending limits for your debit and credit cards.
• Bill Pay & P2P Payments – Easily pay bills and send money to friends and family, all within the app.
• Smart Money Management – Stay on top of your finances with budgeting tools, spending insights, and goal tracking.
• Personalized Alerts – Set up real-time notifications for account activity, low balances, and more.
• Branch & ATM Locator – Quickly find the nearest branches and ATMs, no matter where you are.
Enhanced Security for Peace of Mind:
Your security is our priority. The app includes advanced encryption, multi-factor authentication, and biometric login options (fingerprint and facial recognition) to keep your information safe.
Support When You Need It:
Need assistance? Get help directly through the app or contact us at (800) 749-9732.

Make high-quality international calls to both mobiles and landlines for next to nothing. We offer low cost calling rates for calls or text SMS. 
Cloud SIM allows you to choose your connection type and set up your call via either local access, mobile data or WIFI. This means you never have to worry about bad reception or your call dropping.
**A second phone number for freelancer, Dating, Business, Online, Gumtree, & other use**
Free text chat between Apple phones worldwide while using WIFI or data, share pictures. No matter where you or your contacts live! You’ll get these multiple numbers without any additional or roaming charges.

• Get a 2nd number without changing your SIM card, device, or mobile network provider

• Free Calls & Texts
• Use multiple international virtual numbers at a time
• Receive texts and calls to your new number
• Send SMS and make calls from your dedicated number
• Easy to make and switch between virtual number profiles when calling
• Dedicated voicemail for each separate mobile number
• Complete control of your mobile identity
• In-app purchases and secret messaging feature available
• Cloud SIM is free to download

A disposable number
A temporary/permanent number
A second phone number for travel
A second mobile phone number for business use
Disposable phone numbers for online ad listings
***Make low cost, roaming free calls***
Call landlines and mobiles in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, France, Nigeria, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Oman, India, Philippines, Australia

- Search any location by name

FREE AND SUBSCRIPTION

bluejetty:00077685:ios.description:
Embark on a transformative journey with the Travel Diaries App, your passport to turning every adventure into an unforgettable story. Blog travel experiences and pin places visited on travel maps with the Travel Diaries travel journal, book creator, travel tracker and map maker app!
Join thousands of travel writers who:
- Create a travel log book with itineraries, travel photos, traveling maps, & keepsakes from countries visited
- Pin their places to travel and countries been with the travel pin feature
- Reflect on unforgettable locals & travelers book like a travel journalist
- Unleash their inner Rick Steves to make a travel guide
- Create a travel book with the book creator feature
Craft your travel chronicle: Immerse yourself in the world of adventure with our versatile travel journal platform. From an interactive travel map that pins your global adventures to customizable layouts for a visually stunning travel photo journal to vivid travel pictures and weave compelling travel stories that will linger in your memory like cherished travel memories.
Effortless travel blogging: Capture each moment with precision, turning your musings into a mesmerizing travel journal. Share your adventures on a stylish webpage, connecting with a vibrant community of passionate travel enthusiasts.
Plan your next expedition: Transform your thoughts into a virtual travel notebook, an endless source of inspiration for planning your next odyssey. Map out countries, cities, and must-visit places, jotting down bucket list ideas. Craft a well-organized plan, ensuring your ideas are beautifully presented for your travel diary.
Pin your globetrotting adventures: Elevate your experiences by transforming your journey into a vibrant tapestry of memories with the travel pin feature. Effortlessly map out the countries been you've visited, creating a visual masterpiece that's not just a record but a work of art, perfect for any passionate travel tracker.
Capture moments, tell extraordinary stories: Turn your musings into a stunning photo travel journal, create a personalized travel diary with various fonts and layouts to document your adventures.Enhance your diary with photos, maps, and other features to make it visually appealing.Easily share selected chapters of your diary as an online travel blog with friends and family.
Compose with effortless grace: Our online text editor is your literary companion, making journaling a breeze. Choose from a myriad of fonts, blog post layouts, and digital scrapbook sticky boxes. It's designed to capture the charm of a real travel diary, ensuring your words are as visually appealing as the destinations you explore.
Seamless mobile & web experience: Switch between the mobile and web app seamlessly, ensuring you can log your travel adventures whether you're on the go or relaxing in your hotel room. Your world travel journal is accessible wherever your journey takes you.
Publish and preserve your memories: Choose what to share publicly and let the world follow your travel adventures. From a secret travel diary to a beautifully printed travel log book, our app ensures your travel memories are not just captured but shared and preserved for a lifetime.
Customizable travel journal: Tailor your travel diary with diverse fonts and layouts. Add travel photos, maps, and more to create a visually stunning record of your journeys. Each entry is a testament to your unique travel story, presented beautifully for a customizable and memorable experience.
Start your travel diaries adventure today and unlock the power to turn every travel moment into a timeless tale!
---------------------
Contact us: https://www.traveldiariesapp.com/en/contact
Terms of use: https://www.traveldiariesapp.com/en/about/terms
Create, share, and relive your travel stories with Travel Diaries.

bluejetty:00044681:ios.name: Cloud Ready printer
bluejetty:00044681:ios.summary: Cloud Ready Printer makes printing easy and convenient, allowing you to print any document, image, or web page to any printer on your network or in the cloud from your mobile device. With Cloud Ready Printer, you can print from anywhere, an
bluejetty:00044681:ios.description:
Cloud Ready Printer makes printing easy and convenient, allowing you to print any document, image, or web page to any printer on your network or in the cloud from your mobile device. With Cloud Ready Printer, you can print from anywhere, any platform, and release print jobs securely at your convenience. Save on printing costs with Economy mode, which converts print jobs to duplex and grayscale. Preview print jobs before printing, and enjoy the peace of mind that comes with secure print job release. Download Cloud Ready Printer now and start printing smarter.
One app that processes thousands of jobs every day and it works always
Can I print to my printer while I am away, like really far?
 Why not? You can.
Is your printer air print enabled?
 We don't care. We support it either way.
Is your printer too old or inexpensive?
 We understand, we support them too.
Is your printer USB connected and you want to print from your iphone or ipad?
 We got you. Please visit https://www.cloudreadyprinter.com.
Cloud Printer application can make any network/usb/bluetooth connected printer "Cloud Ready Printer". 
Smart Printer supports manufacturers like HP, Canon, Brother, Epson, Xerox , Ricoh, Kyocera and many more
MOBILE PRINTING: You can also print documents, pictures, Facebook photos or content from other cloud storage solutions like Drop Box, Drive, Box from your mobile phone.
This app is truly a Global Follow me solution and you can release your print jobs at your convenience.
CLOUD PRINT ENABLER: Print any document, from any where and from any platform ( PC, Mobile, Chrome ) and collect at your printer at home/office.
FOLLOW ME: Release the documents securely at your convenience. Delete any unwanted print jobs or Save it for future use. Your print jobs are literally at your finger tips.
DIRECT PRINTING MODE: As soon as a document is submitted to the "Google Cloud Printer", this app downloads the print job from cloud and prints on the configured device.
Note: Any questions or problems please send a mail to our Support everydaysols@gmail.com

bluejetty:00061877:ios.description:
ZenHR is a state-of-the-art cloud-based HR software solution that changes the game for HR departments and employees. ZenHR's Employee Self-Service (ESS) mobile app offers immediate access to HR-related tasks and information while staying connected wherever you go, right at your fingertips. 
What you’ll love about using the ZenHR app:
- Clock in and out of work right from the app. 
-  Submit and view time off requests and any type of requests. 
-  Approve and deny requests. 
-  See your available time off balances. 
-  Access salary slips and company documents from anywhere. 
-  See who’s off or working remotely today and on future dates.
-  Access the employee directory everywhere you go - find colleagues' numbers, emails, titles, and more.
-  View work schedules and shifts on the go.
-  Face and Touch ID to keep your information secure. 
-   Push notifications to keep you in the loop on request statuses, company announcements, and more. 
- See which of your colleague's birthdays are coming up. 
- Dark mode - because we know it looks cooler. 
 -  And so much more! 
In order to enjoy the app, you must have a ZenHR account. Find out more and request a demo at https://bit.ly/3FB7F2X.

bluejetty:00078050:ios.description:

Enjoy support throughout your hair removal journey with the Braun IPL App, which helps you plan your sessions, get step-by-step guidance, and track your progress towards up to 3 years of smooth skin.*
Expert guidance personalized to you with Braun Aura 9 and Skin i-expert
The Braun IPL App creates a personalized treatment plan tailored to your body areas, hair density, and progress. Get the right number of sessions for each body area, with your plan automatically adapting based on your results, and real-time coverage guidance to help avoid missed spots and patchy results. If life gets in the way and you miss a session, your treatment plan automatically adjusts to keep you on track towards your best results.
Like a beautician at home with Braun Aura 7, Silk-Expert Pro 5, Silk-Expert Pro 3 & Silk-Expert Mini
The Braun IPL App helps you stay on track to smooth skin. Create treatment plans for each body area and receive reminders when it’s time for your next session. Missed a session? Your treatment plan automatically adjusts to fit your routine.
*Skin smoothness due to hair reduction. 3 years measured from treatment start following 4 initial sessions. Check treatment regimens, skin type and hair color compatibility, warnings, and contraindications, at www.Braun.com and in the usage instructions.
