bluejetty:00066198:ios.description:
Journey to Pixeland, home of the cute and epic Pixelings. 
Trouble brews; a mysterious being is consuming Pixeland’s inhabitants. It’s up to you and PewDiePie to battle against the threatening invaders and restore order to Pixeland’s different worlds! 
Build your deck of Pixelings and lead them to glorious victory! Collect and upgrade over 40 hand drawn pixel creatures in this EPIC Idle but not-so IDLE RPG Game. Make new friends and catch up with familiar faces from Tuber Simulator & Legend of the Brofist. 
Go head-to-head against other players in gripping, real-time PvP battles. Devise the best strategy, use big brain tactics, and make your name famous in the arena! 
Drag, drop, and swap! PewDiePie’s Pixelings has the best combat system: it captures the essence of idle games and the strategic depth of turn-based strategy RPGs. 
Create a guild and chat with your friends to build a new unique strategy! 
TL;DR: 
• Collect & upgrade new and epic Pixelings 
• Join PewDiePie on a “meme-orable” quest across Pixeland, home of the Pixelings 
• Play against other players in real-time PvP matches 
• Battle using a unique, fluid combat system that captures elements of idle and strategy games 
• Meme to glory in an all-new storyline set in PewDiePie’s Pixelverse (Tuber Simulator, 
Legend of the Brofist) 
• Join guilds and chat with your friends! 
• Collect & master ALL the spells and experiment with different monster teams 
PewDiePie’s Pixelings is a free-to-play mobile game. However, you may purchase items with real money. Should you wish to disable such purchases, please go to your device’s settings and disable in-app purchases.
PewDiePie’s Pixelings offers players a monthly VIP subscription, which grants players daily premium currency and other benefits. The subscription is priced at (USD) $7.99. Prices may vary depending on country and sales taxes.
Payment for PewDiePie’s Pixelings’s monthly VIP subscription will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of the purchase. Please note: the monthly VIP subscription automatically renews itself, unless you disable the auto-renew feature 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. To disable the auto-renew feature, please go to your user Account settings. iTunes accounts are charged 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
Privacy Policy & Terms of Use: https://outerminds.com/legal/

bluejetty:00039733:ios.description:
Much more than an online pet shop, in the Cobasi app you'll find everything essential for your pet, home, and garden. Lightweight and user-friendly, here you have thousands of products at your disposal, activate exclusive My Discount promotions, track orders, schedule services, and much more! 
Cobasi App: Your 24-Hour Pet Shop 
The Cobasi app allows you to have a complete online pet shop anytime in the palm of your hand. Everything you love from our website and physical stores is on your phone screen.
Items for dogs, cats, rodents, birds, and other pets with variety, plenty of promotions, and fast delivery. 
Everything for Dogs and Cats
In the Cobasi App, you can buy the best brands of dog and cat food without leaving the comfort of your home. Check out our promotions for today! 
Take advantage and get interactive toys, scratching posts, as well as accessories like dog houses and beds. You can also find numerous flea treatments, antibiotics, flower essences, vitamins, and dietary supplements for pets, always on promotion. 
If your dog or cat needs a visit to the veterinarian, you can easily schedule an appointment at partner clinics Pet Anjo and SPet closest to you with just a few clicks. 
Birds, Fish, and Other Pets 
The Cobasi online pet shop isn't just the favorite app for dogs and cats. We have dedicated spaces for birds, fish, rodents, and other pets. Buy food, aviaries, and medications to keep your pet happy. 
Home, Garden, and Pool 
Shop for items to decorate your home, take care of your garden, and maintain your pool. We have plants, tools, and pool chlorine to make the most enjoyable part of your home just the way you want it. 
Why Download the Cobasi App? 
Shopping online with us is practical, fast, and secure. In our pet shop, you not only get low prices and fast delivery, but you also manage your scheduled purchases, track delivery statuses, and receive notifications about the best deals. 
With our app, you gain comfort and convenience by scheduling grooming services online at Pet Anjo and Spet units located in our stores. 
Access exclusive offers; 
Schedule your purchases and get discounts; 
Book services; 
Track orders; 
Shop online; 
Participate in the Amigo Cobasi program; 
Register in the Espaço Pet; 
Buy in just a few clicks; 
Pick up in-store within minutes. 
Exclusive Discounts, Offers, and Benefits 
Those with the Cobasi pet app on their phones can enjoy exclusive promotions from My Discount. Simply activate notifications and enjoy offers for purchases on the website, in-store, and, of course, on the app. 
By scheduling your purchases, you also get a 10% discount on all products and services. Dog walking, pet sitting, training, and more from quality provider Pet Anjo. 
Check your points from the Amigo Cobasi Program, exchange them for gifts or discounts of up to R$150 on the website, app, and physical store. And there's more! In our app, you can also access Espaço Pet for exclusive information and keep up with your pet's important moments. 
Security and Trust 
Since 1985 in the lives of Brazilians, Cobasi has a presence throughout Brazil with over 200 stores. We also have a strong online presence on the website and app to provide convenience and low prices for your family's home. 
Here, you have security in your purchases and service bookings on a platform that follows LGPD regulations and has the latest security systems in payments. 
Download the app and enjoy Cobasi's online pet store!

bluejetty:00044600:ios.description:
Tasks, quests, and BEASTS - OH MY!
Gamify your life with ModernSam. A free self-care and productivity app designed by ADHDers for ADHDers that transforms your day into an exciting RPG adventure to gamify your tasks, goals, and overall wellbeing.
Use ModernSam to support your ADHD, reduce stress, defeat procrastination, build habits, boost productivity, reach fitness goals, organize your to do list, and more
With immersive quests, character customization, and magical dopamine reward boosts - you can level up your productivity and self-care effortlessly
KEY FEATURES
IMMERSIVE STORYLINE: Dive into a captivating fully voiced campaign storyline with unique villains and fascinating characters. 
Stay tuned for regular chapter releases keeping you engaged and motivated!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER: Create your unique character avatar with a wide range of options including hairstyles, facial expressions, skin tones, and even warpaints
DAILY QUESTS: Roll daily for new, randomized real life quests! Complete them each day and level up while earning rewards like luck potions, coins, and hunting tickets
RECURRING TASKS: For your daily, weekly, and monthly needs
AI ASSISTED TO-DO LISTS: Create your todo list and utilize AI to break down complex feeling tasks into manageable subtasks offering valuable support for ADHDers struggling with executive dysfunction
EARN COINS AND XP: Transform the grind of modern day life into rewarding quests where you earn coin and XP for completing tasks
FOUR ARCHETYPES: Level up your inner Warrior, Ranger, Magician, or Healer based on your daily actions each contributing to holistic self improvement - each contributing to strengthening your in game character for battles
BEASTIARY CARD COLLECTION: Encounter a variety of creatures from common to super rare and complete your card collection
HUNTING: Features turn based combat mode with varying difficulty based on the rarity of the monster you discover
MEDITATIONS: Breathe easy with short fantasy themed mindfulness meditations such as The Enchanted Forest for a quick mental health refresh featuring soothing quality voiceovers 
AFFIRMATIONS: Listen to daily bite sized positive affirmations to quickly boost self esteem, motivate you, and encourage positive change in your life 
CAMPFIRE DAILY REFLECTION: Visit your tent and reflect on your daily accomplishments, no matter how small, to boost your confidence positivity and earn bonus archetype points
THREE HOUSES: Take a personality quiz to be sorted into one of the three unique houses encouraging friendly competition among players
Do you want to be more productive and practice better self-care but have given up?
Does ADHD seem to get in the way of everything you want to do 
With ModernSam you'll harness the true power of gamification and start reaching your goals
Potential benefits include
Reduce Stress 
Boost Confidence 
Stay Motivated 
Increase Focus 
Feel Organized
Improve Health
Your hero's journey begins now
ModernSam
For ADHDers by ADHDers
Run by a small passion driven team with an on fire community aiming to build an app that actually works for people with ADHD
Our team aims to roll out continuous improvements to better the player experience based on both our vision and your valued feedback

- Eliminate long lines at your front desk by checking clients in.
- Provide clients with a personalized experience by quickly viewing their information, including purchases and visit history.
- Always keep track of how your business is performing with access to real-time metrics and reports.
Please note: This app is for businesses that use Mindbody.

bluejetty:00159728:ios.name: QVC Mobile Shopping (US)
bluejetty:00159728:ios.summary: Mobile shopping has never been more simplified and fun. Now you can watch our TV channels live by simply downloading the updated QVC app on your iPhone. Get more of what you love with the QVC for iPhone® app that can be downloaded for free.
bluejetty:00159728:ios.description:
Mobile shopping has never been more simplified and fun. Now you can watch our TV channels live by simply downloading the updated QVC app on your iPhone. Get more of what you love with the QVC for iPhone® app that can be downloaded for free. The My Account feature lets you access more order information than ever. You can track your order, edit Easy Pay® options, and manage your address book. Plus, as always, you’ll never miss our Today's Special Value®—our best find of the day, an item we believe you’ll love. That goes for our QVC2 Big Deal™ and Beauty iQ Steal™, too!
NEW FEATURES
• Now introducing PayPal as a payment method and PayPal Express to place orders quickly and easily!
• A new look and enhanced user interface across our Home screen, Product Listings, and Product Detail pages make it easier to shop your favorites, from fashion to cosmetics to electronics
• New checkout process for a seamless experience
• QVC live video displayed right from the Home tab, so you never miss a moment
• Quick links to our TSV, QVC2 Big Deal, Beauty iQ Steal, and more
• Seamlessly browse through recent on-air items, right from the Home screen
• At the end of the page? Keep scrolling to see the latest happenings, new offers, trends, and more!
• For “Do Not Sell My Personal Information” rights under California law please refer to the Right to Opt-Out of Sales section of the QVC Privacy Policy
EXISTING FEATURES
•Watch our full 16:9 HD live stream and purchase the current Item On Air
•See customer ratings & reviews on our Product Detail pages and Product Listings. Plus, view product images, information, sizing, color swatches, styles, availability, and delivery date estimates on our enhanced Product Detail pages
•Find exactly what you're looking for with our full-search capability – search over 50,000 clothing, cosmetics, electronics, home décor, and other items by category, item number, product description, brand, phrase, or word. From there, you have the ability to narrow those search results
•On our Homepage, find our Today's Special Value offer, QVC2 Big Deal, Beauty iQ Steal, and current
Item On Air, plus Items Recently On Air, and featured promotions
•Narrow the Items Recently On Air product listing by show
•Share items via Facebook or Twitter
•Speed Buy® to purchase items quickly and confidently! New customers can easily create an account—anytime, anywhere
•Check your order status, edit or cancel orders, and manage Auto-Delivery
•Update your personal information, manage your address book, and view/edit Easy Pay options
•Access and shop your Wish List
QVC wants you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If you're not satisfied for any reason, our return policy allows you to send back the merchandise within 30 days of the date you received the package for an exchange or a refund of the purchase price, minus the full shipping & handling and Q Return Label fees. QVC will refund any paid S&H fees and Q Return Label fees if an item is defective or we were in error. Purchases from QVC and the use of QVC services are subject to our General Terms and Conditions of Use and our Privacy Policy, which can be found at the bottom of the QVC.com homepage.
Award-winning Service: We've been honored multiple times with BizRate's "Circle of Excellence" distinction.
QVC is committed to giving you quality service and treating your information responsibly. For details, please see our Privacy Statement.
QVC is Norton Secured powered by Digicert, so you can feel confident while shopping with us. We participate in the Norton Secured Seal Program with Extended Validation of our organization. All of your personal information is encrypted by Transport Layer Security (TLS) software when it's transmitted to us during the checkout process, just as it is on QVC.com.
Watching QVC's video stream may significantly increase the data usage amount of your mobile device and may incur additional fees. Contact your carrier for more information.

bluejetty:00063003:ios.name: Belot.BG: Белот с приятели
bluejetty:00063003:ios.summary:
ИЗБЕРИ БЪЛГАРСКОТО! Играй белот и намери нови приятели в нашата социална платформа за игри с карти! В Belot.BG играеш твоята любима игра онлайн, на мобилно устройство, във Facebook и на Smart TV. 
5 ИГРИ ЗА ТЕБ
Играй в реално време сре
bluejetty:00063003:ios.description:
ИЗБЕРИ БЪЛГАРСКОТО! Играй белот и намери нови приятели в нашата социална платформа за игри с карти! В Belot.BG играеш твоята любима игра онлайн, на мобилно устройство, във Facebook и на Smart TV. 
5 ИГРИ ЗА ТЕБ
Играй в реално време срещу истински противници от цяла България! Намери нови приятели, стани част от клуб и съхранявай прогреса си на всяко устройство! Можеш да играеш във вертикално и хоризонтално положение на устройството.
ИГРАЙ БЕЛОТ
Белота се играе от четирима човека по отбори, с тесте от 32 карти. Всеки отбор се стреми да обере колкото може повече ръце. Целта е да се съберат 151 точки.
ИГРАЙ САНТАСЕ
Сантасе се играе от двама души с 24 карти. Целта е да се съберат 66 точки. Анонси по време на игра носят допълнителни точки: Q и K от един цвят са 20, а в козов цвят са 40.
ИГРАЙ БЛАТО
Блато (3-5-8) се играе от трима играчи с 52 карти. Всеки играч играе за себе си. Целта е всеки да събере оказаните в началото залози от 4 карти, които могат да са 3, 5 или 8.
ИГРАЙ ТАБЛА
Таблата е настолна игра за двама. Дъската за игра е разделена на 24 черни и бели триъгълника, разположени в 4 квадрантa. Всеки участник започва играта с 15 пула и хвърля зарове. Целта е да извади всички свои пулове от играта.
ИГРАЙ НЕ СЕ СЪРДИ, ЧОВЕЧЕ!
Не се Сърди, Човече се играе от четирима играчи. Всеки има по 4 пионки от един и същ цвят, които трябва да придвижи през дъската и да прибере в оказаното за своя цвят поле. Движението става според хвърлянето на зара.
ВЗИМАЙ БОНУСИ
- Печалба при всяка победа
- Дневни бонуси
- Касичка прасенце
- Събирай печати за всяка покупка. След 5 покупки в приложението на каква да е цена (1 печат подарък от нас), ще получиш бонус чипове
- Допълнителни бонуси с ръчно повишаване на нивото
- Адвент календар за специални награди
- Дарителски инвентар за изпращане на подаръци
ВЛЕЗ В КЛУБ
Можеш да създадеш отворен клуб, където всеки може да се присъедини, или частен клуб, само за отбрани играчи. Клубът може да е боен (с фокус върху игрите) или социален (с фокус върху чат и забавление). Стани лидер и разпредели роли за всеки. Клубовете участват и в специални клубни игри.
ПОКАЖИ СЕ В КЛАСАЦИИТЕ

ИГРАЙ БЕЛОТ
Белота се играе от четирима човека по отбори, с тесте от 32 карти. Всеки отбор се стреми да обере колкото може повече ръце. Целта е да се съберат 151 точки.

Сантасе се играе от двама души с 24 карти. Целта е да се съберат 66 точки. Анонси по време на игра носят допълнителни точки: Q и K от един цвят са 20, а в козов цвят са 40.

Блато (3-5-8) се играе от трима играчи с 52 карти. Всеки играч играе за себе си. Целта е всеки да събере оказаните в началото залози от 4 карти, които могат да са 3, 5 или 8.

bluejetty:00184199:ios.description:
The Cleveland State Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Cleveland State Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Cleveland State Bank App, you must be enrolled as an Cleveland State Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00014233:ios.description:
Korea’s first private money transfer company authorized by the Korean Government. 
GME is a fintech Super App designed to provide financial services for foreigners living in Korea. Since launching as a cross-border money transfer service in 2016, GME has expanded into multiple financial services to make daily life easier and more convenient. 
▶ Fast, Easy and Convenient International Money Transfer 
• Competitive exchange rates 
• Cash pickup and bank deposit available within 5 minutes 
• Remittance fees from 5,000 KRW — typically lower than traditional bank wire transfers 
▶ Safe Overseas Remittance with GME 
• Secure overseas remittance through trusted partners such as MoneyGram and Ria 
• Send money to banks in over 200 countries 
• Operates under the supervision of the Financial Supervisory Service and the Bank of Korea 
▶ GME Debit Card 
• Spend and withdraw money wherever Mastercard is accepted 
• Shop online and offline worldwide 
• Withdraw cash from ATMs in Korea and overseas 
This card is issued by BC Card Co. pursuant to a license by Mastercard Asia/Pacific Pte. Ltd. 
▶ Loan Services for Foreign Residents in Korea 
• Explore personal, business, vacation, and student loan options 
• Fast online application with digital contracts 
• Loan services are provided through licensed financial partners 
▶ Telecom Services 
GME provides MVNO SIM card services in partnership with LG U+ and KT. Customers can apply for a SIM card directly through the app and receive it at home. 
▶ International Mobile Top-Up 
• Send mobile top-ups to family and friends worldwide 
Privacy Permissions 
GME requests permissions only when necessary for identity verification, transactions, security, and customer convenience. 
• Camera: ID verification and face verification 
• Photos: Upload documents for identity verification and save receipts 
• Location: Address verification during registration 
• Contacts: Select recipient phone numbers for mobile top-up 
• Notifications: Transaction and security alerts 
Privacy 
GME uses personal information only for the stated purposes and with user consent. 
Our Commitment 
• Reliable service 
• Customer support available 365 days a year 
• Multilingual support in 17+ languages 
Loan Disclosure 
GME acts as a loan facilitator in cooperation with GME Finance (Business Registration No. 646-88-01104, License No. 2019-금감원-1801), regulated by the Financial Supervisory Service (http://www.fss.or.kr). 
GME does not directly enter into loan contracts. Loan reviews and agreements are conducted by affiliated financial institutions. 
• Loan Limit: 2,000,000 KRW – 50,000,000 KRW 
• Loan Period: 6 – 120 months 
• Interest Rate Range: 9.05% – 20.0% annually within legal limits 
Representative Example: 
For a 2,000,000 KRW loan at 20.0% annual interest over 12 months, the total repayment amount is approximately 2,223,228 KRW (185,269 KRW/month). 
• Loan terms may vary depending on the product and repayment method 
Customer Support 
• Website: www.gmeremit.com 
• Hotline: 1588-6864

bluejetty:00128708:ios.name: Adobe Fresco: Draw & Paint App
bluejetty:00128708:ios.summary: Adobe Fresco is a free, professional drawing and painting app made for everyone. Built for iPad and iPhone with Apple Pencil Pro compatibility, Fresco offers powerful features and thousands of brushes to help you create your next masterpiec
bluejetty:00128708:ios.description:
Adobe Fresco is a free, professional drawing and painting app made for everyone. Built for iPad and iPhone with Apple Pencil Pro compatibility, Fresco offers powerful features and thousands of brushes to help you create your next masterpiece.
CREATE & SHARE YOUR ARTWORK
Take your artwork to the next level with Fresco’s suite of animation tools, visual effects, and expansive brush library. Perfect your artwork with unlimited layers, and easily export and share your work with multiple export presets, including process time-lapses. You can even mark your content as generative AI-free with Fresco’s Content Credentials feature.
QUICK ANIMATION TOOLS
Animate your artwork with frame-by-frame animation and motion paths. Dynamic, easy-to-use features and a library of preset options let you add movement with just a tap. Easily export and share your creations as GIF and MP4 files.
THOUSANDS OF BRUSHES
Make your masterpiece with our library of exclusive brush packs, completely free. Discover blendable raster brushes, realistic paints and pencils, and sharp, non-pixelating vector brushes. You can also easily import your favorite Photoshop brushes.
EASY TO USE
Fresco provides professional digital art tools at an accessible level. Easily create perfect shapes with Snap to Shape. Draw stunning symmetrical artwork with rotational and reflective symmetry guides. Apply effects from our library of Elements to enhance your artwork. Speed up and optimize your coloring with Paint Inside mode.
Fresco is the premier, professional digital art tool for artists of all levels. Download today and start creating for free.
OTHER FEATURES & TOOLS
• Color palettes – Fresco automatically creates a color palette when you import any artwork.
• Recolor your artwork — Photoshop-like adjustment layers allow you to easily test and apply changes to brightness, hue/saturation, and color balance.
• Text — Add stylish text to your artwork using Adobe’s expansive collection of free fonts.
• Multicolor swatches — Pick up the elements of any piece of artwork to paint with multiple colors at once using any pixel brush or Live Brush.
• Magic wand, liquify and free transform — Easily select your artwork with the magic wand tool and use liquify and other free transform tools to alter any object.
• Learn content — Strengthen your skills with step-by-step tutorials and built-in video tutorials.
• Drawing aids — Trace along the edges of a ruler, circle, square or polygon with a brush or fill inside or outside of a shape with the Fill tool.
• Guides & grids — Align your artwork easily and create perspective grids from an imported photo.
• Seamless integration with Photoshop and Illustrator — Open documents in either app without importing or exporting. Send your layered vector illustrations directly to Illustrator for desktop or iPad for finishing touches.
Terms & Conditions:
Your use of this application is governed by the Adobe General Terms of Use http://www.adobe.com/go/terms_linkfree_en and the Adobe Privacy Policy http://www.adobe.com/go/privacy_policy_linkfree_en
Do not sell or share my personal information: www.adobe.com/go/ca-rights-linkfree

bluejetty:00131492:ios.description:
Lock and load your guns, partner—it’s time for some gun-shooting games action! Settle a battle or two in one of the most engrossing robot fighting games of all time!
If you're a fan of first-person shooting games or military simulators, test your skills and reaction. And if you’re new to the world of robot shooting games, dive into the exciting adventure!
Our fast-paced action game teleports you to a futuristic world where war robots have taken over the planet. It’s only up to you to stop them! Attack the enemies with a blaster and win every robot fight to get the title of the Earth's defender in our fascinating robot game!
OUTSMART WAR ROBOTS
These machines were built for a fight. However, they forgot the golden rule: don’t bring a fist to a gunfight! The robots will try to overpower you with physical strength, but their defense won’t survive your revolver attack in this top war battle game!
UPGRADE YOUR GUNS
Get into the robot wars and tear them all in half! Each destroyed machine will bring you money in our fighting game. Spend it on a unique pistol or revolver and a classy pair of gloves to fire each gun shot with swag!
GUN SHOT ALL STRESS
Run away from the humdrum routine to the world of our defense & fight game to taste the life of the Earth’s defender! Get yourself hooked for hours in the unique top gun game that blends shooter games with robot shooting games!
USE THE ENVIRONMENT
Unlike in other gun shooting games, you’ll get the most powerful weapons of all galaxies! Take a blaster that shoots gum or a pistol with ropes instead of bullets in our top war battle game. These futuristic shooting guns will help tie the robots to hurdles and tear them all down! 
TOP GUN GRAPHICS
This military action game will impress you with its crisp robot wars, colorful levels, and extraordinary shooting guns. With its bright design, our robot fight game will be a feast for your eyes! You’ll feel like a main character from a movie, not like a player of first-person shooting games.
Out of all robot fighting games and shooter games, you'll love our gun game. Download this fun robot game now to defend the planet. Load your weapon and go save the Earth, legend!

bluejetty:00065308:ios.description:
The Service Finance mobile application allows registered dealers and their authorized agents the ability to securely apply for customer financing while on site 24/7. The secure application can be filled out quickly by leveraging some exclusive add-ons that allow it to capture demographic information by simply scanning the customer's driver's license. Agents will also be notified with an underwriting decision real-time on the device leveraging the device's native push notification system. Agents are also able to snap a photo and upload work orders and other stipulations leveraging the existing camera on the device. The app also allows the agent to provide a touch interface for the customer to easily sign their loan documents electronically. This grants the agent the ability to successfully complete all the required tasks before ever leaving the property, greatly reducing the processing time. The agent then has the ability to follow the progress of the request through all the steps and manage their individual pipeline real-time. The office administrator will be provided with access to the agent management dashboard upon successfully registering for and completing the training. This tool will allow the office administrator to grant and delete access to the mobile application.
• Expedited data entry by scanning customer's driver's license
• Real-time status updates
• Capability to photograph and upload required documents
• Touch interface for customer signature
• Maintain individual pipeline
• Agent management dashboard
Service Finance does not charge a fee for the use of its free mobile application. However, web access is required and third party message and data rates may apply. Check with your mobile carrier for specific fees and charges. A supported mobile device is needed when using this application. Use of the Send Document Feature requires a supported camera-equipped device. During the installation you will be requested to trust certain features of the application, in doing so, you are allowing the application to use those features. Using the EZ Sign Portal feature redirects the user to Service Finance's secure url for easy execution of documents.

bluejetty:00123095:ios.description:
Stop exposing your credit or debit card information and protect your online payments with Privacy. Join over 250,000 users who have saved millions of dollars by using Privacy to block unwanted charges from compromised cards, overcharging, hidden fees, and forgotten subscriptions.
Getting started with Privacy is simple: create your account, verify your information, securely link your bank account or debit card, and request your first virtual card. Start shopping and enjoy the added layer of protection Privacy provides to protect you from payment card theft and fraud.
Benefits:
- Shield your true financial information: Our Privacy Cards mask your debit card or bank account number to help protect you from card theft and fraud. Pay with greater privacy and security anytime, anywhere on desktop or on mobile.
- Create merchant-locked and one-time-use cards: Our cards automatically "lock" to the first merchant they are used at, so if the merchant is ever breached, the card number can never be used anywhere else. You can also create one-time-use cards that automatically close after a single transaction.
- Take complete control over your spending: Set customizable spending limits to prevent overcharging and block hidden fees—perfect for managing subscriptions and recurring expenses. If a transaction goes over the limit, we will automatically decline it.
- Leverage real-time transaction monitoring: Receive notifications any time a Privacy Card is used. Easily pause, unpause, and close Privacy Cards any time with just one push of a button.
Privacy’s core product is free to use on domestic transactions, because, like other card companies, we collect transaction fees from merchants. Privacy Cards can be used at most merchants that accept credit and debit cards.
The security of our users’ personal information and data is critical to everything that we do at Privacy. You can review our security policies at https://privacy.com/security.
Read about us in Forbes, Wirecutter, and The Wall Street Journal!
For support, questions, or more information, please contact us at support@privacy.com.

With our
bluejetty:00025531:ios.description:
Are you looking for an exciting and challenging puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours on end? Look no further than our amazing new game Blockin’ Art that will challenge your brain in ways you never thought possible. 
With our unique and innovative gameplay, you'll be able to create beautiful pictures out of blocks, using your logic and creativity to arrange the blocks in just the right way.
The game is incredibly addictive and engaging, and once you start playing, you won't be able to stop. There are so many different pictures to create, each one more challenging than the last, and with each new picture you complete, you'll feel a sense of accomplishment and pride in your ability to solve even the most complex puzzles.
Blockin’ Art is designed for players of all ages and skill levels, so whether you're a seasoned puzzle pro or just getting started, you'll be able to find something that suits your interests and abilities. 
The block puzzle game is easy to learn but challenging to master, so you'll never get bored or feel like you're not being challenged enough.
One of the best things about puzzle games is the sheer variety of pictures you can create. From simple geometric patterns to intricate landscapes and portraits, there's no limit to what you can create with our blocks. And with each new picture you complete, you'll unlock new challenges and levels, keeping the game fresh and exciting every time you play.
But it's not just about the puzzles - Blockin’ Art is also a great way to relax and unwind after a long day. With its beautiful graphics and calming gameplay, you'll find yourself lost in the world of block art, forgetting all your worries and cares as you create stunning pictures with ease.
So if you're looking for a fun, engaging, and challenging puzzle game that will keep you entertained for hours on end, look no further than our amazing Blockin’ Art. With its unique gameplay, stunning graphics, and endless variety, you'll never want to put it down!

bluejetty:00180980:ios.summary:
Do you have a refined taste for games? 
Are you searching for the ultimate immersive experience in mobile games?
Why do you pour the milk before the cereal? Ouch, wrong chat. 
If you answered positively to the first two questions, Railways
bluejetty:00180980:ios.description:
Do you have a refined taste for games? 
Are you searching for the ultimate immersive experience in mobile games?
Why do you pour the milk before the cereal? Ouch, wrong chat. 
If you answered positively to the first two questions, Railways will certainly suit your interests. From the makers of Traffix, Railways is a simulation game where you have trains, passengers and railways. Your goal is to move the trains strategically between the tracks, picking up the passengers and preventing crashes. Your mission is complete when you collect all the passengers. 
Mind the gap and start managing your railways!
To manage the trains like a master, you have to learn how to:
- Stop a train for a limited time with a single tap;
- Drag the train to create a new track;
- Automatically pick up nearby passengers and fill the trains; 
- Avoid running over passengers when changing the route;
- Prevent crashes between trains.
Railways features minimalist and artistic elements merged in an immersive experience where the perks of a train trip are emphasized: astonishing landscapes observed at a slow pace. Each level will bring a new challenge to the track, more chaos and of course clever moves from your side. All aboard! This train is ready to depart!
How much time can you keep the trains moving? Find out now!
This new game by Infinity Games is a magnificent train simulator where patience is a virtue. In order to succeed, you need to wait for the right moment and use your skills to drag the trains from one railway to another. You know that you will lose if the trains collide but you also know that you have all the time in the world to make a smart move. Furthermore, you can also stop the trains for a while. 
If you have the patience of a monk, you will have a great time with Railways!
If you are an impatient person, you can use Railways to improve those skills!
Features:
- Premium look and artistic features: you will not just play a mobile game. You will behold a masterpiece! 
- Immersive gameplay: after a couple of levels, you will find yourself absorbed by Railways imaginary world. 
- Curated levels crafted by train conductors: Railways levels were designed by train conductors with +10 years of experience. 
- Multiple achievements to conquer: picking up the passengers is just the beginning.
- Smooth difficulty curve
Did you know that 0% of players passed level 1? 
That is because at the date I am writing this text the game is not yet released. 
Infinity Games aims to provide the best game experience within its titles. We love showcasing new minimalist puzzle games and making people think while relaxing and having fun.
Do you like our work? Follow our track:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/infinitygamespage
Instagram: 8infinitygames (https://www.instagram.com/8infinitygames/)

bluejetty:00081337:ios.summary: The toughest prison sim in the yard is back to serve its 3rd consecutive sentence - combining classic moments from the OG with the best aspects of 2D, while putting out a few hits of its own! See how long you can survive in a sprawling faci
bluejetty:00081337:ios.description:
The toughest prison sim in the yard is back to serve its 3rd consecutive sentence - combining classic moments from the OG with the best aspects of 2D, while putting out a few hits of its own! See how long you can survive in a sprawling facility, where hundreds of fellow prisoners are trying to get through each day in real-time. Develop relationships with an advanced dialogue system that allows you to start conversations before the drama comes to you. Should you choose violence, a combat system perfected by wrestling lets you express yourself with your fists! Hundreds of fully interactive props can be equipped in either hand to dual wield as tools or weapons - including mind-blowing gunplay that allows you to shoot at ANY moment. Reinforced by a creative crafting system, you've only ever run out of ammo when you've run out of ideas.
Just when you think you've seen it all, a whole other police role challenges you to tackle crime from the other side of the fence - keeping existing prisoners in order while patrolling the streets for new ones! An extended outside world makes life worth living, with a wider range of vehicles and animals to explore it. All now presented with higher resolution visuals, a smoother frame rate, and a wider variety of camera angles to enjoy cinematic moments.
Upon upgrading to the fully "unlocked" experience, an inbuilt editor empowers you to save your changes to each character to make the world your own. You can then blow off steam in a special "Fight Scene" mode - where you select WHO fights WHERE and with WHAT! The action can also be enjoyed at a smoother 60fps frame rate on compatible devices, with no ads for paying customers.
The "Terms of Use" for subscriptions can be found here:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00157542:ios.name: MyMojoHealth
bluejetty:00157542:ios.summary: Tracking and viewing your blood glucose and ketone readings are easy with the App. Instantly sync your test results from your Keto-Mojo meter to your smartphone. A simple and seamless connection from your meter to the app requires no additi
bluejetty:00157542:ios.description:
Tracking and viewing your blood glucose and ketone readings are easy with the App. Instantly sync your test results from your Keto-Mojo meter to your smartphone. A simple and seamless connection from your meter to the app requires no additional formatting and no manual entries are required, although manual entries can be made.
European meter models will also download your GKI values and the app will automatically calculate GKI with US meter models without the GKI function.
· Filters allow you to review your data in a variety of formats.
· View different graphs of your readings (MyMojoHealth account required) with highs and lows for each day and your average over various time periods.
· Toggle from glucose to ketones to GKI or Dr. Boz Ratio, and scroll through past results.
· Filter your readings by tags and meters.
· Add and edit tags and notes to your readings.
· Set your glucose unit to either mg/dL or mmol/L.
· Upload your readings from the app to select health management platforms  (MyMojoHealth account required) where you can track your ketones and glucose alongside other  vital health metrics.
· Securely upload your data to MyMojoHealth Cloud Connect where your data is stored on a HIPAA compliant server.
· Use MyMojoHealth to share your data with our many app partners.
· Synchronize your data across multiple devices.
· Unlimited storage ensures you never have to worry about upgrading capacity or losing heritage data.
· Integration with Apple HealthKit.
The app is compatible with the following Keto-Mojo meters:
1. USA: GK+ meter, Bluetooth integrated meter or Bluetooth connector for older meter models, found at https://shop.keto-mojo.com/
2. EUROPE: GKI-Bluetooth meter found at https://shop.eu.keto-mojo.com/
Encrypted API connection ensures all your data is transferred securely.
Connect With the Community by Keto-Mojo to support your lifestyle inside the app.
· Weekly live events and Q&As.
· Practical, evidence-based resources and educational material.
· Support from peers on a similar path.
A friendly space to stay motivated, informed, and connected.
For more information: https://community.keto-mojo.com/landingpage
The information we provide through MyMojoHealth, Keto-Mojo, Community by Keto-Mojo and Keto-Check Inc. is not intended to replace consultation with a qualified medical professional.
The connection to our meters is solely intended to be used in the following regions:
* the USA
* the UK
* EU / EFTA
* Chile
* South Africa
* UAE/Dubai
The app can be used without a connection to our meters across all regions.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00170522:ios.description:
It's time for YOU.
Mamele provides everything that you need to hit those big goals that you've set for yourself.
Whether it's losing weight, building muscle, improving your nutrition, having a healthy pregnancy or coming back to the gym postpartum we have what you need!
What can you expect from the Mamele app? 
WORKOUTS:
FAT burning, MUSCLE building workouts for ANY fitness level.
Whether you’re working out at the gym, at home, you’re pregnant, postpartum or brand new to exercise. We’ve got what you need! Browse our programs or take our questionnaire to find which program suits you best.
NUTRITION: 
Enjoy our custom macro calculator, meal planning and food logging features all within the app, along with hundreds of delicious, macro-friendly, family friendly recipes. Plan out your meals for the week and use the grocery list feature to quickly and easily get the ingredients you need. 
COMMUNITY:
If you want to go far, go TOGETHER!
Join our incredible community of like-minded women who encourage, uplift and support one another. We have hundreds of women who have found their new best friend through this Mamele community. It's the best there is! We can't wait to meet you!
YOGA: 
Give those achy muscles some love and slow it down with our complimentary yoga flow session each week in the app. Stretch your body AND your mind through breath work and targeted muscled focused stretching.
GOALS:
Set new goals each day on our home screen. Toggle complete after you do each task or goal that you've set. A goal without a plan is just a wish. Let's turn those dreams into reality.
GRATITUDE:
Start each day the right way... with GRATITUDE. Use the gratitude prompt on the app to start each day with a grateful heart. Gratitude makes sense of our past, brings peace for today, and creates a vision for tomorrow.
Download the Mamele app to begin your journey to a happier, healthier, YOU.

bluejetty:00131936:ios.name: The Washington Manual
bluejetty:00131936:ios.summary:
** Expert diagnosis and treatment recommendations fully integrated with Prime PubMed **
ABOUT WASHINGTON MANUAL OF MEDICAL THERAPEUTICS
The Washington Manual streamlines diagnosis and treatment recommendations for hundreds of medical condi
bluejetty:00131936:ios.description:
** Expert diagnosis and treatment recommendations fully integrated with Prime PubMed **
ABOUT WASHINGTON MANUAL OF MEDICAL THERAPEUTICS
The Washington Manual streamlines diagnosis and treatment recommendations for hundreds of medical conditions on your mobile device without the need for an internet connection. Interns, residents, and medical students save valuable time by searching for practical answers to medical questions encountered on a regular basis. Evidence-based entries present current therapeutic options and Prime PubMed integration delivers supporting abstracts and journal articles directly to your mobile device in the hospital and at the bedside.
ABOUT DAVIS'S DRUG GUIDE
Davis’s Drug Guide is the perfect compliment to your Washington Manual app. Davis's Drug Guide is the best-selling drug database trusted by thousands of healthcare professionals. It delivers frequently updated information on over 5,000 trade name and generic drugs. Each monograph, with its focus on safety, includes details on pharmacokinetics, dosing, side effects, interactions, assessment, and more. 
BUNDLE FEATURES
• Comprehensive coverage of many areas of medicine and the core subspecialties 
• 600+ new and updated quick-reference topics
• 5000+ updating drug entries
• Decision support algorithms for diagnosis and treatment
• Evidence-based description of proven therapies
• Reference links to the medical literature through Prime PubMed
• General principles, diagnosis, and treatment information for each disease entry
• Pill Images and audio pronunciations
• Cross Links between resources
• Create custom notes and highlights within entries
• “Favorites” for bookmarking important entries
Prime PubMed 
Quickly search the complete PubMed database on your smartphone and tablet. Results contain abstracts, citations, and links to available full text articles that can be read on device and shared with classmates and colleagues. Additionally, Prime PubMed Search contains Grapherence™, an exclusive way to visually explore interrelationships and relevance in the medical literature.
Washington Manual Editors: Siri Ancha, MD; Christine Auberle, MD; Devin Cash, MD, PhD; Mohit Harsh, MD; John Hickman, MD, Carole Kounga, MD, PharmD [Internal Medicine Chief Residents from the Washington University School of Medicine and Barnes-Jewish Hospital in St. Louis.]
Publisher: Wolters Kluwer
Powered by: Unbound Medicine
Davis's Drug Guide Authors: April Hazard Vallerand, PhD, RN, FAAN; Cynthia A. Sanoski, BS, PharmD, FCCP, BCPS 
Publisher: F.A. Davis 
Powered by: Unbound Medicine
Your Davis’s Drug Guide subscription automatically renews annually unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours prior to the conclusion of your current period. If you choose not to renew, you will continue to have access to the content, but will no longer receive updates. Your iTunes account will automatically be charged the current renewal rate ($39.99) within 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. This will ensure you receive all updates for the following year. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. 
Unbound Privacy Policy: www.unboundmedicine.com/privacy
Unbound Terms of Use: https://www.unboundmedicine.com/end_user_license_agreement

bluejetty:00026699:ios.name: UNIQLO: Clothes Shopping
bluejetty:00026699:ios.summary: Discover effortless shopping and effortless style — all with the UNIQLO app. Explore the latest men’s, women’s and kids’ clothing collaborations, inspire your style with fresh fashion ideas, and claim exclusive app-only deals. From timeless
bluejetty:00026699:ios.description:
Discover effortless shopping and effortless style — all with the UNIQLO app. Explore the latest men’s, women’s and kids’ clothing collaborations, inspire your style with fresh fashion ideas, and claim exclusive app-only deals. From timeless LifeWear and streetwear favorites to winter HEATTECH thermal layers and breathable AIRism lines for warmer days, be the first to know when the clothing you love most is back in stock. 
Complete your wardrobe with everyday denim jeans and essential accessories for your home and redefine your fashion shopping experience with the app that brings you the best of UNIQLO. Discover a clothing app for men, women and kids.
Inspire your clothes shopping
Browse styles shared by customers, influencers, and UNIQLO staff members from all over the world and get inspiration for your next outfit. 
Find ideas for women’s, men’s and kids’ clothing and shop practical, stylish collections for all ages and seasons. 
Discover online-exclusive sizes and clothing styles you won’t find anywhere else.
Kids’ and baby clothes shopping
Discover stylish and comfortable clothing for the little ones. 
From playful and durable everyday kids’ clothing like jeans, t-shirts, and shorts, to soft and gentle fabrics perfect for newborns, UNIQLO has just what you need for your kids’ wardrobes. 
Shop seasonal kids’ clothing collections, featuring streetwear-inspired designs and limited-edition collaborations, all exclusive to UNIQLO.
Save your favorite clothing styles 
Tag clothes you like as “Favorites” and keep a collection of looks you love.
Get notified when items you’ve tagged as favorites are available for pickup, back in stock, or on sale.
Keep adding your favorite clothes to your collection for more personalized style and shopping recommendations.
Clothes-sizing videos 
See styles up close with product videos that give you a detailed look at the cut and fabric, giving you a more realistic idea of how clothing fits.
MySize ASSIST
Take the guesswork out of fashion shopping with MySize Assistant.
Simply enter your body measurements and preferred fit, and we’ll recommend a clothing size that’s perfect for you.
Easy in-store pickups
Save on shipping costs and skip store queues when you’re clothes shopping and buying other products using the app. 
Choose "Ship to Store" on your checkout screen and collect from any UNIQLO store that suits you within 1 hour, completely free of charge. 
See when products are out of stock online but available in-store and swing by for a swift, same-day pick-up. 
Avoid the disappointment of a wasted trip by checking whether a new product or special offer item is in stock before you visit your favorite store.
Back-in-stock notifications
Get alerts sent straight to your phone and be the first to know when the clothing style you’ve been eyeing is back in stock.
UNIQLO product scanner
Use the app to scan product barcodes at home or in store and easily check if nearby stores have your perfect clothing size and fit. 
App-exclusive offers
Download UNIQLO and unlock $5 off your first purchase of $50 or more—new customers only.
Scan your app member ID at checkout to unlock exclusive, member-only discounts.
Save time—and the planet—with e-receipts
Opt for e-receipts at checkout to easily track your clothes shopping history right from the app.
Return or exchange clothing and other items using electronic receipts, saving you the hassle of keeping track of paper receipts.
Have your say
Share feedback on items you’ve bought with the UNIQLO team and keep a lookout for product improvements. 
Read reviews from customers who have bought the same products as you. See the star rating, gender, height, weight and age of the customer who posted the review to help you choose the perfect product.
UNIQLO customer care
Chat with a UNIQLO representative for assistance with all your clothes and shopping needs.

bluejetty:00062904:ios.description:
** nPlayer officially supports DTS (DTS HD ), DTS Headphone:X.
** nPlayer supports Dolby (AC3, E-AC3).
** nPlayer is the universal app. You can install it in any other iOS device without additional purchase.
- You don't need to convert video files to MP4 to play them in your mobile device. nPlayer enable you to play all kinds of video formats and codecs without file converting efforts.
- You don't need to store video files in your device with limited storage space. nPlayer's powerful and various network technologies will help you to stream them from remote devices. 
- With your finger tip, you can adjust playback position, move to previous and next subtitle position, adjust location and font size of subtitles, control volume and brightness.
- Experience nPlayer, thousands of users recommendations.
* Features
- Supports officially DTS audio codec (DTS HD)
- Supports Dolby audio codec (AC3, E-AC3)
- Supports iXpand Drive
- Supports Chromecast
- Supports video cast for Smart TV
- Supports HDMI output
- Supports video files : MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WMV, ASF, FLV, OGV, RMVB, TP etc.
- Supports audio files : MP3, WAV, WMA, FLAC, APE etc.
- Supports subtitle files : SMI, SRT, SSA, IDX, SUB, LRC, SUP, MLP2 etc.
- Supports image files : JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF, TIFF etc.
- Supports playlist files : CUE, M3U, PLS
- Supports WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, HTTP, SMB/CIFS, NFS 
- Supports UPnP/DLNA (supports subtitles if DLNA server provides subtitles information.)
- Supports cloud service (Box, Dropbox, OneDrive, Yandex.Disk)
- Supports in-app web browser
- Supports iTunes video/audio play (except for DRM contents)
- Supports videos and pictures in Album
- Playback speed control : 0.5x ~ 4.0x
- Resume playback
- AB repeat(specific section repetition)
- Screen lock
- Supports AV1/HEVC/H.264/MPEG4 Hardware acceleration
- Supports 3D video mode
- Screen flip horizontally, vertically. brightness and saturation control
- Aspect ratio : Default, 1:1, 3:2, 4:3, 5:3, 16:9, 1.85:1 etc 
- Supports multi-track audio
- Supports audio boost
- Supports audio sync
- Supports lyrics display
- Supports Dolby, DTS HDMI Bitstream (Passthru)
- Supports embedded subtitles
- Supports multi-track subtitles
- Supports user’s selection of subtitle files
- Supports addition of optional subtitle files while playback
- Supports subtitles font, color, shadow, outline customization
- Supports subtitles sync
- Supports external subtitle fonts
- Supports SAMI(SMI) tag
- Supports SSA/ASS with full styling, embedded subtitles
- File management : Delete, Move, Rename, Create a folder
- Playlist management : Add, Delete, Modify
- Supports recently played list
- Folder lock
- Supports Open-in
- Supports UI theme
* Gesture Features
- Tap : Menu
- Double tap : Pop-up play
- Drag horizontally : Playback position adjustment
- Drag vertically on right half of the screen : Volume control
- Drag vertically on left half of the screen : Brightness control
- Pinch on the screen : Screen size adjustment
- Drag horizontally on subtitle text : Move to previous/next subtitle text
- Drag vertically on subtitle text : Subtitle position adjustment 
- Pinch on subtitle text : Subtitle font size adjustment
- Supports finger gesture customization

bluejetty:00096855:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00096855:ios.description:
► SORT YOUR WAY TO HAPPINESS
Master mergers, ready those fingers and get to matching in 3…2…1! This fun sorting puzzle features colorful coins that need to be matched up in their slots and then merged together to clear the playing field, making way for more. Bright colors, simple graphics, and lots of boosters ensure that your brain can focus on what it does best: noticing patterns and finding unique ways to shuffle everything around in order to win.
► MASTER THE MATCH
Simple in theory yet difficult in practice, players young and old will enjoy racking their brains for the best possible way to merge the different color coins and keep progressing. With no timer or pressure to trip you up, you’ll be able to sort, match, and merge the coins while also relaxing.
Fun features:
● Tons of coin types – In addition to your standard rainbow of coins to match, as you progress there will be all manner or fun new coins to keep things fresh. Hidden coins, linked coins, ice coins, and more await, so keep your eyes peeled!
● Easy on the eye – As colorful as this sorting puzzle is, the whole point is to help you chill so we’ve done away with any crazy graphics or flashing lights. This also means the game is great to play wherever you find yourself, solo or perhaps with a little helper.
● Relaxing to play – No countdown clock here! Take as much time on each puzzle as you need, and move the coins around as much as you want without being penalized. We believe in having fun, not getting stressed.
● Train your brain – Sorting and matching puzzles are a great way to train your brain to recognize patterns and colors, and to work on your logic and thinking skills as you test out different ways to group coins. And it doesn’t stop there, the skills you hone in the game can be applied to other stuff in real life.
● Keep growing – As you progress through the puzzle levels, more colors and coin types will be added, and things will get steadily more difficult. But no fear, even as you’re pushed to get better we’ve added plenty of fun boosters to keep it chill.
► GO ON A COLORFUL ADVENTURE
Ready to start your merge adventure? This relaxing game keeps your mind sharp while also providing a fun escape as you enjoy sorting and matching, so hop on in to become the master sorter and put all this stuff where it needs to be!
Download Pocket Sort: Coin Puzzle today to see how good you are at locating different colored coins and slotting them in together.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00127995:ios.summary: Du möchtest deinen Zyklus / deine Periode im Blick behalten? Oder deine fruchtbaren Tage, weil du schwanger werden möchtest? Mit der urbia Eisprungkalender-App von ELTERN hast du deinen Zyklus immer im Blick und kannst den Zeitpunkt der näc
bluejetty:00127995:ios.description:
Du möchtest deinen Zyklus / deine Periode im Blick behalten? Oder deine fruchtbaren Tage, weil du schwanger werden möchtest? Mit der urbia Eisprungkalender-App von ELTERN hast du deinen Zyklus immer im Blick und kannst den Zeitpunkt der nächsten Menstruation, des nächsten Eisprungs und deiner fruchtbaren Tage berechnen. 
Lade dir jetzt die urbia Eisprungkalender-App von ELTERN kostenlos herunter! Die App bietet dir einen Menstruations-/ Periodenkalender, Ovulationskalender, Fruchtbarkeitskalender und Eisprungrechner. Behalte deine Periode im Blick und nutze die praktische Tagebuchfunktion für deine Notizen. Außerdem findest du in der App alle wichtigen Informationen rund um das Thema Kinderwunsch und Gesundheit. So klappt es schneller mit dem Wunschkind.
Alle Funktionen auf einen Blick
• Errechne deinen persönlichen Eisprung und deine fruchtbaren Tage
• Self-Tracking (Sex, Periode, Blutungen, Ergebnisse von Ovulations- und Schwangerschaftstests) auf täglicher Basis
• Kalender-Ansicht für Folge-Monate
• Anzeigen der nächsten Periode
• Hilfreiche Experten-Artikel
• Austausch in Deutschlands größter Familien-Community
KALENDER
• Zykluskalender: Behalte deinen Zyklus im Blick, selbst, wenn die Zykluslänge variiert.
• Menstruationskalender (Period Tracker): Sehe und berechne den Zeitpunkt der vergangenen und nächsten Menstruationen.
• Eisprungkalender/ Fruchtbarkeitskalender: Berechne und dokumentiere Eisprung und fruchtbare Tage.
TAGEBUCH
• Persönliche Notizen und Dokumentation über die Tage, an denen du Sex hattest, Ergebnisse von Ovulationstests (positive Ovu-Tests werden in die Berechnungen einbezogen), Beobachtungen zum Zervix-Schleim oder Ergebnisse deiner Schwangerschaftstests.
• Wichtige Daten für die Planung deiner Schwangerschaft werden automatisch berechnet: Eisprung, Zeiten für Sex, wann Schwangerschafts- oder Ovulationstests möglich sind, Berechnung des möglichen Geburtstermins, Sternzeichen des Babys u.v.m.
RATGEBER
• Schwangerschafts- und Kinderwunsch Inhalte: kompetente Fachartikel aus Deutschlands größtem Familiennetzwerk
• Community: Urbia.de ist Deutschlands größte Familien-Community (mehr als 10.000 Beiträge täglich in unseren Foren und Clubs).
• Videos und Beiträge zum Thema Kinderwunsch, Folsäure, Fruchtbarkeit, Zyklus, Eisprung etc.
• Weitere Informationen zu deiner Gesundheit und hilfreiche Tipps um schwanger zu werden.
UND SO GEHT’S
Lade dir die urbia Eisprungkalender-App von ELTERN herunter, trage deine Zyklus-Daten ein und schon siehst du, wann du schwanger werden kannst. Der Eisprungkalender in der App zeigt dir die Entwicklung deiner Periode und deine fruchtbaren Tage an.
EXTRA FEATURES
Du kannst täglich deine Daten zur Menstruation, eingenommenen Folsäure, Beschaffenheit deines Zervixschleims und deine Ovulations- und Schwangerschaftstests-Ergebnis eintragen. 
EINFACHE BEDIENUNG
Die urbia Eisprungkalender-App von ELTERN ist einfach, schnell und unkompliziert. Du musst nur den Beginn deiner letzten Periode und deine Zykluslänge eingeben und schon siehst du, wann du fruchtbar bist und schwanger werden kannst. Du wünschst dir (noch) kein Baby und willst einfach nur wissen, wie regelmäßig dein Zyklus ist? Natürlich eignet sich die App auch hierfür!
FRUCHTBARE TAGE BERECHNEN
Durch unterschiedliche Symbole hast du in der Kalenderansicht deinen gesamten Zyklus im Blick. Du siehst deinen Eisprung und deine fruchtbaren Tage und kannst eintragen, wie hoch deine Körpertemperatur ist, wann du Sex hattest, wie deine Ovulations- und Schwangerschaftstests ausgefallen sind und wann du Folsäure eingenommen hast. Nach einem erfolgreichen Schwangerschaftstest kannst du so auch zurückverfolgen, wann das Wunschkind gezeugt wurde.
Du hast Fragen oder Anregungen? Dann schreibe und gerne eine E-Mail an parenting-apps@guj.de

bluejetty:00018975:ios.description:
A great helper app to keep track of your tabletop RPG character data.
Intended for people familiar with tabletop RPG games, this app has several features to help you with tracking your character's data:
- Keep track of all those numbers (all attributes in one convenient place)
- Automatically update data (all attributes are synced automatically when modified)
- Dice roller (a fancy way to roll any combination of dice you want)
- Journal (with the option to enter your own custom entries and features)
- Inventory (keep track of weight, gold, and several common items)
- Custom Shop (create your own custom items and share them between characters)
- Magic (track Mana by Value or Slots, and use notes for spells)
- Multiple characters support
- No ads! (because that would ruin your immersion)

bluejetty:00179377:ios.name: Beam of Magic – Roguelike RPG
bluejetty:00179377:ios.summary:
Beam of Magic is a multiplayer RPG game in which you explore dungeons and open-world locations, destroy a bunch of enemies, and fight bosses. You can play this exciting RPG multiplayer alone or in an online co-op with friends.
Magic Shoote
bluejetty:00179377:ios.description:
Beam of Magic is a multiplayer RPG game in which you explore dungeons and open-world locations, destroy a bunch of enemies, and fight bosses. You can play this exciting RPG multiplayer alone or in an online co-op with friends.
Magic Shooter Features:
- Huge map – fight against hordes of enemies in PvE mode on big locations. We are updating maps all the time, making gameplay more diverse and keeping you on your toes.
- Monsters and beasts – learn how to defeat scary creatures living in the dungeons and deep inside the forest. There’s going to be more and more of them! If you are on your own, things might get desperate. Invite friends to join the magic adventure and get to know this arcade hunter together.
- Level-up system – level up your hero over the course of the game. Choose one of three random perks that will define your tactics in this exciting RPG adventure.
- Challenging bosses – enjoy all the advantages of this magic shooter. Destroy big bosses and get a massive reward.
- Online multiplayer – play with other players or with your friends. Battle multiplayer mode can bring your gameplay to new heights! 
Looking for dope roguelike games? Stop right now, you’ve just found the game you’ve been looking for! Try it out online!
Beam of Magic is a top-down age-of-knight adventure with a choice of 3 random skills per level up. As you progress through the map, you will discover several different sections with multiple bosses. Each location brings a new inventory and equipment. Stronger enemies will spice up your progress in this PvE shooter.
Killing monsters together with other players makes it more fun. Action-adventure games online like this won’t let you get bored. Ready to impress everyone with your skills? 
Beam of Magic combines the best of fantasy games, magic RPG online, as well as dungeon games. Your way won’t be easy - follow it through multiple dungeons filled with monsters and treasure. 
Join thousands of players who have already started playing Beam of Magic - one of the best magic games out there. We continue to work on the gameplay, adding new locations and levels to keep it nice and fun.
Do you like PvE online, multiplayers, battle simulators, or games similar to “Enter the Gungeon”? Try Beam of Magic today to add a new title to your list of favorite games!

bluejetty:00062208:ios.description:
Fazilet Calendar continues to be a "Life Guide" for millions of Muslims around the world!
It respectfully offers everything a Muslim may need throughout the year, including prayer times, the Quran, Islamic jurisprudence, religious and moral guidance, supplications, a Qibla compass, and many more features, all presented with respect for religious values. Fazilet Calendar provides a personalized service with its simple, user-friendly design and ad-free experience.
Download now and meet your "Life Guide"!
Key Features:
*The Quran
- Read comfortably with the print-like Mushaf view.
- Quickly access any page, verse, or juz through the Quick Access menu.
- Bookmark and track any chapter, page, verse, or the last page you read.
*Reliable Prayer Times
- Accurately calculated prayer times based on Islamic scholars' principles and advanced technological precision.
- Timely notifications; customizable reminders to alert you of prayer times.
* Islamic Content with Utmost Care
- Fazilet Calendar is prepared with reliable content carefully selected from authentic sources in line with the Ahl al-Sunnah creed, featuring unique daily content. The content is renewed annually.
*Ramadan Timetable
-Follow sahur, iftar, and prayer times during the holy month of Ramadan, daily or monthly, without missing anything.
*Qibla Compass
-Easily find the correct direction with a highly accurate Qibla finder.
*Rich Calendar Features
- Track Islamic (Hijri) and Gregorian calendars, along with religious days and nights.
- See the countdown to upcoming blessed days and nights.
- Receive notifications for special days and learn recommended worship practices for these occasions.
* Library
-Access e-books like The Arabic Letters and Diacritics, A Concise Islamic Jurisprudence, and Some Recommended Supplications.
* Advanced Widget Support
- Customize and add dozens of widgets to your home screen.
* Support for Multiple Locations
-Automatically view prayer times for your current location via GPS or add multiple cities for easy switching.
* iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch Support

It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.

Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Range Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Range Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00185124:ios.description:
Movavi is your go-to reels maker and video editor for creating awesome content in just a few taps. Whether you're sharing a vlog, filming your workout, posting food recipes, showing off drinks and desserts, or promoting your small business, this video maker helps turn everyday clips into stylish reels fast – no editing experience needed.
TRENDING TEMPLATES FOR ANY VIBE
You don’t even have to edit yourself! Just pick a template and turn raw clips into scroll-stopping reels instantly.
 • Choose from dozens of templates for vlogs, food, sports, travel, and more
 • Add your clips – the reels maker builds your video automatically
 • Get social-ready videos with smooth transitions, dynamic motion, and cool music
 • Polish after applying a template – trim, rearrange clips, tweak transitions, apply filters
 • Add AI captions and customize fonts, style, and layout to match your vibe
SUPER-EASY VIDEO EDITOR
The video editor gives you everything you need to adjust your clips as you like – effortlessly.
 • Cut and trim clips to keep only the highlights
 • Add stylish transitions between parts
 • Apply atmospheric filters and adjust colors to set the perfect mood
 • Add eye-catching effects: lens flares, sparkles, retro, and much more
 • Speed up, slow down, or reverse clips to add motion
 • Crop and resize your vids for any social media format
TRENDING MUSIC AND SOUNDS
Make your reels not only look cool, but sound amazing too.
 • Choose trending tracks from the music library or add your own
 • Align music perfectly with your clips
 • Lower or mute the original sound
 • Record voiceovers 
AI CAPTIONS WITH EXTRA STYLES
Captions are a must for any reel! Add them automatically with AI, pick a design you like, and get people watching and liking your videos – even on mute.
 • Generate captions instantly – save time and boost engagement
 • Customize fonts and colors to match your video
 • Place captions anywhere on the screen
BUILT-IN PHOTO EDITOR
Movavi is more than a reels maker – it also includes a photo editor, perfect for creating eye-catching reel covers.
 • Apply stylish filters and creative effects
 • Remove background or swap the background with AI
 • Auto-enhance photos in seconds
 • Create collages with ready-made templates
EXPORT AND SHARE ANYWHERE
When your reel is ready share it instantly and get those likes.
 • Export in high quality, including 4K
 • Post directly to popular social platforms
 • Send your vids to friends, clients, or followers – make them go “wooow”
Try Movavi App today – and create awesome reels in a few taps.

Lost your AirPod again?
With Bluescan, you can find it in seconds.

- Smartwatches & Fitness Trackers – Easily locate your Apple Watch, Fitbit, or similar devices.

- Saves valuable time by finding devices in seconds.

- Works with a wide range of Bluetooth-enabled devices.
- Designed to give you peace of mind, wherever you are.
- Bluescan is more than just a tool — it’s your everyday companion for keeping track of the devices you love and depend on.
- Stop losing. Start finding — with Bluescan.

bluejetty:00128219:ios.description:
Smarthome-Even
Tanto pelo site da Even quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a Even, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para even@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00117406:android.description:
**🚗 Master the Streets: Ultimate City Car Racing 🚗** 
Get ready to experience the ultimate thrill of city driving! Dive into **Ultimate City Car Racing**, the most realistic driving game where you control the wheel from a detailed **first-person cockpit view**. Feel the adrenaline as you navigate through bustling city streets, race against other vehicles, and perform daring close calls! 
### 🏙️ **Key Features** 🏙️ 
- **Immersive Cockpit View**: Drive from inside the car for a truly lifelike experience. 
- **Dynamic Traffic Racing**: Dodge, weave, and race against fast-moving traffic. 
- **Perform Close Calls**: Show off your reflexes and earn rewards for near misses. 
- **Diverse City Environments**: Explore stunningly detailed urban landscapes. 
- **Realistic Driving Physics**: Experience smooth controls and authentic car behavior. 
- **Multiple Vehicles**: Choose from a variety of high-performance cars. 
### 🎯 **Test Your Skills** 🎯 
- **Traffic Challenges**: Can you navigate the busiest streets without crashing? 
- **Speed Racing**: Push the pedal to the metal and race against time or rivals. 
- **Precision Driving**: Maneuver through tight gaps and master tricky turns. 
### 🚦 **Why Play Ultimate City Car Racing?** 🚦 
- **Stunning Graphics**: Enjoy high-quality visuals and realistic cityscapes. 
- **Exciting Gameplay**: Endless challenges and goals to keep you engaged. 
- **Leaderboard Competition**: Compete with players worldwide and climb the ranks. 
🚘 **Fasten your seatbelt and ignite your passion for driving!** Whether you’re looking for an exciting racing experience or just love exploring the city behind the wheel, **Ultimate City Car Racing** is your go-to game. 
🛠️ **Download now and prove your driving skills in the ultimate city traffic adventure!**

bluejetty:00040149:ios.description:
Stronger by the Day is an easy-to-use fitness app for women who are serious about building strength and muscle. With expert coaching–by Meg Gallagher aka @megsquats–and personalized progress at their fingertips, our 25,000+ users have a science backed roadmap to getting and feeling stronger each session.
Our Flexibility Functions are proven to work with any busy schedule while avoiding wasted time on random workouts or unqualified coaches. Workouts are just one tap away; and while you’re working in the gym or at home, our Smart Progress Tracking tools adjust your next workout so you’re always moving forward.
PROVEN TRACK RECORD OF RESULTS
We have thousands of 5 star reviews from our app users:
– Over 25,000 active members
– Over 100,000+ lifters coached
– Thousands of PRs and progress made daily
– A roadmap for permanent results
– A free 7-day trial so you can see for yourself
FLEXIBLE ENOUGH TO FIT YOUR LIFESTYLE
Our Flexibility Functions fit your schedule and needs:
– Train on your schedule with our 3, 4, or 5 day options
– Quickie workouts on EXPRESS keep you on track
– Train from anywhere with our Bodyweight program
– Simple substitutions for any scenario
COACHED EVERY STEP OF THE WAY
This isn’t your typical fitness industry plan. We designed this app with intuitive guidance, ensuring you succeed:
– No digging around, your workout is just one tap away. 
– Built in tutorials deliver the expert cues you need, exactly when you need them.
– Your coach uncovers the “why” behind getting strong, one workout at a time.
GET STRONGER MINDLESSLY 
Planning science-backed strength gain takes a ton of time. We make the science backed plan, all you have to do is show up and get stronger.
– Our addictive progressions help you break past plateaus and keeps you coming back.
– Our progress trackers, strength scores, and intelligent calculators mean making progress is simple.
– While you train, we do the math.
Get a free 7-day trial when you download Stronger by the Day!
Download Today. PR Tomorrow.
