Our free psychic fortune telling app offers a variety of features, including tarot card readings, daily horoscopes, zodiac signs, palm readings, birth charts, and even fun quizzes! Discover what the future holds and unlock the mysteries of the universe with Kismet!
Kismet is a unique psychic fortune telling app that offers tarot card readings, daily horoscope or zodiac signs, free palm readings, birth chart, as well as personality tests. If you want a free and personal experience, download Kismet for free.
Tarot Card Reading: Tarot card reading is a psychic practice that makes use of tarot cards to gain insight about your past, present or future, depending on your questions. We will draw and read your tarot cards.
Free Palm Reading: Palmistry, also known as palm reading, is the practice of fortune telling through studying the palm and the lines on it. Palmistry is a part of our psychic and astrology app too, for free! Our fortune tellers mesmerize you!
Free, Daily, Weekly & Yearly Horoscope Readings: Would you like to read your daily horoscope? Or you may want to read weekly, monthly or yearly horoscopes since Kismet has all! Simply download our app and get personalized horoscope insights that could help you better understand your life and the challenges and opportunities that come your way. Whether you're seeking clarity for the day or planning ahead for the future, Kismet has got you covered with its accurate and insightful horoscope readings.
Angel Card Reading: Angel cards consist of 36 luminous angels that will assist and support you. Pick your cards and choose the topic that you want to get help from your angels, such as love, money and family. Then let our fortune tellers read your cards.
Zodiac Compatibility, Love Compatibility Between Zodiac Signs: We not only talk about your horoscope, but also talk about your loved one’s horoscope too! Explore the unique dynamic between you and your partner's zodiac signs and unlock insights into your relationship that you never knew before. Check if your zodiac signs are compatible now!
Birth Chart: Unlock the secrets of the universe with Kismet's free birth chart feature! Simply enter your birth date, time, and place to discover how the position of the stars and planets at your birth may influence your destiny. Our expert astrologers will interpret your chart and provide insight into your unique strengths and challenges. 
Games: You can also have fun playing classic hit games like Solitaire, Pipe Connect, and Word Ring, all while earning coins to enjoy free readings. Kismet's games section offers many options to suit all tastes, ensuring that you will never get bored while waiting for your reading! 
Quizzes: Kismet not only offers you a free unique psychic or astrology experience, but also offers you a fun experience, so you will never get bored while waiting for your tarot card reading or free palm reading! You can find quizzes that are related to any topic such as zodiac signs, horoscopes, personality tests! 
Daily Affirmations: We are not just an ordinary astrology or psychic fortune telling app! We want to help you in your daily life too! Check the affirmations page for free and you will be amazed how your life changes!
Dreams: Get insights from your dreams with dream interpreter and visualize them with dream painter.

bluejetty:00084714:ios.description:
Fast Track to Your Ticket
How can you buy your tickets even faster and get updates on your journey on top of that? You get it with the ÖBB App, round the clock, wherever you are. Take the train and take it easy.
The ÖBB App comes with the following features:
• Tickets for trains, buses, the metro and trams: book your ÖBB tickets & get exclusive online specials such as the Sparschiene Österreich discount fares. You can also book the city tickets and weekly or monthly tickets of Austrian regional transport operators
• Pay your fares on the go with SimplyGo! The handy add-on for the ÖBB App automatically identifies the routes you travelled and calculates the matching public transport fare for your complete journey
• Secure your favourite seat on the Railjet: use the graphic seat reservation
• Find the best fare: see the ÖBB train services sorted by lowest fare first
• ÖBB Account: conveniently and securely store your personal data and means of payment, save your favourite routes, and receive additional exclusive offers (e.g. the Vorteilscard 66 discount card)
We are continuously working on the app to enrich it with new features and improve the usability.
Further information: https://www.oebb.at/en/tickets-kundenkarten/online-mobile-ticketing/oebb-app

bluejetty:00180382:ios.description:
Welcome to the easiest way to shop with Pick n Pay.
Experience shopping like never before with our best app yet. Shop over 30 000 products across a wide range of categories including groceries, homeware, electronics, and more.
Enjoy exclusive deals, in-store pricing, Smart Shopper rewards, and fast delivery right to your doorstep. Whether you need groceries, homeware, or more, Pick n Pay asap! & Smart Shopper makes shopping easier than ever. Shop from the comfort of your home with super-fast delivery in just 60 minutes, smart AI search, and precise order tracking.
YOUR ONE-STOP GROCERY SHOP
From fresh fruit and veggies, dairy, frozen food, pantry staples, and home appliances, to pet care, electronics, health products, and even load shedding essentials, you’ll find over 30,000 products from all your favourite brands. Plus, enjoy alcohol delivery including liquor and wine.
ALL YOUR FAVOURITE BRANDS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Browse top brands like Nestlé, Coca-Cola, Pampers, and Simba. Whether it’s baby products, coffee, cheese, wine, or ready-made meals, you’ll find everything you need in one place. If it’s in-store, it’s on the app.
FRESH & FAST DELIVERY WITHOUT LEAVING HOME
Enjoy fresh, fast deliveries to over 400 destinations across South Africa, with orders sent from your nearest store. Our goal is to get your order to your door as quickly as possible, delivered in as little as 60 minutes for just R35 per order. With smart search tools, easy cart additions, and location services, you can shop, pay, and track your order with ease.
EARN AND SPEND YOUR SMART SHOPPER POINTS
Link your Smart Shopper card to the app and earn points on every order. You can now spend your Smart Shopper points on the app too.
BONUS POINTS AT OUR FEATURED PARTNERS
Earn Smart Shopper points when shopping at our featured partners like TymeBank, Netflorist, BP, and Europcar, as well as through programs like Momentum Multiply, Absa Rewards, and Standard Bank UCount Rewards.
EARN EBUCKS
Get up to 30% back in eBucks on every order.
EASY PAYMENT AND ORDERING
With quick and simple payment options, finishing your order is a breeze. Your shopper will carefully select your items, and a driver will deliver your order straight to your door. Get live updates on your order status through notifications.
MORE REWARDS WITH PICK N PAY CLUBS
Join our Pick n Pay Clubs and enjoy exclusive deals and competitions. From the Pick n Pay Wine Club to the Baby Club and Coffee Club, get additional savings, member-only offers, and even triple points on select products.
TOP-UP, DIGITAL RECEIPTS & MORE
Quickly top up airtime and data with prepaid options, and enjoy digital receipts sent straight to your inbox for easier tracking. No more paper clutter!
THE SMARTER WAY TO SHOP
The app offers a simpler, smarter way to shop. Get instant savings, personalised discounts, and rewards for every purchase. It’s your go-to app for savings, loyalty points, and hassle-free shopping!
GET STARTED NOW
Download the Pick n Pay asap! & Smart Shopper app today to unlock your rewards, and start enjoying easy, fast, and affordable shopping. Whether you're stocking up on groceries, getting essentials for home, or treating yourself to something special, Pick n Pay has you covered.

bluejetty:00068277:ios.description:
כלכליסט גאה להציג אפליקציה משופרת עם חוויית משתמש מתקדמת ומעולה. 
האפליקציה החדשה מהירה הרבה יותר וידידותית יותר למשתמש. שיפרנו משמעותית את הביצועים, שדרגנו את הגרפיקה, הוספנו פיצ'רים וקיצורי דרך לערוצים ייחודיים, והכל כדי לתת לכם חוויה כלכלית מתקדמת. 
באפליקציה תוכלו כמובן למצוא מגוון ערוצי תוכן כלכלי איכותי בהם שוק ההון, נדל"ן, חדשות מהעולם, משפט, פרסום ושיווק, פנאי ועסקי ספורט. גלישה נוחה בין הערוצים מתאפשרת באמצעות גלילה ימינה ושמאלה. גלילה מתאפשרת גם בין כתבות בתוך כל ערוץ. תרצו לשתף? כפתורי השיתוף נגישים עוד לפני הכניסה לכתבה עצמה. 
הפורטל הפיננסי יעדכן אתכם בכל דקה לגבי מצב הבורסות בתל אביב ובעולם, ותוכלו גם לבנות תיק אישי משלכם ולהתעדכן במצב המניות שמעניינות אתכם. 
גלישה נעימה, צוות כלכליסט 
תנאי שימוש: https://m.calcalist.co.il/Content/resources/documents/terms.html
מדיניות פרטיות: https://z.calcalist.co.il/mvc/long/2018/OrganizationalStructure/Policy/Privacy.html
====================================
Calcalist Online is proud to present its new application, offering users a cutting-edge financial experience.
The new application is more user-friendly, customizable and offers extensive sharing features.
The homepage offers clear and comprehensible headlines and live ticker data as well as a "most popular" list. 
The application has a variety of finance, economy and general channels, such as stock market reports, real estate, local and global current affairs, legal affairs, lifestyle and sports. 
A free scrolling feature allows easy navigation in the homepage and among the channels. Bold and accessible share buttons allow sharing without having to open new pages.
Our new application is easily customizable, and allows users to select channels and create favorite lists according to preference, on their devices. 
Regular, by-the-minute updates keep users updated on market activity on TASE and around the globe and users can create personal stock portfolios and receive updates on specific stock. 
The new Calcalist application offers users a one-click "Red Email" update feature in which they can share content, images and videos from newsworthy events.
Terms of Use: https://m.calcalist.co.il/Content/resources/documents/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://z.calcalist.co.il/mvc/long/2018/OrganizationalStructure/Policy/Privacy.html

bluejetty:00184812:ios.description:
"Seven (7): Endgame" is the sequel story to the successful interactive text thriller "Seven (7): Deadly Revelation", where you decide your own scary interactive story.
THE INTERACTIVE STORY OF SEVEN (7)
Just as you thought the horror is over and you could live in safety from now on, evil strikes again and threatens your and the life of your friends and family.
In this psycho episode of the Horror Text Thriller, a stranger contacts you and forces you to decide about life and death. He hunts you down and threatens the important people in your life with twisted mind games. Follow the clues hidden in pictures, text messages, documents and in the calls of the psycho strangers. Find out who is hiding behind the mask and save the lives of your friends.
He has them all in his sights:
Your girlfriend, your family and your friends.
Who is the one playing these psycho horror games on you?
Who is the one sending you all these scary messages?
Who is the one turning your life into a psycho horror story?
YOU DECIDE THE MESSAGES, YOU INFLUENCE THE GAMES COURSE
How you decide has an impact on the course and the end of this scary episode of the interactive horror story. So you can actively determine the story and influence your relationship to the different characters. It’s even up to you to decide who will survive in the end. 
CHARACTERS AND RELATIONSHIPS
In Seven (7) you can directly decide how to interact with the people in your life. Every text message and every time you decide influences the relationship you have with all the characters. The interactive thriller game will force you to choose between people and let some of them get lost in the scary depths of this horror story.
THE INTERACTIVE GAMEPLAY OF SEVEN (7)
Dive into the deepest abyss of the human soul and solve a variety of exciting tasks, puzzles and mini games. Seven (7): Endgame is a roller coaster ride of feelings and it’s up to you to fight an unpredictable psycho to save the lives of your friends and family! You will receive and send text messages that will directly influence the course of this interactive horror game. You can choose which way the story of the game will go by interacting with the individual characters and facing the psycho that threatens the ones closest to you.
ADDITIONAL GAME INFORMATION
This psych episode of the Horror Messenger Chat Thriller is completely free to play!
Optional In-app purchases can accelerate the course of the story and game.

bluejetty:00080857:ios.description:
Unleash your creativity — visually create, design, and edit just about anything you can imagine with AI. Use the power of generative AI to create eye-catching images with your words, craft next-level designs that pop like personalized birthday cards, holiday cards, wallpapers for your phone, and even use AI to edit photos like an expert - removing backgrounds and erasing distractions from photos. Create what you want, when and where you need it. 
Key capabilities: 
• Images: Create any image you can imagine. Sci-fi art, surreal scenes, funny images? Dream it, describe it, and create it with AI. Your imagination is limitless! 
• Stickers: Create something that sticks. Make custom stickers that help you stick out on messaging apps, social, and more. 
• Edit with AI: make your photos and images picture perfect with AI. 
 o Generative erase: Erase distractions to make objects you don’t want in your image disappear. 
 o Remove background: Say bye-bye to bad backgrounds. Easily remove unwanted image backgrounds in one step. 
 o Blur background: Bring what’s most important into focus. Blur the background of any image to make your subject pop. 
 o Add filters, adjust brightness, resize: Customize to fit your creative vision, including resizing to turn your creations into a square or custom size that fits just right. 
• Wallpapers/Backgrounds: Put it all on display. Create custom wallpaper or background to fit your current mood, make a statement, or to keep a special occasion front and center on your phone screen. 
• Greeting cards: Craft the perfect greeting for any occasion. From birthday cards to holiday cards and beyond, create a thoughtful greeting card with personalized messages and images even if you’re at a loss for words. 
• Restyle image: Transform photos into a work of art—like turning portraits, landscapes, and pet photos into artwork. 
• Monograms: Make your mark. Add some personal pop to your everyday life or for a special occasion like a wedding with custom crafted monograms that use letters and more to define your mark.
• Invitations: Create invitations that wow. Customize your invitations for every occasion and any event like birthdays, weddings, and anything else big or small. 
• Social posts: Stand out online. Elevate and craft your next social post with Designer to create the perfect image and text to share online. 
• Icons: Express yourself visually. Create icons to easily communicate your vision and decorate your designs. 
• Emojis: Express yourself! Have the perfect reaction on hand with custom crafted emojis to fit any mood. 
• Coloring book pages: Color it in and get in your flow. Create custom coloring book pages to make coloring more exciting. Great for all ages. 
• Frame image: Turn your photos into a customized framed memory that you can share everywhere. 
• Collages: Bring your favorite photos, styles, and descriptions together create a custom collage from your favorite memories. 
• Banners: Create banners for newsletter headers, social profiles, and more to grab attention and stand out. 
Microsoft Designer is available for free with a Microsoft account. Your Microsoft account provides 5 GB of free cloud storage that you can use to save your designs, files, and photos across your devices. 
Additional information about terms of use can be found here: https://designer.microsoft.com/consumerTermsOfUse/en-US/consumerTermsOfUse.pdf 
Download Designer and create something new today!

bluejetty:00015104:ios.name: Christmas Games for Kids
bluejetty:00015104:ios.summary:
Full version- *no additional purchases required*
Christmas is here and it’s time for some fun with Christmas trains and Santa games in the Christmas Games for Kids App Full version! This entertaining and imagination evoking app was desig
bluejetty:00015104:ios.description:
Full version- *no additional purchases required*
Christmas is here and it’s time for some fun with Christmas trains and Santa games in the Christmas Games for Kids App Full version! This entertaining and imagination evoking app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play. The Christmas train sounds will keep you entertained while you delve into different Christmas worlds with music and train horn sounds. Then jump into those different worlds and help Santa collect sweet and fun items in the exciting platform jumping game. The icing on this app is the Christmas ABC book, which will delight all ages with 26 different Christmas themed pictures. If you love Christmas then hop on board for some true holiday fun with the Christmas Games for Kids App Full version!
Build A Snowman
Building a snowman is fun, but have you ever built a police snowman, or a snow princess? This entertaining game will keep little ones delighted as they tap and build a snow fireman, fairy, baseball player, pirate, and more! Make magic happen when you tap the screen, hear cute music and a sound when they are done.
Christmas Train Sounds
Jingle toot toot! Everyone thrills to see a Christmas train and with 5 interactive sounds to delight and entertain you you’re sure to have a blast! The trains are all ready for Christmas and they take you into different holiday inspired worlds as they drive by. Also on the page are more cute Christmas things to tap and hear what sound they make, including Christmas tunes. These Christmas train sounds will delight all train lovers and everyone who loves the holidays!
Santa Reindeer Games
Santa needs help! He’s busy at this time of year and needs help to collect some things he likes and might have misplaced, like his favorite cookies and his reindeer. Each exciting game takes you into a different world, the same cute Christmas worlds as the sounds, as you use the platforms to make Santa jump and collect his items, while listening to boppy Christmas music. Every game has a different amount to collect and when you find everything Santa needs then you get a sound reward because Santa thinks you’re great! It’s an interactive and fun game that is sure to get you into the Christmas spirit.
Christmas ABC Book
Santa loves to read as much as he loves trains so he knows you’ll adore the Christmas ABC book! Filled with cute Christmasy pictures that will make your Christmas spirit sing this fun book will delight all holiday lovers. Of course Santa knows the building blocks to reading are letter recognition and seeing how the letter is pronounced in a word, so he wants all potential elves to have fun learning letters in this Christmas inspired book. 
Present Tap
Who doesn't love to open presents? In this delight-filled game your little one taps the present to reveal the toy inside. But the real fun is they never know how many times they have to tap it or what it's going to do before it opens! And after the toy pops out they can tap it to hear what sound it makes. Pure Christmas fun!
Sound the Christmas train horns and whistles and have a delight-filled time playing with trains, reindeer's, and Santa games in the Christmas Games for Kids App Full version, where learning through play encourages you to have fun while sharpening imagination, skills, and letter recognition. If you love Snowmen, Christmas and Santa and fun this is the app for you!

bluejetty:00023617:ios.name: Afterplace
bluejetty:00023617:ios.summary:
An open world adventure game filled with silly characters and terrible secrets.
Afterplace is an adventurous indie game for mobile devices. It's a huge open world, full of hidden secrets, treasures, and creatures. You'll run around the woo
bluejetty:00023617:ios.description:
An open world adventure game filled with silly characters and terrible secrets.
Afterplace is an adventurous indie game for mobile devices. It's a huge open world, full of hidden secrets, treasures, and creatures. You'll run around the woods, fight monsters, and talk to ostensibly shady characters! All from your pocket! Be warned though - you never know what the forest might be hiding, and not all trails are paved. Labyrinths and dungeons are tucked away in the most concealed nooks. There are no waypoints in Afterplace. You'll have to forge your own path.
Afterplace has been designed from the ground up to be a fast, fluid, beautiful experience for mobile. There are no virtual buttons. You can move and attack by touching anywhere. You can tap objects directly to interact or attack, use two thumbs like a traditional controller, or control the game with a physical gamepad. The game will adapt dynamically to your play style. Pick up and set down the game at your own pace, it will always save your progress. Afterplace is made to feel like a full-fledged indie adventure game that fits in your pocket.
About the Author:
Afterplace is made by one person, Evan Kice. A former software engineer from Austin TX, Evan quit his job (to the dismay of his friends and family) and has been working full time on Afterplace since early 2019. The initial game released in December of 2022, but Evan plans on continuing to support and polish the game when he can!

bluejetty:00115903:ios.summary:

Unleash your inner barista puzzle master with Coffee Craft! Immerse yourself in a vibrant world of aromatic coffee and strategic tray stacking.

bluejetty:00115903:ios.description:
Brew Your Way to Bliss! Master the Art of Coffee Stacking & Matching.
Unleash your inner barista puzzle master with Coffee Craft! Immerse yourself in a vibrant world of aromatic coffee and strategic tray stacking. 
Your mission: untangle the colorful chaos and brew your way to victory!
In Coffee Craft, you’ll face a delightful challenge:
1. Strategic Tray Selection: Click and select trays of various colors from the candidate zone.
2. Upward Ascent: As you tap, trays ascend to the upper holding area, which has a limited capacity of six. Plan your moves carefully!
3. Automatic Coffee Matching: Watch as different colored coffees from the top pipes automatically seek out and pair with matching colored trays in your holding area.
4. Satisfying Cascades: Once a coffee fills a tray, it’s a match made in coffee heaven – and it’s cleared!
5. Clear the Board, Win the Brew: Eliminate all coffees and trays on the board to conquer the level and move on to the next delicious challenge.
Master the Coffeehouse Grid
- Hundreds of Handcrafted Levels: Explore a vast array of uniquely designed levels with increasing difficulty, ensuring endless hours of engaging gameplay.
- Hypnotic Color Theory: Experience a visually stunning feast of vibrant colors and smooth animations that are as soothing as a perfectly brewed latte.
- Relaxing, Timeless Play: Enjoy a stress-free progression with no timers, allowing you to strategize and play at your own pace.
- ASMR-Worthy Animations & Soothing Sounds: Every tap, match, and cascade is accompanied by delightful visual effects and calming audio, creating a truly immersive and therapeutic experience.
Why You’ll Love Coffee Craft:
• Brain-Teasing Puzzles: Hundreds of challenges designed to test your logic, strategy, and color-matching skills.
• Visually Stunning: A rich, inviting color palette and smooth animations that are a treat for the eyes.
• Calm & Stress-Free: Immerse yourself in a peaceful puzzle environment with no pressure, just pure enjoyment.
• Satisfying Moments: Experience the joy of perfect matches and cascading eliminations that are incredibly rewarding.
Can you craft the ultimate coffee masterpiece? Download Coffee Craft now and transform simple ingredients into chromatic harmony!

bluejetty:00041479:ios.description:
الخرائط السياحية — كل ما تحتاجه لرحلتك في مكان واحد
لا تضيع وقتك بين عشرات المواقع والتطبيقات للبحث عن الأماكن وترتيب برنامج رحلتك. مع الخرائط السياحية نوفر لك محتوى سياحيًا جاهزًا ومنظمًا يساعدك على التخطيط بسهولة، واكتشاف أجمل الأماكن، والاستفادة من كل يوم في رحلتك.
اختر وجهتك واترك علينا مهمة البحث والترتيب.
لماذا الخرائط السياحية؟
• نوفر عليك ساعات من البحث عن الأماكن وترتيب الرحلة.
• نجمع لك أجمل وأهم الأماكن السياحية في وجهتك داخل خرائط منظمة وسهلة الاستخدام.
• نساعدك على اكتشاف أماكن وتجارب مميزة قد لا تصل إليها بسهولة بالبحث التقليدي.
• نقدم لك جداول سياحية جاهزة لتنظيم أيام رحلتك بدل البدء بالتخطيط من الصفر.
• نوفر مسارات سفر مدروسة تساعدك على التنقل بين المدن والوجهات بطريقة أكثر تنظيمًا.
• نقدم أدلة سياحية مختارة لتكون المعلومات والترشيحات التي تحتاجها أقرب إليك أثناء السفر.
• نوفر بكجات متكاملة تناسب المسافر الذي يزور عدة دول ومدن في رحلة واحدة.
نبذه عن منتجات المتجر:
• الخرائط السياحية
خرائط جاهزة تضم مجموعة كبيرة من الأماكن المختارة والمصنفة، تشمل المعالم السياحية، الطبيعة، الإطلالات، القرى، المطاعم، المقاهي، المخابز، الأسواق، التسوق والتجارب المميزة وغيرها.
• الجداول السياحية
برامج يومية جاهزة لأشهر الوجهات، يتم فيها توزيع الأماكن على أيام الرحلة وترتيبها بطريقة عملية لتساعدك على الاستمتاع بوقتك وتقليل التنقل قدر الإمكان.
• المسارات السياحية
مسارات مقترحة للرحلات بين المدن والدول تساعدك على معرفة ترتيب الوجهات وبناء رحلة متكاملة بطريقة أسهل.
• الأدلة السياحية
أدلة ومعلومات وترشيحات تساعدك على التعرف على وجهتك والتخطيط لها قبل السفر والاستفادة منها أثناء الرحلة.
• البكجات السياحية
مجموعات متكاملة من المنتجات والوجهات، مناسبة للرحلات الطويلة أو لمن يرغب في الوصول إلى محتوى سياحي لعدة دول ومدن.
ماذا ستجد في خرائطنا؟
• أشهر المعالم والأماكن السياحية.
• أجمل القرى والمدن والوجهات الطبيعية.
• البحيرات والشلالات والجبال والإطلالات.
• المطاعم والمقاهي والمخابز والحلويات.
• الأسواق ومراكز التسوق والأوتلت.
• الأماكن المناسبة للعائلات والأطفال.
• التجارب والأنشطة والأماكن المميزة.
• الكثير من الأماكن المختارة التي تجعل اكتشاف وجهتك أسهل.
بدل أن تبدأ كل رحلة بساعات من البحث وحفظ عشرات المواقع والأماكن، ستجد لدينا محتوى جاهزًا يساعدك على معرفة أين تذهب، ماذا تزور، وكيف ترتب رحلتك.
وجهات متعددة، ومنتجات سياحية متنوعة، ومحتوى يتم تطويره وإضافة الجديد إليه باستمرار.
خطط أقل، اكتشف أكثر، واستمتع بكل لحظة في رحلتك.
الخرائط السياحية
دليلك الذكي والأسهل.

bluejetty:00091898:ios.summary: Founded in 2005 by CEO Tim McEnery, Cooper’s Hawk was built upon the belief that food and wine hold the power to forge lasting connections. Our portfolio currently includes 49 Cooper’s Hawk Winery & Restaurant locations, the Cooper’s Hawk W
bluejetty:00091898:ios.description:
Founded in 2005 by CEO Tim McEnery, Cooper’s Hawk was built upon the belief that food and wine hold the power to forge lasting connections. Our portfolio currently includes 49 Cooper’s Hawk Winery & Restaurant locations, the Cooper’s Hawk Wine Club, and two “by Cooper’s Hawk” brands – Esquire and Piccolo Buco. Cooper’s Hawk wines have won over 600 awards and are the Official Wines of the Screen Actors Guild® Awards.
The Cooper’s Hawk mobile app was created to make it easy for Cooper’s Hawk Wine Club Members to engage with their Club benefits, which include exclusive content and a new gifting feature, only available on the app! Users who are not a Member can still register for the app to explore our locations, menus, wines, wine-tasting experiences, and the Wine Club. 
MEMBERS: Log into your Wine Club account to get the most out of your membership! If you have never set up your online login credentials, please go to “Create An Account” first.
NOT A MEMBER: You can log in if you already have an account created on our Carryout online ordering site. If not, go to “Create an Account” or “Join our Wine Club”!
Highlights of main features:
- HOME: The feather icon will always take you Home. Easy access to “Make a Reservation”, Wine Club Member Card, reminders/news, Our Wines with Tasting Notes, and other features.
- RESERVATIONS: Fewer steps because your name, phone number, and favorite location will be pre-populated!
- MENU (WITH WINE PAIRING): Browse the menu for Cooper’s Hawk Winery & Restaurants including Chef Recommendations, each item with a photo and wine-pairing recommendation. 
- JOIN THE WINE CLUB: Learn about all the benefits that come with a Wine Club membership! You can sign up on the app and use your benefits right away!
- LOCATIONS: Explore, find, and heart a location. View photos, the address, hours, phone numbers, upcoming events, and more! Share a location and get directions. 
- ACCOUNT: Track your Wine Club points, bottles, rewards, tastings, and more. You can also update your profile and adjust your membership.
- WINE (WITH TASTING NOTES): Show available wines in your Member account and your pickup history. Each wine clicks to Tasting Notes for your reference! Not a Member? Join our Wine Club.
- MEMBER CARD: Easy access to your electronic Member card (card icon on the top right-hand corner) on the Home screen
- ORDER CARRYOUT: For Members, you will be seamlessly linked to our carryout site without having to log in, and you will be able to add your wine club bottle to your order and take advantage of your carryout discount, plus earn points!
- INSIDER GIFTING: Members will be able to purchase a Wine of the Month and “text” or email it to a friend, letting them know that they can pick up or enjoy the exclusive gift bottle at any of our locations. 
For the best experience, use the latest version of iOS. The app is supported on the two most recent major iOS versions and newer.

bluejetty:00099038:android.description:
Welcome to the magical world of Fantasy Tile: Sliding Match! In this colorful adventure, you'll experience a feast for the eyes and mind, effortlessly sliding tiles and reveling in the joy of elimination! This game not only tests your observation and reaction skills but also invites you to explore a puzzle world filled with creativity and fun.
In the game, dozens of beautifully designed tile icons await your challenge—from adorable shoes and fresh fruits to mouthwatering delicacies, each one comes to life, beckoning you to partake in a marvelous matching feast. Just slide your finger gently across the screen to cleverly align matching tiles, then tap on them to make them disappear in a dazzling display of colors, bringing you unparalleled satisfaction!
The level design is rich and varied, with each stage presenting unique goals and challenges for you to conquer. As you progress, you'll encounter increasingly complex arrangements and combinations, pushing your logical thinking and strategic planning skills to the limit. Use your intellect to find the best elimination paths, create chain reactions, and earn higher scores and rewards!
Additionally, the game features a powerful item system to lend you a helping hand. When you hit a wall in a particular level, consider using the rearrange item to shuffle the tiles, disrupting the existing layout and creating more opportunities for elimination. Meanwhile, the hint item will provide you with valuable advice when you need assistance, guiding you toward the optimal elimination strategy to help you breeze through levels and enjoy the game even more.
Whether you're a casual player or a challenge-seeker aiming for high scores, Fantasy Tile: Sliding Match offers endless fun and a sense of achievement. Join this magical elimination adventure today! In this world filled with surprises and challenges, every slide is a new miracle, and every elimination is a joyful release!

bluejetty:00075574:ios.description:
Finding real love is tough. Saying "I love you" to your loved one is even tougher. Being in a lasting relationship with your partner is the toughest. But checking your love score with your heartthrob is easy with this love tester app. It is usually said "Life is the flower for which love is the honey." Love is the greatest power in existence. Its presence can be deeply felt wherever it resides. When someone is in love, they realize love can overcome everything and can magnificently transform intricate situations to the better. Having a soulmate in life makes everything beautiful. The great difficulty of love, however, is that it is challenging to find the right words to express what you are feeling, and to find out whether what you are feeling is actually "ove". Having a lasting relationship with your soulmate is a dream everyone has. No one really wants a loveless life. Being liked by your heartthrob is the ultimate gift of life. Having a compatible relationship with unrequited love life is something we all work towards.Looking to find out if you are in love with someone? If you are, this love test calculator app is exactly what you are looking for.
We all want "love" in our lives, we crave for "true love" in our partners. In this fun love calculator, all you have to do is enter your name and the name of your lover. And within few seconds, you and your sweetheart will receive a score. You will be able to see your score just after entering your names in the love tester app. The love tester helps you realize if you already are at compatible level with this partner or if your love situation right needs a little more work from both of you. And the best part is you will be able to share the love test result with anyone you wish using the share option through the social media channels.
Looking to find out if you are in love with someone? Or how love-able you are? Or want to see if there is a love line? Is there a chance of a potential relationship? Try this love test calculator app is exactly what you are looking for.Do you want to check the love percentage with your heartthrob? To check what you are feeling is actually mad love or just an infatuation. Take this fun, just for entertainment, love calculator quiz and check what the reading says in the love meter. Love Tester app is designed with the unique motto, that is to find real love by checking love score through love name match.
Having a true love from your soulmate is nothing short of a blessing. If you are wondering How many times I can take the fun love quiz to check the compatibility with your heartthrob ?
You can take the quiz as many times as you like. You can take the love test as and when you want. The app offers unlimited access to all users. This allows you to take the love quiz again even for the same partner. We are constantly in the process of adding more content and features to our app. Our aim is to ensure that you never get bored even if you take the test the tenth time.
If you think you have any suggestions or any feature request to make this match compatibility calculator test better or if you just want to say hi, please reach out to us at happyverseapp@gmail.com. Go ahead and have fun with this cupid love tester game! 
Disclaimer: Please note this love tester app has been developed only for fun, entertainment purposes and has no intention to hurt any user's feelings whatsoever. The application uses numerical algorithm to determine love match based and should be used only for fun.

bluejetty:00120688:ios.description:
The Ultimate Coding Playground for Kids Ages 4-7!
Tynker Junior is the award-winning app specifically designed for young learners, including pre-readers who haven’t even started school yet. Through vibrant, word-free picture blocks, your child will learn to solve problems, compose music, and create art—all with the power of code.
Why Parents and Teachers Love Tynker:
* Trusted Globally: Used by 1 out of every 3 U.S. K-8 schools and 100,000+ schools worldwide.
* Proven Success: Over 60 million kids in 150 countries have started their STEM journey with Tynker.
* Designed for Little Hands: A tap-based interface with friendly voiceovers and no complex dragging or reading required.
5 EPIC CODING ADVENTURES
With 200+ coding challenges, your child will explore:
Ocean Odyssey: Master sequencing and patterns while helping Gillie the Goldfish.
Robots: Learn about events and parameters as you fix a wacky robot factory.
Wild Rumble: Help endangered animals using counting loops and delays.
Puffball Panic: Navigate dynamic environments using conditional logic.
Super Squad: Defeat villains and retrieve stolen treasure using advanced problem-solving.
WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN
Tynker Junior transforms screen time into a brain-building workout. Your child will master:
Logic & Sequencing: Understanding cause and effect.
Critical Thinking: Solving complex puzzles step-by-step.
Programming Concepts: Loops, conditional logic, and debugging.
21st Century Skills: Resilience, focus, and algorithmic thinking—the same foundations used in professional languages like Swift and Python.

bluejetty:00033714:ios.name: Notebook Artillery
bluejetty:00033714:ios.summary:
Apple called it "sketchy — in a good way." Multiple-time Game of the Day in 80+ countries. Nintendo Force gave it 8.5/10. And it started as a doodle.
Once upon a time in a middle school computer lab, a student ignored every assignment for
bluejetty:00033714:ios.description:
Apple called it "sketchy — in a good way." Multiple-time Game of the Day in 80+ countries. Nintendo Force gave it 8.5/10. And it started as a doodle.
Once upon a time in a middle school computer lab, a student ignored every assignment for an entire semester to fire cannons at a friend. That student grew up, spent 20 years making games professionally, and eventually decided the world needed a proper love letter to that wasted time. This is it.
Notebook Artillery is a hand-drawn artillery game inspired by the classic Mac game that got confiscated off school computers everywhere. Set your angle. Load your powder. Fire. Account for the wind. Try not to hit your own tower.
Play your way:
Solo target practice — break floating targets across randomly generated stages
VS CPU — take on a computer opponent
Local multiplayer — challenge someone in the same room
What makes it feel different:
Every frame hand-drawn in Procreate — ruled lines, coil binding, pencil textures, the whole notebook aesthetic
Trees splinter. Towers explode. Cannonballs collide mid-air.
Wind changes everything. Read the flag. Use your shot trails.
Unlock stickers by pulling off feats — first-shot eliminations, mid-air collisions, and yes, accidentally destroying your own tower
Randomly generated stages mean no two games play the same
Made by one person, with audio by Kevin Samuels and Switch/console ports by PolyCrunch Games.
No AI tools were used in making this game. All art hand-drawn. Developed in GameMaker Studio.

Download the Ralphs grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout

 • Add your Rewards Card Card to Apple Wallet

Helpful Everyday Tools

bluejetty:00126564:ios.description:
Zoiper is an easy to use sip video softphone, with excellent voice quality and easy to setup.  
Feel free to contact us with support questions or for more information on whitelabel solutions.
Connect Zoiper to your PBX or voip provider and make crystal clear, echo free, voice or video calls through wireless and 3g.  
Zoiper works flawlessly in the background and is optimized to use as little battery as possible while ensuring the reliability of incoming calls.  
Use bluetooth to pair the Zoiper SIP softphone to your car audio system or your headset and enjoy voip on the go.
  This softphone comes with a built in QR code scanner for 1 click account configurations. Never type account details and credentials again! 
Try it for 7 days free! Subscription is not charged if cancelled within trial period. Please note that the in-app subscription purchases are not supported through Family Sharing.
1-Year Subscription: $9.99, 1 month $0.99 USD, automatically renewed until cancelled by the user.
Additional Subscription Information:
• Subscriptions will be automatically renewed within 24-hours prior to following subscription period. Please check user's Account Setting to disable the auto-renewal.
Features:
 - Call waiting
- Call transfer
- Call statistics  
- Call recording
- Conference calls
- Instant messaging (SIP simple)
- Presence (SIP simple)
- Encryption (TLS / ZRTP)
Supported codecs:
 - g.711 (ulaw/alaw)
- OPUS
- G722
- G.722.1
- G.722.1C
 - Speex
 - iLBC
 - gsm 
- g.729*
 - vp8 
- h264*
  * The 3rd party patented codecs h264 and g729 are available as optional in app purchase.    
Zoiper is also available as an OEM / whitelabel solution license and can be customized on demand.
Be sure to configure ios to allow notifications for incoming calls for Zoiper and provide access to the contact list.
For more information on Zoiper’s features, please visit: https://www.zoiper.com/en/products/zoiperios
Terms of use: https://www.zoiper.com/en/zoiper-general-terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.zoiper.com/en/zoiper-privacy-policy

• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00018250:ios.summary: The PGCFCU App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organiz
bluejetty:00018250:ios.description:
The PGCFCU App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Bill Discovery: The app will automatically identify bills within your list of transactions and display a reminder to you when upcoming bills are due.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Prince George's Community FCU customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the PGCFCU App, you must be enrolled as a Prince George's Community FCU Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00161444:ios.summary:
# Simple notepad & memo. Take notes, shopping list, to-do list, calendar, reminder

bluejetty:00161444:ios.description:
# Simple notepad & memo. Take notes, shopping list, to-do list, calendar, reminder
WeNote - Notes,To-do,Calendar is a simple and awesome note taking app. You can create color notes, to do lists, shopping lists, reminders, and calendars quickly.
Users love WeNote® as their life organizer, work planner, or study note app. Note taking with WeNote® is easier than any other notepad, memo app.
When you write down memos, emails, phone numbers, messages, cooking recipes, diary, journal, shopping lists, and to do list, you will realize this is a good notes taking app.
WeNote® is a privacy-focused notepad. WeNote® can work offline perfectly, even without an Internet connection. No login is required.
Lock notes and to do list via PIN, pattern, password, or fingerprint, to protect confidential information.
# How to Take a Note?
WeNote® can act as a simple word processing app. You can type unlimited characters. After saving the note, you can pin it to the top screen, check off, password lock, share or delete through the menu. 
# How to Make Todo List or Shopping List?
In to-do list mode, you can add an unlimited checklist. Arrange their order with a simple tap and move. When finishing with an item, you can perform a simple tap to strikethrough it.
# Features
• Create color notes and todo list
• Organize memo using label & color
• Labels designed as tabs, to let you swipe between notes at blazing fast speed
• Attach photos and images into notebook
• Voice recording allows hands-free note taking. You can add unlimited voice recordings into notepad
• Pin important notes to the top. You will not miss out on any important thing
• Place a sticky note widget on your Home Screen. View and access your note directly from Home Screen
• Secure lock notes and keep them private
• The completed to-do list will move to the bottom of the checklist
• Customize notes via various fonts, viewing modes, sorting modes
• 13 different app color themes to make notebook looks great
• Unlimited notes color choices
• Reminders memo and calendar
• Powerful notes reminder. Notepad able to repeat daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, and highly customizable. Never miss anything from the notebook
• Show holidays on the calendar notes, which supports up to 250 countries, 3,680 states & provinces
• Secure sync to iCloud. Never lose any notes
• Local backup and restore to keep notes safe
• Share notes to email, SMS, social networking & messaging apps
• Undo/ redo enables mistake correction during note typing
• Convert URL and phone number to clickable links
• Export notes to PDF
• Search notes and todo list, instantly
# Color Notes
This notebook can categorize notes into different colors. Manage notes with 12 pre-defined beautiful colors. WeNote® also provides an unlimited favorite color.
# Notes Category
WeNote® allows you to categorize notes by creating labels. Labels can display as Tabs.
# Calendar Memo
This notepad has a calendar. You can write a memo and create a reminder in the calendar.
Due to its remarkable easy-to-use built-in calendar, you can use WeNote® as agenda planner and family organizer. Either plan next trip itinerary or schedule business meetings.
# Secure Lock to Keep Notebook Private
This notepad can secure lock and keep notes private. Either lock a note or lock the entire app to keep the notebook safe.

bluejetty:00068956:ios.summary: Laoshi is a complete app for learning Mandarin Chinese: smart flashcards built for characters, tones and grammar, with real handwriting practice, pronunciation scored for sound and tone separately, and ready-made decks for every major Chine
bluejetty:00068956:ios.description:
Laoshi is a complete app for learning Mandarin Chinese: smart flashcards built for characters, tones and grammar, with real handwriting practice, pronunciation scored for sound and tone separately, and ready-made decks for every major Chinese textbook.
Join 300,000+ learners who use Laoshi to build vocabulary, master grammar, prepare for the HSK exam and make progress every day.
Laoshi is a Red Dot Design Award 2021 winner and a HICOOL 2025 winner.
Chinese works differently. Understanding a character isn't enough — you have to memorise it and write it by hand, and it fades fast. That's why spaced repetition sits at the core of Laoshi: it brings a word back exactly when it starts slipping, and locks it in through writing. Tones need pronunciation training, grammar needs clear explanations. Laoshi brings all of it together in one focused app.
Why learners choose Laoshi:
• Real handwriting practice — Don't just read Chinese. Write it. Draw characters with correct stroke order on your phone and strengthen recognition through active recall.
• Pronunciation and tone scoring, character by character — Say a whole sentence and every character comes back with two scores: one for pronunciation, one for the tone. The slip is named in words — a syllable you dropped, a tone that shifts before the next word. Listen to the reference, then play back your own take.
• Textbook decks, chapter by chapter — 4,300+ ready-made word lists covering 66 Chinese textbook series, including Standard Course HSK, Integrated Chinese, Developing Chinese, Boya Chinese, New Practical Chinese Textbook and Road to Success. Open your book, pick your chapter, start learning.
• HSK 2.0 and HSK 3.0 coverage — Vocabulary and grammar aligned with both official exam standards, including the advanced 7–9 band.
• Flashcards built for Chinese — Tones, pinyin, meanings, example sentences and character writing in one learning flow.
• Complete Chinese grammar section — 756 grammar points with clear explanations and practical examples, from beginner to advanced.
• Spaced repetition system (SRS) — Scientifically optimised review intervals help you retain vocabulary up to 3x longer.
• 30,000+ word lists and thematic decks — HSK lists, textbook decks and topic-based vocabulary, including preparation for the CSCA, China's standardised admission exam for international students.
• Import and create decks — Bring lists from Anki, Quizlet or Pleco, or create and share your own.
• Stroke order worksheets — Print any deck as a handwriting worksheet in one click.
• Progress tracking — Monitor your HSK level, daily goals and long-term growth.
Whether you are preparing for the HSK exam, applying to study in China, or simply learning Chinese for yourself, Laoshi gives you structure, clarity and tools that make vocabulary, characters and grammar stick.
What learners say in the App Store:
"I find Chinese challenging and fascinating at the same time... The structure of presenting knowledge and the method applied are just great. If you're serious about learning, look no further than Laoshi." - Playfull Orca
"Well designed and structured, helping students to build a solid foundation for later on write and speak Mandarin correctly... You can also practice pronunciation, which is a plus!" - estafada por rtve

listings.name: Laoshi: Learn Chinese & HSK
listings.description:
Laoshi is a complete app for learning Mandarin Chinese: smart flashcards built for characters, tones and grammar, with real handwriting practice, pronunciation scored for sound and tone separately, and ready-made decks for every major Chinese textbook.

Join 300,000+ learners who use Laoshi to build vocabulary, master grammar, prepare for the HSK exam and make progress every day.

Laoshi is a Red Dot Design Award 2021 winner and a HICOOL 2025 winner.

Chinese works differently. Understanding a character isn't enough — you have to memorise it and write it by hand, and it fades fast. That's why spaced repetition sits at the core of Laoshi: it brings a word back exactly when it starts slipping, and locks it in through writing. Tones need pronunciation training, grammar needs clear explanations. Laoshi brings all of it together in one focused app.

Why learners choose Laoshi:

• Real handwriting practice — Don't just read Chinese. Write it. Draw characters with correct stroke order on your phone and strengthen recognition through active recall.

• Pronunciation and tone scoring, character by character — Say a whole sentence and every character comes back with two scores: one for pronunciation, one for the tone. The slip is named in words — a syllable you dropped, a tone that shifts before the next word. Listen to the reference, then play back your own take.

• Textbook decks, chapter by chapter — 4,300+ ready-made word lists covering 66 Chinese textbook series, including Standard Course HSK, Integrated Chinese, Developing Chinese, Boya Chinese, New Practical Chinese Textbook and Road to Success. Open your book, pick your chapter, start learning.

• HSK 2.0 and HSK 3.0 coverage — Vocabulary and grammar aligned with both official exam standards, including the advanced 7–9 band.

• Flashcards built for Chinese — Tones, pinyin, meanings, example sentences and character writing in one learning flow.

• Complete Chinese grammar section — 756 grammar points with clear explanations and practical examples, from beginner to advanced.

• Spaced repetition system (SRS) — Scientifically optimised review intervals help you retain vocabulary up to 3x longer.

• 30,000+ word lists and thematic decks — HSK lists, textbook decks and topic-based vocabulary, including preparation for the CSCA, China's standardised admission exam for international students.

• Import and create decks — Bring lists from Anki, Quizlet or Pleco, or create and share your own.

• Stroke order worksheets — Print any deck as a handwriting worksheet in one click.

• Progress tracking — Monitor your HSK level, daily goals and long-term growth.

Whether you are preparing for the HSK exam, applying to study in China, or simply learning Chinese for yourself, Laoshi gives you structure, clarity and tools that make vocabulary, characters and grammar stick.

What learners say in the App Store:

"I find Chinese challenging and fascinating at the same time... The structure of presenting knowledge and the method applied are just great. If you're serious about learning, look no further than Laoshi." - Playfull Orca

"Well designed and structured, helping students to build a solid foundation for later on write and speak Mandarin correctly... You can also practice pronunciation, which is a plus!" - estafada por rtve

"I always struggled with learning how to write Chinese characters, this app helps so good, and u learn pronunciation and tones as well. I love the word lists by topic." - lisu-ka

Start learning Chinese today — try your first 10 words now.

To access all features of Laoshi, you will need to start a subscription after the free trial period.

Questions or ideas? Email us at app@laoshi.io

bluejetty:00142754:ios.description:
Get drums into your pocket! Play world-famous hits in various music genres - Rock, Pop, Hip-Hop, Dance. No experience needed!
Drums by Piano Band is a drum set simulator with extraordinary drum games. You can choose different drum sets to play tracks in your favorite music genre. The app offers a collection of famous classical music pieces, originally reworked and rearranged as contemporary compositions. Get very exciting experience of playing popular tunes in a new way on drums. And don’t miss our Rock category! 
Drums are the very first musical instrument invented by humanity. Hitting out powerful, punchy sounds in a certain rhythm makes us feel excited and uplifted. This is why playing drums is one of the best known stress relievers. 
Never tried playing any musical instrument? No worries, you can play drums in our app! Rock on and feel the beat power!
App features:
- Drums circles gameplay;
- A collection of famous songs for drums in Rock, Pop, Hip-Hop, and other styles;

bluejetty:00144309:ios.description:
All Your Services in One App for Comfort and Convenience:
 • Submit claims quickly and easily.
 • Keep your virtual card handy, wherever you go.
 • View your network and get directions via Google Maps.
 • Check your and your family's benefits and usage.
 • Manage your Electronic Health Records and access prescriptions, lab reports, and more.
 • Live chat with our agents and health services doctors.
Enjoy Comprehensive Healthcare with Our Health Services Program:
 • Access stress-free home services: medication refills (pick-up or delivery), home labs, and vaccinations (child or seasonal).
 • Get an International Consultation.
 • Women’s Health: Consult with female health services doctors for insights on maternity, childcare, and more.
 • Build your digital health profile.
 • Integrate with HealthKit to track medical, lifestyle, wellness, and mental health data in your interactive dashboard.
 • Track all your requests through your Calendar and Timeline.
Introducing Our Digital Clinic Platform:
 • Book physical consultations with leading providers.
 • Schedule virtual consultations and connect with Sanar Doctors from the comfort of your home.
Please note: Services are subject to your policy network and scheme.
نقدم جميع خدماتنا في تطبيق واحد لراحتك: 
 • قدم مطالباتك في خطوات سريعة وسهلة. 
 • احتفظ ببطاقتك الافتراضية في متناول يدك أينما ذهبت.
 • عرض الشبكة الخاصة بك والحصول على الاتجاهات عبر خرائط جوجل.
 • اطلع على مزاياك واستهلاكك أنت وعائلتك.
 • إدارة سجلاتك الصحية الإلكترونية والوصول إلى الوصفات الطبية، تقارير المختبرات، والمزيد.
 • الدردشة المباشرة مع وكلائنا وأطباء الخدمات الصحية. 
تمتع برعاية صحية شاملة مع برنامج الخدمات الصحية: 
 • احصل على خدمات منزلية مريحة: إعادة تعبئة الأدوية (استلام أو توصيل)، مختبرات منزلية، وتطعيمات (للأطفال أو الموسمية).
 • احصل على استشارة دولية. 
 • صحة المرأة: استشر طبيبة الخدمات الصحية للحصول على نصائح حول الأمومة ورعاية الأطفال والمزيد. 
 • بناء ملفك الصحي الرقمي. 
 • قم بربط HealthKit للتتبع التفاعلي لبياناتك الصحية.
 • تتبع جميع طلباتك عبر التقويم والخط الزمني. 
تقديم منصة العيادة الرقمية: 
 • احجز موعد للاستشارات المباشرة مع كبار مقدمي الخدمة.
 • احجز موعد للاستشارات الافتراضية والتواصل مع أطباء سنار من راحة منزلك. 
. يرجى ملاحظة: تخضع الخدمات لشبكة وسياسة التأمين الخاصة بك
نقدم لك جميع خدماتنا في تطبيق واحد لراحتك
* تقديم مطالبة في 3 خطوات بسيطة
* احتفظ ببطاقتك الافتراضية في متناول يدك أينما ذهبت
* عرض خريطة الشبكة الخاصة بك والحصول على الاتجاهات من خلال خريطة جوجل
* الاطلاع على الفوائد والاستهلاك لك ولعائلتك
* إدارة السجلات الصحية الإلكترونية الخاصة بك وتلقي الوصفات الطبية وتقارير المختبر.. الخ
* الدردشة المباشرة مع وكلائنا وأطباء طبتم
تمتع بخدمات رعاية صحية مقدمة بعناية مع برنامج طبتم*
* خدمات منزلية مريحة بين يديك، إعادة صرف الأدوية (استلام أو توصيل)، المختبرات المنزلية، التطعيمات المنزلية (للأطفال أو الموسمية)
* احصل على استشارة دولية (ISMO)
* صحة المرأة - تحدثي مع طبيب طبتم للحصول على أفكار حول الأمومة ورعاية الأطفال ... والمزيد
* بناء ملف تعريف الصحة الرقمي الخاص بك
* الربط مع   HealthKitلعرض جميع المعلومات الطبية، نمط الحياة، الصحة، والصحة الذهنية في لوحة تفاعلية للبيانات الصحية
* تتبع جميع الطلبات في التقويم الخاص بك وجدولك الزمني
نقدم لكم منصة التطبيب عن بعد الخاصة بنا*
* حجز موعد للاستشارات المباشرة مع كبار مقدمي الخدمة
* احجز استشارتك الافتراضية وتواصل مع أطباء سنار بسهولة في منزلك
ملاحظة: جميع هذه الخدمات خاضعة لسياسة الشبكة والفئة التأمينية الخاصة بك

bluejetty:00167022:ios.description:
Please note: The ScriptSave® WellRx Premier app requires a valid group number (provided by your program sponsor) for access. If you don’t have a group number, you can download the standard ScriptSave WellRx app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/scriptsave-wellrx-rx-discounts/id1016290130 
WellRx Premier is here to make it easier and more affordable to access the medicine you need. 
With your membership, you can search for savings on prescriptions, get discounts at pharmacies near you, and save an average of 65%* on your Rx medications!** 
Because prescription costs often vary between pharmacies, it can be tough to know whether you’re paying the most competitive price. With WellRx Premier, you don’t have to wonder. We give you access to our powerful price checker so you can find the best deal without a lot of digging. 
Saving with WellRx Premier is as easy as 1-2-3:
1. Compare prices at pharmacies in your area and make your selection.
2. Print, text, email, or download your coupon.
3. Show it at the register when you check out to pay the discounted price. You’re all done!
WellRx Premier doesn’t just help you save money—it also helps you stay on top of your medications. Here are some of the other features available to you as a member:
• Drug interaction warnings that alert you to conflicts with saved medications
• Pill and refill notifications to remind you to take your medications and refill your prescriptions
• A virtual medicine chest to store, manage and instantly price your medications
• Medication information, images, and videos
• Notes and mood tracking to refer to as you take your medication
• Nutrition tools to identify foods that align with your health goals and specific health conditions (including pregnancy, heart health, and diabetes)
• “Better for You” grocery recommendations that meet your nutritional needs
Get these benefits and more by downloading WellRx Premier today!
You can feel safe with the resources we share and the savings we bring. ScriptSave WellRx Premier is part of Medical Security Card Company, LLC; offering some of the most advanced technology, pharmacy expertise, and customer service in the industry for more than 25 years.
By downloading the ScriptSave WellRx Premier prescription app for iOS, you agree to be bound by our Terms of Use. ScriptSave WellRx Premier values your privacy and will never sell or share your personally identifiable data.
Average savings based on 2020 national program savings data.
DISCOUNT ONLY – NOT INSURANCE. Discounts are available exclusively through participating pharmacies. The range of the discounts will vary depending on the type of prescription and the pharmacy chosen. This program does not make payments directly to pharmacies. Members are required to pay for all prescription purchases. Cannot be used in conjunction with insurance. You may contact customer care anytime with questions or concerns, to cancel your registration, or to obtain further information. This program is administered by Medical Security Card Company, LLC, Tucson, AZ.

bluejetty:00080176:ios.description:
Welcome to the Femme Nativa Community!
Femma Nativa is a fitness app designed for women by women. Our mission is to help women feel great inside and look great outside.
Our workout style is mostly low impact and includes cardio. All our workouts and programs are designed to get you lean and toned. And when most women start doing this type of workout, their body just transforms. They slim down, they become toned, and they start feeling more confident than ever.
Inside our app you will find these:
Workout Programs Designed to Give You Lean and Toned Look
Our app currently includes workout programs that include both cardio and strength training.
At-Home Cardio Videos
Can’t go for a walk outside, or don’t have access to a treadmill?
We’ve got you covered! Try our at-home cardio workouts instead - guaranteed to get you sweating and increase your step count.
Workout Challenges
Want to challenge yourself and add a finisher to your workout? Or are you short on time and just want a quick 10-15 minute workout today?
We've got you covered! There are a lot of quick workouts for you to choose from in our Challenges section, and we are continually adding new workouts to keep things fresh and exciting.
Educational Guides
Getting educated about fitness, nutrition, and health is incredibly important. Getting this type of knowledge will help you get results faster and teach you how to stay on track. 
Goal Tracking
Now you can track your progress all in one place. Upload your progress photos so you can see how far you’ve come on your fitness journey.
Community
Need a little extra support and motivation (don’t we all?!). You’ve come to the right place!
Our community of women is friendly, and supportive and is on a similar journey to you. Create your accountability groups, send direct messages, or read through everyone else’s posts and questions for motivation.
Nutrition
And finally, we all know how important nutrition is for not only weight loss but your general health. So we have an 8-week nutrition plan that is tailored to your specific body type. It includes both a regular and vegan meal plan, with over 100 healthy recipes. This nutrition plan is key to helping you achieve long-term results.
We have designed the Femme Nativa App to help you achieve long-term success!
The Femme Nativa iOS App is available under the standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00018315:ios.description:
With the Sbanken app, you become your own bank manager, wherever you are!
Here you get smart, digital solutions that are easy to use, with open prices and equal conditions for everyone. The app makes your everyday banking easier, whether you need to pay bills, check your balance or borrow money. Save money in funds or buy shares with just a few magical taps on your mobile phone. And you know what? The app works very well on tablets too, if you prefer to do things on a larger screen.
Create your own budgets and get a full overview of what you spend money on. Move money between your own accounts with a simple drag-and-drop gesture. Share bills with family and friends by giving them access to your eInvoices. Customize the front page in the app and make it more personal. Are you going abroad or shopping online? Use our currency calculator to see how much things cost in other currencies. Last but not least. We also made the app in dark mode! Better late than never, right?
And one more thing. DNB and Sbanken have merged, but will continue to be two different brands. To use this app, you must be a customer in the Sbanken consept.

bluejetty:00028840:ios.description:
Spiik is an easy-to-use voice recorder and AI transcription app. Record lectures, interviews, meetings, personal notes, or ideas and instantly get accurate automatic transcriptions.
Turn your recordings into useful AI-generated outputs: detailed notes, summaries, quizzes, and flashcards — all created directly from your audio.
Key Features
Unlimited recording: Record, save, and replay audio with no time limits on the free version.
AI transcription: Automatically convert speech to text with high accuracy.
100+ languages: Transcribe and translate in over 100 languages.
AI note taker: Generate structured notes, summaries, quizzes, flashcards, and more from any recording.
Organization: Group your recordings into projects for easy management.
Export options: Export transcriptions with or without timestamps.
Perfect For
Students recording lectures, professionals capturing meetings, journalists doing interviews, or anyone who wants to turn spoken ideas into searchable, organized text and study materials.
The free version of Spiik includes unlimited recording and replaying. Advanced AI features are available with Spiik Pro.
Contact: support+spiik@fadel.io
EULA: https://www.fadel.io/apps/terms.html

bluejetty:00014368:ios.description:
For a better experience, download our new app. (https://kotakapp.onelink.me/Xoqo/vnw5l9ex) 
The app allows customers to manage their bank accounts—make payments, money transfers, check balance, change card PINs, and perform various other tasks.  
New customers are required to visit their nearest branch to open their bank accounts. Once enrolled, you can use the application to access the services.  
Key Features: 
* Manage financial transactions, send and receive money with UPI. 
* Pay bills, recharge mobile and DTH services & set up AutoPay for repeat payments.  
* Update profile details, request statements and manage cards on-the-go. 
* Invest & redeem mutual funds while you keep track of your investments.  
* Apply for a credit card, keep track of your spending, and pay bills. 
* Manage card settings including PIN regeneration and temporary blocking.  
* Payday loans are available for eligible users directly through the app.  
Getting Started: To start using the app, you need your Customer Relationship Number (CRN) and either a card PIN or your net banking password. The app will guide you through a one-time setup process. 
Permissions Required: 
* Contacts: For mobile number access 
* Location: To find branches or ATMs 
* Media & Camera: For profile photo 
* Phone: To contact support 
* SMS: For device activation and optional data access (with consent) 
Please note that your data is safe with Kotak Mahindra Bank. We do not share any information with third parties without your permission.

bluejetty:00091525:ios.description:
Learn and have fun with these educational games from Fisher-Price™
Enjoy 10 games that will give you hours of family fun inspired by Fisher-Price™ toys, ideal for all ages.
Entertain your family members while they play, learn and develop their abilities with a variety of educational and creative activities.
HOW TO PLAY FISHER-PRICE™ PLAY & LEARN
You can grow and develop different skills with early learning content such as numbers, letters, animals, and music while also developing their fine motor skills.The simple and intuitive interface makes it easy for all ages up to 2 to enjoy your favorite Fisher-Price™ toys and games digitally, making creative activities and educational experiences accessible anywhere.
- See 'n Say®: Enjoy this iconic Fisher-Price™ toy that teaches animal names and sounds.
- Airplane: Practice counting while maneuvering the plane with your fingers, enhancing coordination skills while teaching colors, letters, and shapes.
- Market: Count and follow directions while at the market! Use the grocery list to fill the shopping bag with the correct number of fruits and vegetables.
- Memory Animals: Enhance memory skills while having fun with animals in this card matching game.
- Doodle Pad: Explore creativity in a fun and mess-free way as you express yourself by drawing with their fingertips on-screen.
- Alphabet Fun: A great and engaging way to learn the alphabet and expand vocabulary. It's an enjoyable and interactive method that helps individuals of all ages become familiar with each letter, while also enhancing their understanding of related words and concepts.
- Shape Sorter: Enhance problem-solving skills while promoting shape recognition and hand-eye coordination as you fit shapes into corresponding holes.
- Smartphone: Build vocabulary, early learning, and pretend play all at once! Tap the keys on this playful phone for ABCs, days of the week, shapes, and so much more.
- Horse Care: Promote empathy and emotional awareness as you nurture and care for horses. Through small tasks, you will learn to care for animals in different ways.
- Xylophone: Express and explore creativity through music or follow the prompts to play a familiar tune.

Accessible anywhere

bluejetty:00121475:ios.description:
Catch up with your favorite ID shows anytime, anywhere with the all-new ID GO app - and now get access to up to 14 additional networks including TLC, Science Channel, Travel Channel, Discovery and more - all in one app. It’s FREE with your pay TV subscription.

New episodes are available the same day as they premiere on TV. 
With ID GO You Can:
• Stream ID and more networks LIVE anytime, anywhere on all your favorite devices
• Find shows to watch with the live schedule guide
• Access thousands of episodes on demand - from current hits to classic favorites
• See new episodes of shows on the app the same day and time they premiere on TV
• Binge your favorite ID series and specials including Evil Lives Here, On the Case with Paula Zahn, See No Evil, People Magazine Investigates, American Monster, Fear Thy Neighbor, Web of Lies - and many more! 
• Get unlimited access to everything the Discovery family of networks has to offer - free with your pay TV subscription

• Stream live TV when you link your pay TV provider
• Watch select episodes and entire seasons of your favorite shows from up to 15 networks!
• Browse by genre - from Natural History, Science and Tech to Food, Home and more - to find your favorite shows and discover new ones
• Continue watching episodes where you left off across all of your devices
• Save shows and episodes to watch later with My List
• Compatible with tvOS and Chromecast
• Closed-captioning support
Requirements:
• Available in the U.S. only
• Wi-Fi connection recommended
• iOS 12 or higher

bluejetty:00185789:ios.name: Castamatic Podcast Player
bluejetty:00185789:ios.summary: Castamatic is a podcast player for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and CarPlay. Build a custom sequence of episodes or a smart playlist, follow along with on-device transcripts, and hear every show at an even level thanks to the machine lear
bluejetty:00185789:ios.description:
Castamatic is a podcast player for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and CarPlay. Build a custom sequence of episodes or a smart playlist, follow along with on-device transcripts, and hear every show at an even level thanks to the machine learning Auto-leveler.
New in Castamatic 14
---------------
-Share as video: share a moment of an episode as a video with the artwork, the waveform and captions. Choose a vertical, square or landscape format. The vertical format goes straight to Instagram Stories.
-Chapter selection (Premium): turn off the chapters you don't care about, and playback skips them for you.
-Undo (Premium): for 10 seconds, take back a skip, a chapter change or an accidental "Listened".
-Chapters from show notes: episodes that list their chapters only in the notes now get real chapters.
Highlights
---------------
Magic Transcript: generate full episode transcripts directly on your device. Tap any line to jump to that exact moment.
Magic Chapters: split episodes into chapters with on-device Apple Intelligence, even when the podcast doesn't include them.
Transcript Panel: follow along with a live-scrolling transcript right in the player, with full transport controls.
Key Features
---------------
-Chapters: quickly jump to favorite topics. Works with published chapter marks, chapters in the show notes and Magic Chapters.
-Smart playlists with priority shows.
-"On the Go" Playlist: quickly pick shows for the next listening session.
-Support your favorite producers with Podcasting 2.0 and Value4Value.
-Live podcasts: listen to live shows and get notified the moment they go live.
-Podping: receive new episodes immediately after they are published.
-Full support for Siri and Shortcuts.
-Automatic Leveler: increase audio level consistency between different parts/voices of each show, without altering the original audio character.
-Adaptive Gap-Zapper: increase play speed without losing intelligibility by shortening silent parts.
-Streaming: save network traffic by downloading only the parts you play. Or download new episodes automatically, and skip the titles you don't want.
-Apple Watch: control playback, volume, pick episodes, and adjust audio effects from the watch.
-CarPlay: take your favorite shows with you in your car.
-iCloud sync: sync subscriptions and playhead position across all your devices.
-Backup and restore: manual and automatic backups keep your data safe.
-Custom AudioUnit player: maximum performance and minimal battery drain.
-Serverless design: Castamatic will keep on working as long as there are podcasts to listen to on planet Earth.
Castamatic Premium (in-app purchase)
---------------
Castamatic is free to use. An optional yearly subscription, "One Year Premium Subscription", supports indie development and gives you:
-No Premium banner
-Chapter selection
-Undo of your last action
-Unlimited imports of external audio files
The app shows the price before you buy. The price may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage the subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://castamatic.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://castamatic.com/terms_of_use/
--------------
We don't feel comfortable interrupting your listening experience to ask for reviews, but if you are feeling generous please take a minute to leave a nice review. Thank you for your support.

BUY EVERYDAY BASICS: UNDERWEAR & BRAS

bluejetty:00146657:ios.description:
Travel eSIMs Made Easy – esims.io is your one-stop app to find and compare the best prepaid eSIM plans for international travel. Browse over 32,000 data plans from 38+ providers covering 250+ countries and regions. Whether you're going on vacation, a business trip, or a backpacking adventure, easily find a plan that fits your needs and budget.
No more juggling multiple apps or hunting down local SIM cards at the airport. esims.io brings all the top eSIM providers together in one powerful comparison tool. Quickly filter plans by price, data amount, or duration to pinpoint the perfect plan for your trip. You can also sort results by cheapest price, longest validity, or our recommended picks to make your decision even easier.
Key Features:
- Huge Selection: Explore thousands of eSIM deals in one place. Compare over 32,000 eSIM data plans from 38+ providers, including popular options like Airalo, Nomad, Saily, BNESIM, Jetpac, GoMoWorld, Firsty, and many more.
- Worldwide Coverage: Find eSIM plans for 250+ countries and regions. Get connectivity wherever you travel – from Europe, Asia, and the Americas to Africa and Oceania. Regional and global plans are also available for multi-country trips.
- Advanced Filters: Narrow your search by data size (MB/GB), plan duration (days), and price. For example, find a 5 GB, 30-day plan under $20 in seconds. It’s easy to tailor your search to exactly what you need.
- Exclusive Offers: Save more with special deals and promo codes available only on the eSIMs app (powered by esims.io). Enjoy exclusive discounts from select providers and get the best price for your travel data.
- Easy Purchase & Activation: Once you found your eSIM, Buy your chosen eSIM plan instantly through the provider's app or site or via a secure link to the provider. Activate it in seconds by scanning a QR code – no physical SIM card required. Start using your data as soon as you land.
No More Roaming Fees: Avoid bill shock! All plans are prepaid, so you know exactly what you’re spending. Use a local eSIM for data while keeping your primary SIM for calls. Say goodbye to expensive roaming charges.
Traveler Friendly: Designed for speed and simplicity, the app is easy to use even on the go. Trusted by over 1.5 million travelers worldwide, the eSIMs app offers reliable service and 24/7 customer support for peace of mind during your journeys.
Download eSIMs now and make staying connected abroad hassle-free. Find the perfect travel eSIM in minutes and enjoy your trip without worrying about internet access. Happy eSIM hunting!
Note: Requires an eSIM‑compatible device (iPhone XS, XR, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 or later). 
Devices purchased in China, Hong Kong, or Macau do not support eSIM.
