bluejetty:00144743:ios.description:
Welcome to GoTo – Shared Mobility 
GoTo is a global leader in shared transportation services, proudly operating in Israel, for over 16 years. We are a community of tens of thousands of people who share a variety of vehicles—ranging from compact city cars to family cars and cargo vans—without compromising on convenience, flexibility, and freedom of movement. 
Our mission is to provide seamless transportation solutions for private and business customers, in the city and beyond. 
Why GoTo? 
- Flexible Rentals: Book a car for as little as an hour or if you need. With our new short-term car rentals (3–30 days) and Flexlease (1–36 months) options, GoTo adapts to your needs. 
- Everythingis included: Fuel, insurance, and maintenance are covered. 
- Easy to Use: Download the app, sign up, and start driving in minutes. No paperwork, and cancellations are flexible. 
- Round-Trip Convenience:** Cars are parked in designated spots, making pickup and return hassle-free. 
- Environmentally Friendly:** Shared vehicles mean fewer cars on the road, reduced emissions, and a greener planet. 
How It Works 
1. Download the GoTo app and register in less than two minutes. 
2. Find the nearest car using the app. Book in advance or as little as 15 minutes before you need it. 
3. Drive with confidence—fuel, insurance, and maintenance are on us. 
4. Return the car** to the designated parking spot. 
Wide Availability
GoTo is available in major cities across Israel: 
 Tel Aviv 
 Jerusalem 
 Haifa 
 Ramat Gan 
 Ra’anana 
 Herzliya 
 Kfar Saba 
 Holon 
 Netanya 
 Givatayim 
 Ramat Hasharon 
 Bat Yam 
 Modi’in 
 Petach Tikva 
We also provide commercial vehicle rentals in Tel Aviv, Haifa, and Jerusalem. Whether you're moving or transporting heavy items, GoTo has you covered. 
GoTo for Businesses
GoTo’s shared mobility service is also tailored for businesses. From reducing costs to simplifying employee mobility, we offer plans that include everything—insurance, fuel, and parking—so you only pay for what you use. 
The Advantages of GoTo
- Significant savings compared to owning a private or second family car. 
- 24/7 service with widespread availability in major cities. 
- A greener, smarter alternative to reduce congestion and emissions. 
Discover Flexiease
Our new subscription service offers cars for flexible periods, from one month to 36 months. More affordable than car rentals and with greater flexibility than traditional leasing, it’s perfect for today’s fast-paced world. No upfront payments, no long-term commitments—just drive. 
Get Started Today 
Download the GoTo app and create your account. 
Find the perfect car for your needs, and you’re good to go. 
Learn more about GoTo’s services at [www.gotoglobal.com](http://www.gotoglobal.com). 
New! Chat with us directly in the app! Look for the pink icon on the vehicle map screen.

bluejetty:00175664:ios.description:
Work out where you want, when you want. From strength and meditation, to outdoor running and yoga, the Peloton App makes fitness classes and workout tracking fun and easy. No equipment needed.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
• Take your workout with you: Find a variety of workouts to fulfill your fitness goals, including strength training, indoor and outdoor running, cycling, yoga, HIIT, meditation, stretching, and more. Our workouts are available on your iPhone or iPad. Plus, you can stream your workouts to your TV with our Apple TV app, or via AirPlay or Chromecast.
• Here to hype. Here to help: Peloton is designed to keep you going with artist series, goal-based programs, and challenges that make working out on the Peloton App a fun and exhilarating experience.
• More burn for your buck: Experience what Peloton is all about with the Free Peloton App or a 30-day trial of one of our paid memberships.
DISCOVER, LOVE, REPEAT
• Variety that you crave: Thousands of workouts that you can take anytime, anywhere, with or without any equipment. From cardio to stretching, we've got you covered. Guided workouts can help you achieve your fitness goals anywhere you go. 
• Workouts you can work in: Let our world-class, expert instructors motivate and captivate you during every workout. You can track your stats and progress using the Peloton Watch App, available on Apple Watch. 
• Whenever you're ready to sweat: Join live classes, or explore our library of instructor-led workouts for a studio fitness experience to get moving whenever you're ready to sweat- on the go, at the gym, or at home.
• Features that take your experience to the next level: Schedule, stack, and bookmark classes, so once you're ready to get moving, all you need to do is show up on your mat and sweat. 
TRANSFORM YOUR FITNESS JOURNEY
• Just bring you: Filter workouts for length, time, and favorite music to support your health and fitness goals. No strings attached, no equipment needed.
• Music to keep you going: With all of your favorite songs and classes dedicated to your favorite artists, you can move to the music you love. 
• Stay connected: Track your classes and freeform activities like outdoor walks, runs and more. Connect a heart rate monitor or download the Peloton Watch App for Apple Watch in order to get metrics in real time to keep you going. 
JOIN THE PELOTON COMMUNITY
Whether you're working out on your phone, tablet, or TV, Peloton is designed to fit your life. Try Peloton for free, no equipment needed. 
Payment for this plan will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The membership will automatically renew at the applicable price and frequency (i.e., monthly or annually) (exclusive of taxes) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. By completing your purchase, you certify that you are at least 18 years old and that you understand and agree to the Terms of Service (https://www.onepeloton.com/terms-of-service) and acknowledge the Privacy Policy (https://www.onepeloton.com/privacy-policy). Auto-renewal may be turned off in your Account Setting in iTunes after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period. A user that cancels during a subscription month will not be charged for the following month.

CozyFit – Stay Comfy, Get Strong
Feel like working out without leaving your comfort zone?
CozyFit turns your bedroom, living room—or even your couch—into a personal training studio, no gear required. Powered by science-backed routines and an ever-cheerful virtual coach, CozyFit keeps you moving toward your goals while keeping things chill.
CozyFit Premium Subscription
Your subscription grants you unlimited access to all of our premium content and features. Access 300+ workouts, adaptive plans, mindful mobility sessions, and full-featured tracking tools with CozyFit Premium.
-7-day free trial included
-$39.99/year after trial
-Auto-renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before end of period
-Manage in Account Settings
-Unused trial days are forfeited upon subscription
Smart Support for Every Body
Whether you’re easing back from an injury, protecting sensitive joints, or just prefer low-impact moves, CozyFit builds sessions that respect your limits and strengthen the muscles that matter. Train confidently, knowing each drill is selected to keep you safe.
30-Day Cozy Challenge
Kick-start progress with themed plans: chair cardio, under-the-covers bed workouts, wall-assisted Pilates, mindful somatic flows, indoor stroll programs, and more. CozyFit learns your habits and offers recommendations shaped around your schedule, goals, and energy level.
Work Out Anywhere, Anytime
All routines are equipment-free, short, and flexible—perfect for dorm rooms, small apartments, or your travel schedule.
Highlights
-Personal Coach: Adaptive plans that evolve with you 
-All Levels Welcome: From first-timer stretches to advanced burners 
-30-Day Challenges: Quick, goal-oriented programs 
-Spot Training: Zero in on core, glutes, back, or wherever you choose 
-Wall Pilates & Chair Yoga: Extra stability for better form 
-Bed & Couch Sessions: Sneak in movement without getting up 
-Senior-Friendly Tracks: Gentle yet effective sequences 
-Mindful Mobility: Somatic and stretch flows to de-stress 
-Daily Tracker: Visualize progress, celebrate streaks 
-Apple Health Sync: One tap to log steps and calories 
Join thousands already cozy-crushing their fitness journey. CozyFit: soft, simple, seriously effective.

bluejetty:00076438:ios.name: Steady: Paced Breathing Timer
bluejetty:00076438:ios.summary: A breathing meditation app that helps you fight stress and anxiety through breathing exercises such as box breathing, and the popular 4-7-8 breathing pattern that helps with sleep. Let the timer and audio cues guide the rhythm of your breat
bluejetty:00076438:ios.description:
A breathing meditation app that helps you fight stress and anxiety through breathing exercises such as box breathing, and the popular 4-7-8 breathing pattern that helps with sleep. Let the timer and audio cues guide the rhythm of your breath as you breathe in and breathe out, inhaling the future and exhaling the past.
Pranayama ("prana" - life force, "yama" - regulation) is the conscious regulation & awareness of breath: the life force that both energizes and relaxes the body. It is no surprise that our breath can influence our physiology. Wim Hof, a Dutch extreme athlete, is noted for his ability to withstand freezing temperatures thanks to his breathwork.
Even if you are not aiming to become an extreme athlete, you can enjoy the many benefits of breathwork such as strengthening your immune system (which can be confirmed by measuring your heart rate variability, a.k.a., HRV), improving your ability to deal with stress & anxiety, keeping asthma under control, etc. In fact, you will notice an immediate sense of relaxation through a short minute of breathwork. Deep breathing doesn't help. What helps is rhythm. Get into a rhythm.
// APP FEATURES
- 4 default programs: box breathing, triangle breathing, relaxing breathing, and ujjayi pranayama
- Create your own breathing pattern/technique (for advanced users)
- Select background music (add an ambience to your meditation)
- Vibration cues (so you can breathe with your eyes closed)
- Choose between male & female audio cues
- Up to 3 daily reminders (you might be busy)
- Insightful statistics
- Set monthly goals
- Collect badges as you breathe
- Export data as CSV
// USE CASES
- As a daily habit/routine
- When you need to perform (e.g. before an interview, a presentation, or competition)
- Before bedtime to help you fall asleep
- As needed when feeling stressed or anxious
Some features need Steady Pro. Choose a subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. The app shows the price in your currency before you buy.
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://harvest-finch-623.notion.site/Steady-Privacy-Policy-7747d7d0335f4993a3e7bbc95980a1c0
Disclaimer:
Steady, a breathing meditation app, is not a substitute for your doctor visits, and it does not provide professional diagnosis or cure for your symptoms. Breathe with the app only if you are feeling well and consult your doctor before taking advice from the authors of the content in the app.

bluejetty:00068710:ios.description:

With an integrated reminder system, it makes schedule management just that much easier.
・Works with the AppleWatch.
・Integrated reminder system. Both reminders and events are displayed on the calendar.
・Works with the iPad's Multitasking feature. Start this app while using other apps by sliding from the sides.

・Works with widgets; you can quickly check your schedule.
・Can be displayed in landscape mode. When using side view, event start time is also displayed on the calendar.
・The calendar automatically adjusts; even if you have many events planned they will not be hidden.
・Includes a template function. Register events and reminders to a template to make addition even faster.
・Customize its appearance as you see fit. Change the calendar theme color to your favorite color.
・Change when the week begins as well as the color.
・You can use 3D touch shortcut menu for create new event or reminder.

bluejetty:00169466:ios.description:
Never miss a flight update again. Flights25 is the flight tracker built for travelers and crew members who want to know more than the airline tells them.
The app is your unfair advantage at the airport and gives you clarity in busy moments while traveling. 
Key Features:
1) First-Class Alerts
Get notified about gate changes, delays, and cancellations before the airline tells you. Our 25-hour monitoring catches issues before they become problems.
2) Track Your Inbound Aircraft
Know exactly where your plane is right now. See if the aircraft coming from its previous flight is on time — so you know if yours will be too.
3) Offline SMS Alerts
No WiFi? No problem. Receive critical flight updates via SMS — even in airplane mode.
4) Build Your Flight Map
Visualize every flight you've taken on a stunning 3D globe. See your total miles, countries visited, and airlines flown.
5) Scan Your Boarding Pass
Scan any boarding pass to instantly add your flight. No manual entry needed.
6) Sync Your Bookings
Import flights directly from your calendar, email, or other travel apps. Everything in one place.
7) Pilot-Level Timeline
See your flight's full story - with exact takeoff, landing, and taxi times that most trackers don't show.
8) Share Your Travel Story
Share your travel stats, flight map, and trip memories. Show the world where you've been.
9) Home Widgets
Track your upcoming flights right from your home screen.
10) Import from other providers
You can now import your flights from other flight tracking apps like Flighty, Myflightradar24, JetLovers. Flights25 even supports automatic syncing with Delta's MiCrew calendar entries.
Trusted by 250,000+ travelers worldwide.
Download now for free and see why frequent flyers are switching to Flights25.

bluejetty:00131787:ios.name: HRV4Training
bluejetty:00131787:ios.summary:
The first scientifically validated Heart Rate Variability (HRV) app. HRV4Training provides HRV based insights to help you quantify stress,
better balance training and lifestyle, and improve performance. HRV4Training does not require a heart
bluejetty:00131787:ios.description:
The first scientifically validated Heart Rate Variability (HRV) app. HRV4Training provides HRV based insights to help you quantify stress,
better balance training and lifestyle, and improve performance. HRV4Training does not require a heart rate monitor, since it can accurately assess your HRV using the phone's camera. 
HRV4Training also works with Apple Watch, the Oura ring and all compatible Bluetooth SMART sensors.
HRV4Training is also the first app that goes beyond simple measurements and provides insights on:
1) acute or day to day HRV changes in response to different stressors (alcohol, travel, sick days, training, menstruation, etc.) 
2) long term multi-parameter trends to look at the big picture 
3) correlations between physiological measurements and annotations 
4) training load analysis, fitness, fatigue, readiness to perform and injury risk 
5) VO2max estimation for runners linking the app to Strava or TrainingPeaks and using a heart rate monitor during their workouts
6) Training Polarization analysis (or 80/20) 
7) Lactate Threshold Estimation for runners linking the app to Strava or TrainingPeaks and using a heart rate monitor during their workouts
8) Weekly and monthly summaries to track progress. 
All data is processed inside the app in order to provide you with actionable interpretations that can help optimizing your training plan and performance.
Supported devices for the camera measurement: iPhones 5, 5S, 6, 6S, 6+, 6S+, SE, 7, 7+, 8, 8+, X, XS, XS Max, XR, 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro Max, 12 mini, 12, 12 Pro, 12 Pro Max, 13 mini, 13, 13 Pro, 13 Pro Max, 14, 14 Plus, 14 Max, 14 Pro, 15, 15 Max, 15 Pro, 16, 16 Max, 16 Pro
Currently unsupported devices for the camera measurement: iPhones 4S, iPads and iPods - These devices require a chest strap.
Other features: 
- HRV-based advice helps you to adapt your trainings based on objective measures of recovery
- TAGS: lets you tag your sleep, mental energy, muscle fatigue, stress and all other parameters that can help you understand what is influencing your physical condition and physiological stress
- Works with Bluetooth SMART heart rate monitors (a Polar H7 is recommended) or simply your phone's Camera
- Integrates with the Health app (writes heart rate, and sleep, read sleep time)
- Configurable test (single or orthostatic, choose test duration between 1, 3 or 5 minutes)
- Extracts and stores the following features while lying down and/or standing: heart rate, mean of beat-to-beat intervals (AVNN), standard deviation of beat-to-beat intervals (SDNN), square root of the mean squared difference of successive R-Rs (rMSSD), number of pairs of successive R-Rs that differ by more than 50 ms (pNN50), low frequency power (LF, 0.04-0.15 Hz), high frequency power (HF, 0.15-0.40 Hz)
- Shows the PPG signal view to ensure signal quality during the test if the camera is used instead of a bluetooth SMART sensor
- HRV4T Recovery Points to provide a single, straightforward metric to analyze your physical condition
- Population summaries and people like you comparisons to put your data into perspective
- Analysis of compliance and consistency 
- Data export via email or Dropbox
- Integrates with TrainingPeaks, Oura, Strava and Coros
HRV4Training requires to register an account with your email address, so that your data can be backed up safely and retrieved in case anything happens (app issue, changing phone, etc.).
HRV4Training does not provide medical advice. It is intended for informational purposes only. Consult a medical professional before making health or lifestyle decisions.
Please find an overview of the relevant scientific literature in our guide, here: https://marcoaltini.substack.com/p/the-ultimate-guide-to-heart-rate

bluejetty:00069930:ios.description:
Lead a motorcycle gang on an epic journey across the country in a brutal driving combat road rage adventure!
Road Redemption is an action racing game set in a post-apocalyptic world ruled by a ruthless dictator. Fans of Mad Max will feel at home here. 
A TRULY EPIC QUEST 
After years of bloody street warfare, the country's biker gangs have settled into an uneasy truce.
This period of peace is interrupted when the leader of the country's richest weapons cartel is assassinated, and a huge bounty is put on the mysterious assassin's head. It's up to you and your fellow gang members to chase down the assassin and claim this prize, but you'll have to race through enemy territory to do so. Every biker in the country wants a piece of that bounty, and they won't hesitate to take out those who get in their way!
COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE 
The roads can be lethal. Fortunately, every time you die, all the experience you've collected can be used to upgrade your character, your bike, and your weapon. Roguelite mechanics allow players to experiment with unique arsenals and customized loadouts for each run. Earn money to buy mid-run boosts by racing and completing assassinations, robberies, and other challenges in your path. 
DEEP GAMEPLAY
Massive, expandable skill tree. 
Tons of brutal weapons for combat. This is more Twisted Metal than it is Mario Kart.
Earn loot to upgrade your character, your bike, and your weapons.
A deep motorcycle fighting system with grabs, kicks, counters, critical strikes, and more.
Win races packed with action and hazards to gain cash.
UNLOCK
Characters 
Bikes
Weapons 
OTHER FEATURES 
Supports gamepad or customizable touch controls.
FROM PC TO MOBILE
Experience the road rage adventure enjoyed by over a million PC users.
“I f***ing loved this game. It’s the most fun I’ve had doing anything in awhile.” 9.0 – Destructoid
“It looks nice, has a rocking soundtrack and a surprising amount of depth.” 90% – Gamespew
“An incredibly successful spiritual successor to Road Rash” 90/100 – RageQuit
TIPS 
Use the right weapon for the right enemy; certain enemies go down quicker with strategic attacks!

bluejetty:00155538:ios.description:
Get a shooter game offline experience with defense against the giant centipede
Welcome to a unique defense shooter with an interesting arcade component. Shoot a Centipede is an intriguing adventure into a tiny shooter world with danger at every turn and of course a giant crawler. Aim and shoot the centipede parts and destroy this crawler with shotgun to avoid becoming food for the monster. Improve your weapons, demonstrate your shooting skills, use strategy and tactics to win and survive in a dangerous environment!
Download Scolopendra: Centipede Shooter right now and start playing a unique adventure through a tiny world!
Key Features
Aim and shoot: Easily control the scope and use tactics to try to stop the giant monster. The crawler is divided into sections with separate features and health - they explode, freeze, protect the body of the centipede - use strategy to stop it!
Strategy and tactics: for each level, you should look for a unique approach: skillfully choose the target, correctly upgrade your weapon, wait for the moment and, of course, skillfully shoot!
Constant upgrade: to get maximum efficiency from shooting, upgrade your weapon, level up during the level and choose power-ups: double shot, more damage, ricochet, piercing bullets, critical damage and much more. As you pass the level, you will receive equipment of different rarities that increase your characteristics as well as a talent tree, together this will make you invincible!
Catchy theme: Immerse yourself in a tiny world with stunning 3D graphics and lots of detail. You play as a hunter shrunk to the size of an ant with a shotgun and observe your garden along with grass, garbage, insects and other things making for an unparalleled centipede shooter experience.
Play anywhere: Your adventure progress is saved even without internet access, so play this incredible example of shooter games offline anytime, anywhere.
Are you ready for an amazing shooter with stunning effects and interesting gameplay? Scolopendra: Centipede Shooter will bring an unforgettable experience and tons of fun, shoot the centipede and survive in a tiny world in the example of great shotgun games! All you need is a hatred of centipedes, a good mood, the ability to aim and shoot, and of course the desire to go all the way - play for the best centipede shooter games offline experience.

Track your player, team or competition. Record stats for all levels of basketball supporting multiple teams, leagues, and seasons. Minimal touches to log data for fast input during the game. Email customized reports per game,player or season. Video of app on our site. 
Designed with team data collection in mind providing the ability to track as much or as little data per team or game as you want. 
We have used non-iOS devices for years tracking basketball and from that experience we designed a better way to track data live during a game. 
CONNECTIVITY:
• Score games and sync stats with or without an internet connection
EASE OF USE:
• Keep pace with live action
• Track stats for one or both teams
• View stats at any point during game
• Track as much or as little data as you want
• Use jersey numbers or player initials as well as team colors to identify players. 
• Edit free throw shots by series (combines 2 shot or 3 shot free throws into one UI)
• Event assistant can gray out controls that do not apply based on user actions
• Easily add putback shots
• Correct errors in real-time
• Email reports from iScout
• Full support for portrait and landscape mode
DATA COLLECTION:
• Shot value, location, made or missed, and type (layup, dunk)
• Free throw shots
• Fouls and type (charging, technical, etc)
• Turnovers and reason (dribbling, shot clock, etc)
• Deflections
• Steals
• Assists
• Blocks
• Rebounds (offense and defense)
• Playing time (and optional timer for event time)
INTEGRATION:
• Game schedules, teams and rosters from your SportsEngine** website are discoverable within iScout
• Export stats from iScout directly to your SportsEngine** website at the end of every period or game

sqftAR is a practical AR measurement tool for p
bluejetty:00178466:ios.description:
**Measure Spaces with Augmented Reality**
Measure floor and wall areas, check distances, visualize furniture placement, and see whether objects fit your space—all using your iPhone's camera.
sqftAR is a practical AR measurement tool for painting, pressure washing, landscaping, renovation, DIY projects, house hunting, and home planning.
Whether you're a contractor estimating an area or a homeowner planning your next project, sqftAR helps you visualize and measure spaces with ease.
**FIVE CORE FEATURES**
**1. Area – Floor**
Measure floor areas in square feet (ft²) or square meters (m²). Mark the corners of a floor to calculate its area. Save measurements with notes and review them later.
**2. Area – Wall**
Measure wall areas in ft² or m². Useful for painting, cleaning, renovation, and other home improvement projects.
**3. Length**
Measure the distance between two points using augmented reality.
**4. Furniture**
Place standard-sized virtual furniture in your surroundings to visualize how furniture fits and compare its size with the available space.
**5. Size Checker**
Enter an object's width, depth, and height to create a virtual 3D box. Place it in your surroundings to see how its dimensions compare with the available space.
**HOW TO USE**
**1. Area – Floor or Wall**
- Select your preferred measurement unit (ft² or m²).
- Tap "Area – Floor" or "Area – Wall" on the main menu.
- Move your iPhone slowly to scan the surrounding area.
- Find a flat floor or wall surface and wait for the blue square to appear.
- Position the "+" pointer at the first corner.
- Tap the screen to mark the corner with a red sphere.
- Move clockwise or counterclockwise to the next corner and tap again.
- Continue marking each corner. Do not mark the starting point twice.
- Tap "Calc" to calculate the area.
- To save the measurement, tap "Save," enter a note, and confirm.
- Tap "Camera" to take a photo.
- To access saved measurements, tap the file icon in the upper-right corner of the main menu.
- Search your saved measurements to find specific records.
- Tap a saved record to view its location and photo, if available.
- To delete a record, swipe left on the corresponding row.
Note: Occasionally, the orange AR-shaded area may extend beyond the outline or overlap. This visual effect does not affect the app's area calculation.
**2. Length**
- Tap "Length" on the main menu.
- Move your iPhone slowly to scan the surrounding area.
- Wait for yellow dots to appear on the target surface.
- Position the "+" pointer at the starting point.
- Tap the screen to mark the point with a red sphere.
- Move to the endpoint and position the pointer.
- Tap again to display the measured distance.
- To start a new measurement, tap "Reset."
- Tap "Camera" to take a photo.
**3. Furniture**
- Tap "Furniture" on the main menu.
- Scan the surrounding area until the blue square appears on a flat floor surface.
- Select a furniture item from the list.
- Tap the screen to place the virtual furniture.
- To rotate an item, touch it and slide your finger.
- To move an item, long-press it and drag.
- Tap "Add Another Item" to place additional furniture.
- Tap "Info" to show or hide furniture dimensions.
- Tap "Camera" to take a photo.
Virtual furniture uses standard or typical dimensions to help you visualize the relative size of a space.
**4. Size Checker**
- Select your preferred measurement unit.
- Enter the width, depth, and height of the object.
- Select the surface on which to place the virtual box.
- Tap "GO."
- Move your iPhone to scan the surrounding area.
- Wait for the blue square to appear on a suitable flat surface.
- Tap the screen to place the virtual box.
Use this feature to visualize an object's dimensions before purchasing or placing it in your space.
**IMPORTANT NOTES**
AR measurements are estimates and may vary with lighting, surfaces, and device movement. Verify measurements with professional tools when precision is required.

listings.name: sqft AR
listings.description:
**Measure Spaces with Augmented Reality**

Measure floor and wall areas, check distances, visualize furniture placement, and see whether objects fit your space—all using your iPhone's camera.

sqftAR is a practical AR measurement tool for painting, pressure washing, landscaping, renovation, DIY projects, house hunting, and home planning.

Whether you're a contractor estimating an area or a homeowner planning your next project, sqftAR helps you visualize and measure spaces with ease.

**FIVE CORE FEATURES**

**1. Area – Floor**
Measure floor areas in square feet (ft²) or square meters (m²). Mark the corners of a floor to calculate its area. Save measurements with notes and review them later.

**2. Area – Wall**
Measure wall areas in ft² or m². Useful for painting, cleaning, renovation, and other home improvement projects.

**3. Length**
Measure the distance between two points using augmented reality.

**4. Furniture**
Place standard-sized virtual furniture in your surroundings to visualize how furniture fits and compare its size with the available space.

**5. Size Checker**
Enter an object's width, depth, and height to create a virtual 3D box. Place it in your surroundings to see how its dimensions compare with the available space.

**HOW TO USE**

**1. Area – Floor or Wall**

- Select your preferred measurement unit (ft² or m²).
- Tap "Area – Floor" or "Area – Wall" on the main menu.
- Move your iPhone slowly to scan the surrounding area.
- Find a flat floor or wall surface and wait for the blue square to appear.
- Position the "+" pointer at the first corner.
- Tap the screen to mark the corner with a red sphere.
- Move clockwise or counterclockwise to the next corner and tap again.
- Continue marking each corner. Do not mark the starting point twice.
- Tap "Calc" to calculate the area.
- To save the measurement, tap "Save," enter a note, and confirm.
- Tap "Camera" to take a photo.
- To access saved measurements, tap the file icon in the upper-right corner of the main menu.
- Search your saved measurements to find specific records.
- Tap a saved record to view its location and photo, if available.
- To delete a record, swipe left on the corresponding row.

Note: Occasionally, the orange AR-shaded area may extend beyond the outline or overlap. This visual effect does not affect the app's area calculation.

**2. Length**

- Tap "Length" on the main menu.
- Move your iPhone slowly to scan the surrounding area.
- Wait for yellow dots to appear on the target surface.
- Position the "+" pointer at the starting point.
- Tap the screen to mark the point with a red sphere.
- Move to the endpoint and position the pointer.
- Tap again to display the measured distance.
- To start a new measurement, tap "Reset."
- Tap "Camera" to take a photo.

**3. Furniture**

- Tap "Furniture" on the main menu.
- Scan the surrounding area until the blue square appears on a flat floor surface.
- Select a furniture item from the list.
- Tap the screen to place the virtual furniture.
- To rotate an item, touch it and slide your finger.
- To move an item, long-press it and drag.
- Tap "Add Another Item" to place additional furniture.
- Tap "Info" to show or hide furniture dimensions.
- Tap "Camera" to take a photo.

Virtual furniture uses standard or typical dimensions to help you visualize the relative size of a space.

**4. Size Checker**

- Select your preferred measurement unit.
- Enter the width, depth, and height of the object.
- Select the surface on which to place the virtual box.
- Tap "GO."
- Move your iPhone to scan the surrounding area.
- Wait for the blue square to appear on a suitable flat surface.
- Tap the screen to place the virtual box.

Use this feature to visualize an object's dimensions before purchasing or placing it in your space.

**IMPORTANT NOTES**

AR measurements are estimates and may vary with lighting, surfaces, and device movement. Verify measurements with professional tools when precision is required.

The Adventures in Odyssey Club is a perfect place for kids 8 to 12 years old to access trusted, faith-building entertainment. Written and produced by Focus on the Family, each action-packed episode features beloved characters and real-life experiences designed to help kids navigate today’s culture, grow in their Christian walk, and just plain have fun.
Club membership requires a subscription with three affordable payment options that begin at sign-up. This high-quality content has been a family favorite for 35 years and is enjoyed by all ages – kids as well as adults.
What you’ll love about the Adventures in Odyssey Club:
• Access to over 1,000 Adventures in Odyssey episodes
• Exclusive monthly episodes and videos available to members only
• Earn digital badges for completing interactive adventures and activities
• Build playlists of your favorite episodes or listen to playlists created by our actors or special guests
• Focus on the Family Clubhouse magazine delivered to your mailbox each month filled with new stories, jokes, puzzles, and crafts
• Preview new book releases including The Imagination Station series
• Create up to eight profiles for an account. Profiles give different members of your household their own personalized experience controlled by the account administrator.
• Download episodes to your mobile device and listen offline wherever you are
• Listen across devices simultaneously
The Adventures in Odyssey Club is committed to seeing families learn and grow in a fun, safe community where Jesus is Lord and Wooton still delivers the mail.

bluejetty:00091476:ios.summary:

Our prayer for
bluejetty:00091476:ios.description:
Clarify and focus who you are created and called to be using LifeJournal. LifeJournal is a beautifully designed Christian journal and planner app to help you organize your day, accomplish your goals, and grow in your faith. 
Our prayer for the LifeJournal (Gospel focused) community is that God would use this tool to bring direction and order to what is very often a chaotic and scattered day. 
We are unapologetic in our belief that goal setting and productivity are not separate from or at odds with spiritual disciplines. Instead, they work hand-in-hand, and the LifeJournal app is a catalyst to facilitate that.
Our faith and our good works should live in the same space.
LifeJournal is built to be a place to go to for your quiet time, bible study, thankfulness, sermon notes, prayer, journaling and use throughout your day for simple to-do lists, and tracking your daily routines. 
The thankfulness area is just a quick place to start each day recognizing how God has blessed you or what you are grateful for that day. - Colossians 3:15
Journaling is something we all know we should do, and often just don’t find the time to include it in our quiet time or morning routine. LifeJournal makes journaling simple and provides resources to help you find easy ways to effectively journal.
The daily routines are broken into morning, daily, and evening - giving you a chance to organize your day into sections and see progress through out each and every day. 
With LifeJournal you are also able to use the audio to text dictation feature and journal or create prayer journals by speaking into the app - this can even be done (safely) while driving down the road when there just isn’t time in the morning to sit down and journal your thoughts.
The prayer section gives you the option for a long form prayer (prayer journal) or a quick prayer list to go through each day. 1 Thessalonians 5:17
The sermon notes section gives you a specific place to keep notes on sermons or podcasts so you can go back and reflect on them later. Taking notes while listening has been shown to increase retention of new themes, lessons or concepts taught. 
The LifeJournal Bible Study section allows you to select a chapter and verse to study, and then take notes while quickly flipping back and forth between LifeJournal and one of the most popular Bible apps. 
Our Free 7-Day Trial Gives You Full Access to LifeJournal: 
• Create a habit of thankfulness
• Keep a consistent journal
• Write out a prayer journal and track prayer lists
• Take sermon notes
• Simplify your to-do lists
What do people use LifeJournal for? 
• Journaling
• Prayer Journal
• Prayer Lists
• Bible Study
• Sermon or Podcast Notes
• Thankfulness
• To-Do Lists
• Daily Routines and Habits
LifeJournal Subscription Pricing and Terms: 
LifeJournal offers auto-renewing subscription
LifeJournal Annual: $49.99 per year (after 7-day free trial)
LifeJournal Monthly: $4.99 per month (after 7-day free trial)
These prices are for US customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Your LifeJournal subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can to to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. 
Find our terms and conditions here: 
https://www.getlifejournal.app/terms
Find our privacy policy here: 
https://www.getlifejournal.app/privacy
LifeJournal is a Christian Planner and Journal meant to be a tool to help believers organize their day, accomplish their goals, and grow in their faith.

bluejetty:00030580:ios.description:
Windows computer desktop extension, mirroring and remoting tool for WiFi, USB or LAN. Supports applications like:
- Screen Cast (to television, tablet or smart phone)
- Desktop Remoting Viewer (over USB and Local Area Network)
- Drawing Tablet (drawing and painting with digitizer pen)
- Wireless Display Monitor (similar to Miracast, RDP, AirPlay and Sidecar)
- USB Display Monitor (similar to DisplayLink)
- Remote Access (over USB link, WiFi and LAN)
- Remote Control (wireless and wired)
- Screen Streaming (including audio)
- Screen Mirroring (over the air and via cable)
- Screen Cloning
- Extension Screen
- Windows Desktop Workspace Extension
- Windows Desktop Duplication (clone)
- Windows Desktop Streaming
- Personal Computer Desktop Presenter
- Virtual Monitor for Desktop PC
- Second Display On The Go
- TV, mobile or tablet screen as Side by Side Display
- Alternative to Miracast, AirPlay and Sidecar
- Portable Multimonitor Screen for Travel
- Access main computer from mobile device
- Software KVM-Switch (Keyboard Video Mouse)
- Software Display Hub
- Software Display Switch
- Projector Screen Viewer
- Input Console
- Input Terminal
- Tablet Input Device
- Windows Graphics Tablet App
- Windows Tablet as sketchbook for drawing artwork
- Creative Video Wall App
- Video Wall w. Any Angle Rotation
Instruction manual, documentation and detailed setup:
https://manual.spacedesk.net
Quick Guide:
1. Install spacedesk DRIVER software for Windows Primary PC.
Download from: https://www.spacedesk.net
2. Install this spacedesk Viewer app for iOS.
3. Open this spacedesk Viewer app and connect to Windows Primary PC.
Connection: USB or LAN (Local Area Network).
LAN: Driver and Viewer must be on the same network
- via Mobile Hotspot
Note: Does NOT need internet connection!
The Windows Primary Machine running spacedesk Driver...
...supports Windows 11, Windows 10 or Windows 8.1. Apple Macs are not supported.
Dual monitor and multi monitor configurations are supported. 
Needs spacedesk drivers installed. Download: https://www.spacedesk.net
The Secondary Machine or Device (iOS network display client)...
...is an iPad, iPhone or device running the spacedesk iOS app. 
The wireless and wired cable connection...
...connects Windows Primary Machine to Secondary Machine or Device over USB, LAN (Local Area Network e.g. Ethernet) and/or WLAN (Wireless Local Area Network).
Local Area Network connection can be wired or over WiFi. TCP/IP network protocol is required.
More information on:
https://www.spacedesk.net
Instruction Manual: https://manual.spacedesk.net/
Support Forum: https://forum.spacedesk.net/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/pages/spacedesk/330909083726073
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YkWZSwBD-XY
— LIGHTNING FAST —
To achieve unparalleled performance and display quality with zero lag, use cable connection over USB or Local Area Network. Try to circumvent WiFi and network routers. E.g. configure Windows PC or iOS device as WiFi Access Point (Hotspot) and connect directly before connecting spacedesk. Please check chapter "Performance Tuning" in the instruction manual: https://manual.spacedesk.net
— REMOTE CONTROL INPUT AND OUTPUT PERIPHERAL ACCESSORIES —
- Touchscreen (multitouch and single touch
- Touchpad
- Mouse Pointer Control
- Keyboard
- Pressure Sensitive Stylus Pen
- Audio Speaker
— SETTINGS AND OPTIONS —
- Landscape View
- Portrait View
— SYSTEM SUPPORT —
Supported are iOS versions 11.x+ (including MacOS on Apple Silicon Chips) and PCs with Windows 11, Windows 10 and Windows 8.1. Apple Macs are not supported.

bluejetty:00045097:ios.name: Capital Public Radio App
bluejetty:00045097:ios.summary:
Capital Public Radio App:

bluejetty:00045097:ios.description:
Capital Public Radio App:
The Capital Public Radio App allows you to listen to Capital Public Radio live, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for all the Capital Public Radio streams at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for stories, bookmark a story for later, and wake up to Capital Public Radio with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from Capital Public Radio even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for every station. You can display up to three of your favorites at a time or flick once to see the schedules for all of your favorite stations.
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to Capital Public Radio in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access public radio programs from multiple content providers (NPR, PRI, APM and Capital Public Radio) easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to national programs, individual story segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The Capital Public Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or story segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Radio Bookmarks
• Save what you were listening to (Live or On Demand) so you can replay, follow-up, or share it later by simply clicking “Bookmark”.
• Compatible with the popular Radio Bookmark device (www.radiobookmark.com).
Search
• The unique “Search Public Radio” feature finds stories or programs across hundreds of stations and web pages and makes it easy to play instantly.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The Capital Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at Capital Public Radio and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support Capital Public Radio by becoming a member today!
http://www.capradio.org
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

bluejetty:00019217:ios.description:
Seventeen years have passed since you saved humanity from the Pfhor... Durandal, the only surviving artificial intelligence from the UESC Marathon, has kept you in stasis all this time. Once more, you are called on to save humanity. Leading a rag-tag band of humans and guided by an insane AI, you are the last hope to stave off the Pfhor invasion.
Welcome to Marathon 2: Durandal®, the second in the epic trilogy of first person shooter games that re-defined the genre. Experience the pulse-pounding action as you once again defend humanity from the alien Pfhor.
=====
"Move fast, seize the initiative, wield superior firepower, dive into the melee, anticipate enemy movements, slaughter the defenseless, endure."
=====
FEATURES
- 28 levels divided into nine chapters
- missions include exploration, puzzles and extermination
- smooth game play experience
- "Carnage is as easy as point and shoot."
- 8 unique weapons including:
 .45 Magnum Mega Class Pistol
 WSTE-M5 Combat Shotgun
 M.75 Assault Rifle/Grenade Launcher
 Zeus Class Fusion Pistol
 TOZT-7 flamethrower
 ... and the devastating SPNKR-X17 rocket launcher
** NOTE: Invert aim is available through the Settings app, under "Durandal"
=====
"Being naked in space stinks. Lucky for you, Mr. Security officer, you are dressed in active military uniform, complete with a Cyberhead helmet. Your Cyberhead device is your interface to your surrounding environment."
=====
STORY
- battle against the aggressive Pfhor
- play the role of the cyborg security officer
- uncover the surprising secrets of the Pfhor and their allies
=====
"Carnage is as easy as point and shoot. Different weapons are characterized with different dynamics. It is unwise, for example, to use the rocket launcher in close combat."
=====

bluejetty:00127101:ios.summary: Hãy hòa mình vào Đại Chiến Tam Quốc: trải nghiệm tựa game chiến thuật thuần kỹ năng và tư duy hiện thực hóa giấc mộng xưng đế, được xây dựng hoàn hảo dành cho thiết bị di động. Với hệ thống đồ họa và nhiệm vụ mãn nhãn, các vị quân chủ sẽ đư
bluejetty:00127101:ios.description:
Hãy hòa mình vào Đại Chiến Tam Quốc: trải nghiệm tựa game chiến thuật thuần kỹ năng và tư duy hiện thực hóa giấc mộng xưng đế, được xây dựng hoàn hảo dành cho thiết bị di động. Với hệ thống đồ họa và nhiệm vụ mãn nhãn, các vị quân chủ sẽ được trải nghiệm khung cảnh thời chiến quốc, với những phong cách chơi đa dạng đến từ 1 chiến trường duy nhất liên thông hơn 20 Quốc Gia: global, Trung Quốc, Hàn Quốc, Nhật Bản và Việt Nam.
Đến với tựa game này, người chơi kế thừa Tam Quốc Chí, xây dựng đế chế, kiến thiết quân đội, tạo lập liên minh đa quốc gia, vừa trấn thủ thành trì, vừa công thành xưng đế, thỏa sức thể hiện cá tính qua lối chơi biến hóa không tưởng. Tựa game còn tái hiện một cách chân thực nhất những trận chiến đặc sắc trong Tam Quốc Diễn Nghĩa của La Quán Trung như Xích Bích, Vượt Ải Trảm Tướng, Vương Giả Tranh Bá cùng hàng trăm danh tướng 3Q từ Chiến Thần Lữ Bố, Võ Thánh Quan Vũ, Ngọa Long Gia Cát Lượng,... và không thể thiếu tuyệt sắc mỹ nữ Điêu Thuyền cùng những vị thiếu niên anh hùng.
CÁC TÍNH NĂNG NỔI BẬT
▶ Một server duy nhất, liên thông 20 quốc gia trên toàn thế giới. 
▶ Làm chủ đại quốc, tự do tạo dựng thế lực thông qua nhiều hoạt động như Thao trường, Binh doanh, Tướng kỳ, Điểm tướng đài, Quân đoàn, Cấm vệ doanh, Lưu ly tháp,...
▶ Vượt mặt đối thủ: Hàng trăm thành trì đang chờ bạn tranh đấu, Nhất Thống Thiên Hạ. Gần 2 chục binh chủng các loại cùng xuất chiến trong 1 lúc. 
▶ Tranh đoạt tài nguyên, các cuộc đại chiến PVP vang danh sử sách cùng hàng triệu Game thủ trên thế giới.
▶ Xông vào chiến trường với Quân đoàn chiến rộng lớn không biên giới. Tính năng chiến đấu đặc sắc, mưu lược thiên biến vạn hóa. Thắng bại tại chiến thuật.
▶ Hàng trăm danh tướng Vô Song, vang danh truyền kỳ thời loạn Tam quân.
▶ Tính năng tương tác giữa những người chơi phủ sóng toàn thế giới, thành lập clans, tham gia hội chiến, giao lưu kết bạn. Chơi game một mình sao vui nổi.
Hãy tham gia ngay để có những trải nghiệm chân thực nhất, khó khăn nhất nhưng cũng thỏa mãn nhất.
Hỗ trợ 24/7 qua số Hotline: 19001104

bluejetty:00153103:ios.name: MrClean: Photo Calendar
bluejetty:00153103:ios.summary: MrClean: Photo Calendar turns your photo library into a calendar you can actually get through. Instead of one endless camera roll, you see your year month by month, review one month at a time and decide what stays. The app also keeps contac
bluejetty:00153103:ios.description:
MrClean: Photo Calendar turns your photo library into a calendar you can actually get through. Instead of one endless camera roll, you see your year month by month, review one month at a time and decide what stays. The app also keeps contacts, calendar events and private notes in order.
HOW IT WORKS
Photo Calendar
Your home screen shows every month of the year with its photo count and review status, so you always know where you left off.
On this day
See photos taken on today's date in earlier years and swipe through them to keep the best memories.
Swipe to decide
Open a month from the calendar or today's On this day photos and swipe left to mark a photo for deletion or right to keep it. Then open Review, check what you marked and delete it in one step.
Smart scan
Choose a period and categories, and Smart scan looks for similar shots, exact duplicates, screenshots, large videos and screen recordings. In every group of similar photos the best one stays, and one tap picks a different favorite.
Contacts
Merge contacts that share the same phone number, remove entries with no phone or email, and save your address book as a .vcf backup file.
Birthdays
Upcoming birthdays from your contacts in one list, with an option to add them to your calendar.
Calendar
Clear out events that already ended and remove extra copies of the same event. Future dates of recurring meetings stay untouched.
Locked notes
Write notes with text and photos and protect the private ones with your own passcode and Face ID.
Widgets
Keep On this day or your swipe progress on the Home Screen.
ACCESS AND PRIVACY
Photo library access is needed to build your calendar and find items to review. Contacts and calendar access is used only for the contact, birthday and event tools, and Face ID only to open locked notes. Photos, contacts and events are processed on your device. Every photo deletion asks for your confirmation, and deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days.
MADE FOR SHORT SESSIONS
Review a month while waiting for coffee or clear old screenshots before a trip. Progress is saved for each month, so you can stop at any time and continue later. Download MrClean and give your photo library a calendar of its own.
PREMIUM
Browsing, scanning and reviewing are free. Premium is needed to finish an action: delete photos and videos, merge or remove contacts, create contact backups, delete events and lock notes.
Plans: weekly with a 3-day free trial, or yearly. The current price is shown in the app before you subscribe.

listings.name: MrClean: Photo Calendar
listings.description:
MrClean: Photo Calendar turns your photo library into a calendar you can actually get through. Instead of one endless camera roll, you see your year month by month, review one month at a time and decide what stays. The app also keeps contacts, calendar events and private notes in order.
 
HOW IT WORKS
 
Photo Calendar
Your home screen shows every month of the year with its photo count and review status, so you always know where you left off.
 
On this day
See photos taken on today's date in earlier years and swipe through them to keep the best memories.
 
Swipe to decide
Open a month from the calendar or today's On this day photos and swipe left to mark a photo for deletion or right to keep it. Then open Review, check what you marked and delete it in one step.
 
Smart scan
Choose a period and categories, and Smart scan looks for similar shots, exact duplicates, screenshots, large videos and screen recordings. In every group of similar photos the best one stays, and one tap picks a different favorite.
 
Contacts
Merge contacts that share the same phone number, remove entries with no phone or email, and save your address book as a .vcf backup file.
 
Birthdays
Upcoming birthdays from your contacts in one list, with an option to add them to your calendar.
 
Calendar
Clear out events that already ended and remove extra copies of the same event. Future dates of recurring meetings stay untouched.
 
Locked notes
Write notes with text and photos and protect the private ones with your own passcode and Face ID.
 
Widgets
Keep On this day or your swipe progress on the Home Screen.
 
ACCESS AND PRIVACY
 
Photo library access is needed to build your calendar and find items to review. Contacts and calendar access is used only for the contact, birthday and event tools, and Face ID only to open locked notes. Photos, contacts and events are processed on your device. Every photo deletion asks for your confirmation, and deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days.
 
MADE FOR SHORT SESSIONS
 
Review a month while waiting for coffee or clear old screenshots before a trip. Progress is saved for each month, so you can stop at any time and continue later. Download MrClean and give your photo library a calendar of its own.
 
PREMIUM
 
Browsing, scanning and reviewing are free. Premium is needed to finish an action: delete photos and videos, merge or remove contacts, create contact backups, delete events and lock notes.

ĐƯỢC HƠN 2 TRIỆU NGƯỜI DÙNG TIN TƯỞNG & ĐÁNH GIÁ CAO
Voiz FM là ứng dụng âm thanh chất lượng cao hàng đầu Việt Nam, cung cấp hơn 15.000+ nội dung phong phú bao gồm: Sách nói, Podcast, Sách tóm tắt, Truyện thiếu nhi, Thiền & Ngủ. Voiz FM cam kết mang đến trải nghiệm nghe sách mượt mà, cảm xúc từ 100% giọng đọc của các diễn viên lồng tiếng, nói không với giọng đọc AI, giúp bạn tối ưu hóa thời gian rảnh rỗi như khi lái xe, chạy bộ, nấu ăn...
GIÁ TRỊ VƯỢT TRỘI CHỈ CÓ TẠI VOIZ FM:
- TRẢI NGHIỆM VIP KHÔNG GIỚI HẠN: Thành viên VIP được nghe TOÀN BỘ kho Sách nói & Podcast cao cấp mà không bị giới hạn số lượng mỗi tháng (Lợi ích khác biệt so với các ứng dụng khác).
- CHẤT LƯỢNG ÂM THANH ĐỈNH CAO: Ứng dụng mượt mà, tối ưu hóa không giật lag, không hao pin, đảm bảo trải nghiệm nghe liền mạch, trọn vẹn.
- NGHE THỬ HOÀN TOÀN MIỄN PHÍ: Bạn có thể nghe thử một phần hoặc toàn bộ một số nội dung Miễn Phí để tự kiểm chứng chất lượng trước khi đăng ký VIP.
KHO NỘI DUNG SÁCH NÓI ĐỘC QUYỀN & CHỌN LỌC: Voiz FM hợp tác cùng các nhà xuất bản uy tín để mang đến những tựa sách có bản quyền, được thu âm bởi đội ngũ Giọng đọc chuyên nghiệp, truyền cảm.
- SÁCH BÁN CHẠY MỌI THỜI ĐẠI: Đắc Nhân Tâm, Muôn Kiếp Nhân Sinh, Chiến Tranh Tiền Tệ, Nghĩ Giàu Và Làm Giàu...
- TÁC GIẢ HÀNG ĐẦU VIỆT NAM & THẾ GIỚI: Nguyễn Nhật Ánh, Thích Nhất Hạnh, Osho, Nguyên Phong, Napoleon Hill...
- SÁCH TÓM TẮT THUẬN TIỆN: Tóm tắt những quyển sách Kinh doanh, làm giàu nổi tiếng (ví dụ: Cha Giàu Cha Nghèo, Sức Mạnh Tiềm Thức) chỉ trong 30 phút.
- ĐA DẠNG THỂ LOẠI: Kỹ năng, Đầu tư, Kinh doanh, Lãnh đạo, Khởi Nghiệp, Tâm linh, Ngôn tình, Truyện thiếu nhi...
CÁC TÍNH NĂNG TỐI ƯU TRẢI NGHIỆM:
- NGHE OFFLINE: Tải nội dung về thiết bị và nghe bất cứ khi nào, ngay cả khi không có kết nối Wifi/3G/4G.
- CÁ NHÂN HÓA: Chức năng "Đánh dấu trang", Hẹn giờ tắt, Tùy chỉnh Tốc độ nghe sách (tua nhanh/chậm).
- CHẾ ĐỘ LÁI XE AN TOÀN: Chế độ xe hơi đơn giản, hỗ trợ Carplay để nghe Sách nói trên mọi cung đường.
- GỢI Ý THÔNG MINH: Nghe càng nhiều, gợi ý càng chính xác, giúp bạn khám phá nội dung mới dễ dàng.
GÓI DỊCH VỤ LINH HOẠT & TIẾT KIỆM: Voiz FM cung cấp các gói dịch vụ minh bạch, giúp bạn tiết kiệm hơn so với mua sách giấy hay Ebook hay một số ứng dụng khác.
- Gói Thuê bao: Chỉ từ 2,000 đồng/ngày, nghe không giới hạn Sách nói VIP (Lựa chọn tối ưu của 90% người dùng).
- Mua lẻ sách: Mua và sở hữu lâu dài những tựa Sách nói yêu thích.

The official MR PORTER app puts the world of luxury menswear in the palm of your hand. Take your pick from more than 300 brands, including TOM FORD, Brunello Cucinelli, The Row and CELINE, as well as exclusive collections, curated capsules and our in-house label, Mr P. NEVER MISS OUT 
- Shop our A-Z of more than 300 of the world’s most exclusive men’s and lifestyle brands, including AMIRI, Bottega Veneta, Brioni, Burberry, Canada Goose, Christian Louboutin, Gallery Dept., Gucci, Kapital, Loewe, Moncler, McQueen, New Balance, Polo Ralph Lauren, Rick Owens, Saint Laurent, Stone Island and more

THE EASIEST WAY TO SHOP
- Your Wish List, basket and checkout process automatically sync across all your devices, so it’s easy for you to pick up where you left off 
- Our in-built search function makes it easy to browse items, designer brands and categories
- Detailed product descriptions and built-in fit guides are there to help you choose the size that’s right for you, whether you’re shopping for clothing, footwear or accessories
- Enjoy express worldwide shipping to more than 170 countries and 28-day easy return and exchange
ADVICE FROM THE EXPERTS
- Discover our editors’ curated selection of the latest menswear, luxury watches, designer sneakers, shoes, jackets, suits and accessories, as well as new-season trends and outfits
- Enjoy access to MR PORTER’s editorial content, including celebrity interviews, style tips and grooming advice

Scan, OCR, Edit, and Share Documents Instantly
Turn your iPhone into a powerful, high-speed scanner. FasterScan lets you scan multi-page documents on the go—no bulky scanner needed. From receipts and business cards to books and posters, capture anything with precision, even if the document is curled.
Crystal-Clear Scans, Every Time

Seamless Document Management
 • Create folders, rename files, and protect sensitive documents with passwords.

Export & Share with Ease

apple-macos:6819546389.name: Jikfu: Quick Reply Keyboard
apple-macos:6819546389.description:
How many times a day do you type the same thing? Jikfu saves the phrases you use most as cards, grouped by scenario — quotes, scheduling, follow-ups — each in its own group.
Switch to the Jikfu keyboard in any text field that allows third-party keyboards and tap a card: the text goes straight into the field, in messages, email, notes or forms. No copy and paste.
The same cards on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Build a set on your Mac and it is there on your iPhone when you go out.
SCENARIOS
• A scenario is one group of cards you use together (quotes, scheduling, after-sales follow-up)
• Switch scenario and the panel changes to that group, so you are not scrolling through dozens of lines
• A card can belong to more than one scenario; tags and a Recently used list make it one step
IN ANY APP
• Works in any text field that allows third-party keyboards, not just a few apps
• No copying back and forth between two apps — pick a card and the text is already there
• On Mac, a global shortcut opens the card panel and pastes back into the app you were just using; the first 27 cards have built-in shortcuts
ONE SET OF CARDS, THREE DEVICES
• iPhone, iPad and Mac sync through the private database of your own Apple Account
• Cards you build on the Mac are ready on your iPhone when you leave
• One subscription covers all three
KEYBOARD
• One card can hold several language versions, such as Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and English; switch with the language button
• Compose: pick a few sentences step by step and insert them as one reply
• You check the text and press send yourself — Jikfu never sends messages for you
CREATE CARDS
• Text, link, image and colour cards
• Take a photo or choose one from Photos and read the text in it on your device
• Use Apple Translation to draft other language versions
• Use Share in other apps to add text, links or images to Jikfu
• Pin and reorder cards; deleted items go to the Trash and can be restored within 7 days
SYNC AND BACKUP
• iCloud sync is on by default on iPhone and iPad (you can turn it off) and can be turned on in Mac settings
• One ZIP backup file exports or restores scenarios, cards and images
• Optional automatic backup to iCloud Drive, keeping the latest 7
• Export a single scenario or card as a file; text and link cards can be exported as CSV
PRIVACY
• No sign-up, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics or tracking
• Optionally require Face ID or the device passcode when opening the app
• The Jikfu keyboard does not read the conversations in other apps or what you are typing; some features (such as the clipboard and copying images) need you to allow Full Access for the keyboard in Settings
APPEARANCE
Moon White, Ink Night, and limited styles: Guochao Gold, Salmon Guochao Gold and Eagle Guochao Gold (limited styles may change or be removed in future versions).
SUBSCRIPTION
The free version lets you create up to 10 cards and use every other feature. Subscribe to remove the limit — choose monthly, six-month or annual billing; the features are the same. Prices for each plan are shown in the App Store. Eligible new subscribers get a free trial (length shown by the App Store). When a subscription ends, the free 10-card limit returns and your existing cards are kept. One subscription works on iPhone, iPad and Mac. In Settings › Subscription & Plans you can enter an offer code, restore purchases or manage your subscription.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.henrychan0508.com/Jikfu/privacy-en.html
MAC
The same purchase includes the Mac app (from the Mac App Store): call up the card panel with a keyboard shortcut and click a card to copy or paste it.
